spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Cost isn't the problem, and fewer resources would slow you further.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. SV = -45k (behind), CV = +40k (under budget): you can afford more resources to recover the schedule.

domande.spiegazione: Variance analysis: SV = EV - PV, CV = EV - AC (PMBOK 6, p. 262).

domande.domanda: Team members from other areas were assigned at 50% availability, but they are being pulled back into their normal roles and the project is falling behind. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Talk with the steering committee to arrange more resources.
opzioni.B: Negotiate with the functional managers for clear written assignments with reliable scheduling priorities.
opzioni.C: Raise a risk to delivery and assign it to the functional managers.
opzioni.D: Raise an issue in the issue log and bring it up at the next working group.

domande.hint: Manage it yourself, directly and collaboratively.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Escalation may come later, not first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Direct negotiation with functional managers, with written, reliable commitments.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. It's already happening: it's an issue, not a risk.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Logging is fine, but waiting for the next meeting is too slow.

domande.spiegazione: Interpersonal and team skills: negotiation with functional managers (PMBOK 6, pp. 332-333).
domande.nota: The instructor considers B and D close.

domande.domanda: You're helping a functional manager build a business case to increase profit by 57% in three years. He has 18 project ideas that would take about 7 years and pushes you to fit them all into three. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Prioritize the ideas by impact and cost, noting each as required, desired or optional in the business case.
opzioni.B: Advise the manager that good things take time to deliver.
opzioni.C: Add the cost of extra resources to your project plan to get all the work done.
opzioni.D: Ask the functional area experts to pick their top ideas.

domande.hint: When everything is a must-have, bring a proper process.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. The business case analyzes options with decision criteria such as required, desired, optional.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Dismissive and unhelpful.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Needs approval, and doesn't prioritize.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. People pick pet projects: prioritize by impact and cost instead.

domande.spiegazione: Business case: situation analysis with criteria (required, desired, optional) (PMBOK 6, p. 31).

domande.domanda: Your charter is approved and analysis shows several highly paid, highly influential and impacted executives. When you approach them, they raise concerns about the project, its progress and what it involves. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Perform an impact/influence analysis on all stakeholders.
opzioni.B: Create the project management plan and review it regularly with the impacted and influential stakeholders.
opzioni.C: Circulate the signed charter to anyone who needs convincing.
opzioni.D: Reduce communication with most stakeholders: they can't resist what they don't know about.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Already done: that's how you identified them.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Developing the plan and reviewing it regularly with them supports engagement.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The charter only authorizes; it doesn't address ongoing concerns.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. It backfires: it's always better to communicate more.

domande.spiegazione: Develop Project Management Plan; review with stakeholders regularly (PMBOK 6, p. 82).

domande.domanda: Your project management plan includes scope, schedule, cost, resource and quality plans. Stakeholders say they can't see what is baselined or how performance and changes are measured. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Tell stakeholders the information is in the subsidiary plans.
opzioni.B: Meet stakeholders as often as needed to increase engagement.
opzioni.C: Show them the budget timeline with costs projected on the schedule.
opzioni.D: Create the configuration management plan, change management plan and performance measurement baseline and include them in the plan.

domande.hint: Which plan components cover baselines and changes?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Those subsidiary plans don't contain it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Doesn't answer the baseline question.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Only one part of the picture.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Configuration plan = what's baselined; change plan = how to process changes; PMB = integrated scope-schedule-cost baseline.

domande.spiegazione: Additional project management plan components (PMBOK 6, p. 88).

domande.domanda: Part of the work will be outsourced. The cost must not exceed $1.2 million, and if the supplier delivers under cost and ahead of schedule, you may pay them extra. What contract will you prepare with procurement?

opzioni.A: Firm fixed price.
opzioni.B: Fixed price incentive fee.
opzioni.C: Cost plus fixed fee.
opzioni.D: Cost plus award fee.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. One fixed price, no incentive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. FPIF has a price ceiling (costs above are the seller's) and incentives tied to agreed metrics.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Cost reimbursable: no ceiling.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. No ceiling, and the award is subjective.

domande.spiegazione: Contract types (PMBOK 6, p. 471).

domande.domanda: You take the completed scope to the sponsor for acceptance. She can't accept because she doesn't know the testing outcomes or whether the scope met her requirements. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Meet the sponsor directly to address her concerns.
opzioni.B: Review the RTM and show how each requirement is met.
opzioni.C: Review the quality report with your testing lead and note which items may need change requests.
opzioni.D: Review the project change requests to show whether corrective actions were needed.

domande.hint: Her question is about testing outcomes.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Good approach, but you need the testing data.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Contains little testing information.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. The quality report summarizes control quality findings and corrective action recommendations.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Useful, but not focused on testing outcomes.

domande.spiegazione: Quality reports (PMBOK 6, p. 296).

domande.domanda: Unforeseen events set your project behind and you spent a lot to recover. The sponsor threatens to stop the project unless they can see how much it will cost by the time it's finished. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Perform reserve analysis on remaining contingency and management reserves.
opzioni.B: Create an estimate at completion and compare it to the budget at completion.
opzioni.C: Calculate the to-complete performance index with your team.
opzioni.D: Review the cost performance index.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Doesn't give the total cost.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. EAC forecasts total cost at completion; compare it with the original BAC.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. TCPI is an efficiency index, not a total cost.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. CPI shows efficiency to date, not a final figure.

domande.spiegazione: Cost forecasts: EAC vs BAC (PMBOK 6, pp. 264, 269).

domande.domanda: Your plan includes schedule, cost and resource estimates. The sponsor believes the project can be done with about 34% fewer resources. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Dismiss the sponsor's comments as uneducated and proceed.
opzioni.B: Reduce the resources in your plan to meet the sponsor's expectations.
opzioni.C: Create a basis of estimates with your team and review it with the sponsor to agree on a way forward.
opzioni.D: Raise a delivery risk in case the plan proceeds with fewer resources.

domande.hint: Direct and collaborative: make estimates transparent.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Loses the sponsor's support.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. You don't know the impact yet.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. The basis of estimates explains assumptions, constraints and ranges so you can agree together.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Doesn't manage the situation now.

domande.spiegazione: Basis of estimates (PMBOK 6, p. 204).

domande.domanda: At Stratus Innovations, leadership proposes delivering a new customer platform that will impact multiple teams. It must be released before October next year, and experts from other systems or teams may be involved. Leadership asks how this initiative should be managed. What will you tell them?

opzioni.A: Manage it as a portfolio.
opzioni.B: Manage it as a program.
opzioni.C: Manage it as a project.
opzioni.D: Manage it as part of ongoing operations.

domande.hint: A temporary endeavor, with a deadline, that creates a unique result.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. A portfolio groups projects, programs and operations to achieve strategic objectives; this is a single initiative.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. A program coordinates multiple related projects to obtain benefits not available managing them separately; here there's one initiative.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. A project is a temporary endeavor that creates value through a unique product, service or result: it has a deadline and a defined outcome.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Operations are ongoing, repetitive activities, not a temporary initiative with an end date.

domande.spiegazione: Projects are initiated to create value by producing tangible or intangible deliverables (Standard for PM, p. 12).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed: the instructor reads portfolio, project, program, operations and answers C (project).

domande.domanda: Daniel, project manager at Fintrust Solutions, is preparing the business case for a new mobile banking platform. He identifies expected outcomes including increased transaction revenue, improved customer satisfaction and brand reputation. How should Daniel categorize these benefits?

opzioni.A: Both are tangible benefits.
opzioni.B: Both are intangible benefits.
opzioni.C: Revenue increase is intangible; customer satisfaction and brand reputation are tangible.
opzioni.D: Revenue increase is tangible; customer satisfaction and brand reputation are intangible.

domande.hint: Can it be measured directly in financial terms?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Customer satisfaction and brand reputation are hard to express in financial terms.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Revenue is money: it's measurable in financial terms.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. It's the other way around.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Revenue is measurable in money (tangible); satisfaction and reputation are hard to express financially (intangible).

domande.spiegazione: Tangible benefits: profitability, equity, market share. Intangible: brand recognition, customer satisfaction, employee well-being (Standard for PM, p. 14).
domande.nota: Option text reconstructed from the instructor's commentary.

domande.domanda: You're the PM at Secure Bank Corporation implementing an online banking platform. While developing the project management plan, you identify regulations, organizational culture and IT infrastructure that may influence the project. How should you account for these factors?

opzioni.A: Treat them as enterprise environmental factors.
opzioni.B: Treat them as project risks.
opzioni.C: Include them as part of the scope baseline.
opzioni.D: Treat them as project deliverables.

domande.hint: Conditions not under the team's control that influence the project.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. EEFs are conditions not directly controlled by the team that impact, constrain or direct the project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. They're existing conditions, not uncertain future events.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. They're not work the project delivers.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The project doesn't produce them.

domande.spiegazione: Enterprise environmental factors (Standard for PM, p. 18).

domande.domanda: Rose, PM at TCS, is implementing a new internal reporting system. The PMO requires a standard project management plan template and procedures from previous projects. How should Rose classify these templates and procedures?

opzioni.A: Enterprise environmental factors.
opzioni.B: Project deliverables.
opzioni.C: Organizational process assets.
opzioni.D: Project assumptions.

domande.hint: Templates, procedures and knowledge repositories of the organization.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. EEFs are external or internal conditions (regulations, culture, market), not templates and procedures.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. They're inputs used by the project, not outputs.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. OPAs include the plans, processes, templates and knowledge repositories of the performing organization.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. They're established, documented assets, not assumptions.

domande.spiegazione: Organizational process assets (Standard for PM, p. 19).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: You're PM at Build Max Engineering on a large infrastructure project. The organization assigns you as PM, provides dedicated resources and gives you full authority over the budget and decision making. What organizational structure is this?

opzioni.A: Balanced matrix.
opzioni.B: Weak matrix.
opzioni.C: Project-oriented.
opzioni.D: Functional.

domande.hint: Who holds authority over budget and resources?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. In a balanced matrix authority is shared between PM and functional managers.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. In a weak matrix the PM has little authority.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. In a project-oriented organization the PM has high authority over team, resources and budget.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. In a functional organization the functional manager holds authority.

domande.spiegazione: Influence of organizational structures on projects (Standard for PM, p. 22).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Liam, a sales manager at Prime Manufacturing, wants to start a process improvement initiative. Team members are already in his team, but he has no additional budget or authority. What organizational structure is this?

opzioni.A: Weak matrix.
opzioni.B: Functional.
opzioni.C: Project-oriented.
opzioni.D: Balanced matrix.

domande.hint: The project is run inside an existing functional team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Close, but a weak matrix still has some project coordination role.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. In a functional organization the project is done within the functional team, with no dedicated budget or resources.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. There's no high PM authority here.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Authority isn't shared: there's no project budget at all.

domande.spiegazione: Functional organizations: project done within an existing functional team (Standard for PM, p. 22).

domande.domanda: Sophia, PM at Tech Bridge Solutions, leads a system implementation. During planning she performs coordination, collaboration, applies expertise and provides support. Which function is NOT associated with projects?

opzioni.A: Providing oversight and coordination.
opzioni.B: Facilitating and supporting.
opzioni.C: Applying expertise.
opzioni.D: Performing ongoing operational support for the delivered product.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Associated) Oversight and coordination is a project function.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. (Associated) Facilitating and supporting is a project function.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (Associated) Applying expertise is a project function.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. (NOT associated) Ongoing operational support is day-to-day operations, not a temporary project.

domande.spiegazione: Functions associated with projects (Standard for PM, pp. 22-26).

domande.domanda: An employee secures funding for the project, provides strategic direction and helps remove organizational obstacles to ensure project success. What role is this?

opzioni.A: Product owner.
opzioni.B: Project sponsor.
opzioni.C: Project customer.
opzioni.D: Project manager.

domande.hint: Who provides resources and is accountable for enabling success?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The product owner sets direction for an agile team through the product backlog.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. The sponsor provides resources and support and is accountable for enabling success.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The customer receives the benefits but doesn't usually fund or remove organizational blockers.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The PM leads the team delivering the work but doesn't secure funding.

domande.spiegazione: Sponsor (Standard for PM; PMBOK 8, p. 274).

domande.domanda: Roi is on the project management team at Trans Global Logistics for a system upgrade. The team collaborates with stakeholders and managers to align with objectives and secure resources. Which is something the project management team would do?

opzioni.A: Provide duration and cost estimates on the deliverables.
opzioni.B: Coordinate with functional managers for demands on critical resources.
opzioni.C: Verify that deliverables meet their quality requirements.
opzioni.D: Approve the final product on behalf of the customer.

domande.hint: Project team vs project management team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Estimating deliverables is done by the project team doing the work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. The PM team negotiates with other PM teams and functional managers on critical resources and priorities.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Done by the project/quality team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Acceptance is the sponsor's or customer's role.

domande.spiegazione: Interaction between the PM team and project aspects (Standard for PM, p. 29).
domande.nota: Options C and D reconstructed.

domande.domanda: You're working with the sponsor early in a cloud platform implementation at CSI. Preparing the business case, they ask when the project will begin delivering value. What will you tell them?

opzioni.A: Value will be realized after the project is fully completed.
opzioni.B: Benefits can be realized during project execution phases.
opzioni.C: Value will be realized once benefits are formally measured.
opzioni.D: Value can be realized throughout the project, at the end, or after completion.

domande.hint: Not only at one point in time.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not only at the end.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. True, but not only during execution.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Measurement confirms value; it doesn't create it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Value can be delivered throughout, at the end or after completion, whenever deliverables are used.

domande.spiegazione: Focus on value (Standard for PM, p. 41).

domande.domanda: You're PM on a chip fabrication project at Ng Micro Devices. A functional manager wants assurance that quality standards for deliverables passed to their department will be consistently met. How will you manage this?

opzioni.A: Verify quality through final inspection before delivery.
opzioni.B: Integrate quality into processes to consistently achieve target quality thresholds.
opzioni.C: Manage quality separately from project processes to ensure independence.
opzioni.D: Focus quality on correcting defects after they are identified.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Inspection catches defects late; it doesn't ensure consistency.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Embedding quality in processes and deliverables keeps a consistent focus on thresholds.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Quality must be part of project processes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Reactive: defects should be prevented.

domande.spiegazione: Embed quality into processes and deliverables (Standard for PM, p. 43).

domande.domanda: Raphael manages a government mega project at SGI with multiple vendors. A conflict between vendor teams over shift rotations creates tension and now affects deliverables. How should he address it?

opzioni.A: Force the vendors to follow the agreed contract terms.
opzioni.B: Let the vendors resolve the issue on their own.
opzioni.C: Facilitate discussions to identify root causes and agree on a solution.
opzioni.D: Assign your best team member to manage the conflict.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Possible, but forcing doesn't resolve the conflict's cause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Passive: the PM must be proactive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Collaboration resolves the conflict and removes friction harming quality and productivity.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. It's the PM's job, not to be delegated.

domande.spiegazione: Be an accountable leader (Standard for PM, p. 48).

domande.domanda: You're planning a refinery expansion at Petrocore Energy. An executive is concerned about rising staffing costs and several risks identified early. What will you tell them about cost and risk over the project?

opzioni.A: Cost and staffing are highest at the beginning, while risk and uncertainty increase toward completion.
opzioni.B: Cost and staffing gradually decrease, while risk remains constant.
opzioni.C: Cost and staffing increase as work progresses and drop near completion, while risk and uncertainty decrease over time.
opzioni.D: Cost and staffing remain stable, while risk and uncertainty fluctuate unpredictably.

domande.hint: Think of the classic graph: one curve rises, the other falls.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Inverted: costs start low and uncertainty starts high.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Costs don't decrease from the start, and risk doesn't stay constant.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Costs are low at the start, peak during execution and drop at the end; uncertainty is highest early and decreases.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. There's a predictable pattern.

domande.spiegazione: Impact of variables over time (Standard for PM, p. 59).

domande.domanda: Dr. Mitchell manages drug development at EB Inc. in a highly regulated environment with phase gates. Scope, schedule, cost and risks are defined early, with strict change control and extensive upfront planning. Which approach is this?

opzioni.A: Adaptive.
opzioni.B: Incremental.
opzioni.C: Hybrid.
opzioni.D: Predictive.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Adaptive welcomes change through iterations.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Incremental delivers in increments.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. No adaptive element is described.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Predictive (waterfall) fits when scope can be stabilized early.

domande.spiegazione: Predictive approaches (Standard for PM, p. 61).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Jason leads a mobile app project at Blue Peak Digital. The team works in short iterations, delivering features regularly and refining based on feedback. One person is responsible for the approved scope and its value. Which approach?

opzioni.A: Adaptive.
opzioni.B: Predictive.
opzioni.C: Hybrid.
opzioni.D: Incremental.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Adaptive (agile) delivers in iterations, uses feedback; the product owner owns scope and value.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Predictive delivers in one go.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. No predictive element is described.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Incremental delivers increments but without iterative refinement from feedback.

domande.spiegazione: Adaptive approaches (Standard for PM, p. 63).

domande.domanda: Ethan's project at Westgate Group delivers an enterprise platform. The software has constantly evolving requirements, while the data center is built with upfront planning and formal change control. They come together in a final sprint. Which approach?

opzioni.A: Predictive.
opzioni.B: Hybrid.
opzioni.C: Incremental.
opzioni.D: Adaptive.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Only the infrastructure part is predictive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Combines adaptive and predictive elements.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Only part is incremental.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Only the software part is adaptive.

domande.spiegazione: Hybrid approaches (Standard for PM, p. 65).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: You've taken over the Orion CRM upgrade, where many stakeholders aren't available, others are disengaged and success criteria are unclear. This is an example of:

opzioni.A: Project constraints.
opzioni.B: Issues to be managed.
opzioni.C: Leading indicators.
opzioni.D: Lagging indicators.

domande.hint: Signals of what may go wrong in the future.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. They aren't limits on the project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. They must be managed, but the concept tested is the indicator.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Leading indicators signal upcoming changes or trends that may put performance at risk.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Lagging indicators measure results already achieved.

domande.spiegazione: Leading indicators (PMBOK 8, p. 14).
domande.nota: The instructor considers B close.

domande.domanda: You've been assigned to a new patient record system at CHS. The business case is approved and key stakeholders identified. Leadership wants the project to start immediately. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Develop the project management plan.
opzioni.B: Hold a kickoff meeting with the team.
opzioni.C: Work with the sponsor to approve the project charter.
opzioni.D: Perform a make-or-buy analysis.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The plan is developed in planning, after the project is authorized by the charter.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Tempting, but the project isn't authorized yet.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. The charter formally authorizes the project and gives the PM authority over resources.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. A distractor: make-or-buy is a procurement decision, not the next step to start the project.

domande.spiegazione: Initiate Project or Phase (PMBOK 8, p. 17).

domande.domanda: You've been hired for a retail expansion. As planning begins, material costs rise significantly and stakeholders question whether the project is still worthwhile. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Review the project management plan.
opzioni.B: Review the financial management plan.
opzioni.C: Review the project charter.
opzioni.D: Review the business case.

domande.hint: Which document assesses cost versus benefit?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. It says how the project is managed, not if it's worthwhile.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. It's the process for managing finances.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The charter authorizes the project; it doesn't assess cost versus value.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. The business case is the economic feasibility study.

domande.spiegazione: Business case (PMBOK 8, pp. 17, 116).

domande.domanda: Elijah is initiating a data center expansion at QGS. Early planning relies on uncertain factors like utility availability and vendor timeline accuracy. As he documents initial cost and duration estimates, what will he NOT do?

opzioni.A: Note the factors in the assumption log.
opzioni.B: Add the factors to the issue log.
opzioni.C: Add the factors to the risk register.
opzioni.D: Add the factors to the basis of estimates.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (He would do it) These are assumptions underlying the estimates.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. (He would NOT do it) Issues are events that have occurred; these haven't.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (He would do it) Uncertainties belong in the risk register.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. (He would do it) They affect the estimates.

domande.spiegazione: Assumption log, risk register and issue log (PMBOK 8, pp. 17, 114).

domande.domanda: You're managing a large infrastructure project at Granite Works. After a kickoff, team leads provided their high-level strategies. You want them in a document that can change and be configured over time. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Create the configuration management plan.
opzioni.B: Create the project management plan.
opzioni.C: Create the change management plan.
opzioni.D: Update the project charter.

domande.hint: Which document integrates all the subsidiary strategies?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Handles version control, not strategy integration.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. It integrates all subsidiary plans and specifies execution, monitoring and closure.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Defines the change control process.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The charter is high-level and initiates the project.

domande.spiegazione: Integrate and align project plans (PMBOK 8, pp. 18-19).
domande.nota: Option D reconstructed.

domande.domanda: A team at Redwood Industrial is preparing to acquire specialized components. They're defining evaluation criteria, contract types and whether to build internally or outsource. No vendors have been contacted. What should the PM do next?

opzioni.A: Issue procurement documents and request vendor proposals.
opzioni.B: Evaluate vendor proposals and select the best supplier.
opzioni.C: Develop the sourcing strategy, including make-or-buy decisions.
opzioni.D: Advertise the opportunity to gather additional vendors.

domande.hint: First decide whether to outsource at all.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Procurement documents are issued only after the sourcing strategy is defined.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. No vendors have been contacted, so there are no proposals to evaluate.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Plan Sourcing Strategy documents sourcing decisions, the selection approach and make-or-buy.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Advertising comes after deciding to outsource and defining the strategy.

domande.spiegazione: Plan Sourcing Strategy (PMBOK 8, pp. 19-20).

domande.domanda: A project requires outsourced engineering. Several vendors want to bid but have different ideas of what the project is about. How do you get everyone on the same page?

opzioni.A: Conduct a bidder conference.
opzioni.B: Clarify the source selection criteria.
opzioni.C: Perform a make-or-buy analysis.
opzioni.D: Use advertising for the proposal.

domande.hint: Same information to all prospective sellers.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. A bidder conference gives all sellers the same information and clarifications.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Criteria explain how you'll choose, not what the project is.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Decides whether to outsource.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Ensures fairness of visibility, not shared understanding.

domande.spiegazione: Bidder conferences (PMBOK 8, pp. 19-20, 265).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Irene is preparing a large infrastructure project at West Core. Teams propose conflicting approaches for acquiring materials and services, delaying procurement. She must align contract types and supplier selection methods. What should she do?

opzioni.A: Develop the bid documents.
opzioni.B: Perform a make-or-buy analysis.
opzioni.C: Develop the statement of work.
opzioni.D: Develop the sourcing strategy plan.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. They don't define the approach.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Decides whether to buy.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Defines the work, not the approach.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. It documents sourcing decisions and the source selection approach.

domande.spiegazione: Sourcing strategy plan (PMBOK 8, pp. 20, 141).

domande.domanda: Ricky is planning manufacturing at Trade Corp. A critical component can be produced internally or by a specialist supplier. Stakeholders want to start quickly and budget is limited. What will he do next?

opzioni.A: Develop the procurement management plan.
opzioni.B: Conduct a cost-benefit analysis.
opzioni.C: Perform a make-or-buy analysis.
opzioni.D: Issue a request for proposal.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The process for procurement, not the decision.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Good, but make-or-buy is the specific decision tool.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Make-or-buy analyzes requirements against internal production or purchase.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Only after deciding to buy.

domande.spiegazione: Make-or-buy analysis (PMBOK 8, pp. 19-20, 180).

domande.domanda: Aiden manages a facilities upgrade at CM Holdings. He needs standard electrical components with clear specs; several suppliers offer different prices, causing confusion. What should he do?

opzioni.A: Conduct a bidder conference.
opzioni.B: Issue a request for proposal.
opzioni.C: Issue a request for information.
opzioni.D: Issue a request for quote.

domande.hint: Standard product, price is the deciding factor.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Specs are already clear.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. RFP is for complex solutions.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. RFI gathers information.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. RFQ is used when price is the main factor and the solution is readily available.

domande.spiegazione: RFQ (PMBOK 8, pp. 20, 248).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Rina is executing a warehouse automation project at Grid Line. Several modifications have been requested and there's confusion about what to implement and in what sequence. What will she do next?

opzioni.A: Review the scope statement.
opzioni.B: Review the change log.
opzioni.C: Review the issue log.
opzioni.D: Review the risk register.

domande.hint: Where are change requests and their status tracked?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. May not yet reflect approved changes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. The change log records changes and their status.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The issue log tracks problems that occurred, not requested changes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Future risks, not requested changes.

domande.spiegazione: Manage Project Execution; change log (PMBOK 8, pp. 22, 116).

domande.domanda: During execution of a production system upgrade at Ironworks, the team delivers outputs, implements approved changes and tracks performance. A stakeholder questions the consistency and reliability of outputs. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Reassess the scope and quality plans.
opzioni.B: Ensure deliverables are produced according to the scope baseline.
opzioni.C: Raise the concerns with the steering committee.
opzioni.D: Complete a full analysis of the quality risks.

domande.hint: Execution means delivering per the plan and baseline.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Reviews the processes, not the outputs.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Manage Project Execution ensures deliverables meet scope requirements.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Avoid escalating what the PM can handle within execution.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Slower and less direct.

domande.spiegazione: Manage Project Execution (PMBOK 8, pp. 22-23).

domande.domanda: Midway through execution at CD Solutions, a security officer reports unauthorized access to sensitive project data, which could affect deliverables. What should the PM do first?

opzioni.A: Note it in the issue log.
opzioni.B: Brainstorm ways to handle the breach with the team.
opzioni.C: Escalate to senior management.
opzioni.D: Record it in the risk register.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Occurred problems are issues, documented in the issue log before further action.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Right, but only after logging the issue so it can be tracked and managed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Avoid escalation unless outside your authority.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The breach has already happened: it's an issue, not a future risk.

domande.spiegazione: Issue log (PMBOK 8, pp. 22-23, 123).
domande.nota: Option D reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Omar manages pharmaceutical packaging at NCL. Inspections repeatedly find defects from inconsistent procedures across shifts. He wants to address the underlying cause. What should he do?

opzioni.A: Update the team's work instructions.
opzioni.B: Implement check sheets.
opzioni.C: Assign a quality lead.
opzioni.D: Apply process analysis and improvement.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Good, but without analysis it may miss the cause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Tally sheets count defects, not causes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Adds resources without addressing the cause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Analyzes and improves the process at the root.

domande.spiegazione: Manage Quality Assurance; process improvement (PMBOK 8, pp. 23, 188).

domande.domanda: At Forgeline Industries, teams follow procedures and standards inconsistently. Leadership wants to identify process gaps and improve performance. What's the most appropriate action?

opzioni.A: Increase inspections of completed deliverables.
opzioni.B: Rebaseline the project.
opzioni.C: Conduct additional testing.
opzioni.D: Perform audits to identify improvement areas.

domande.hint: Audits for processes, control for products.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Finds defects, not process gaps.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Doesn't address the cause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Tests products, not processes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Quality audits examine whether processes are followed and where to improve.

domande.spiegazione: Manage Quality Assurance (PMBOK 8, pp. 23-24).

domande.domanda: A team is missing deadlines due to inconsistent task execution: juniors do unnecessary work, seniors report inefficiencies and defects. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Ask the team to swarm around the issue.
opzioni.B: Implement a general training program.
opzioni.C: Work with the team to create checklists.
opzioni.D: Reassign tasks to more experienced members.

domande.hint: Standardize how the work is done, with the team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Lacks a structured approach.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Too generic.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Checklists from lessons learned standardize work collaboratively.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Doesn't fix the cause.

domande.spiegazione: Checklists (PMBOK 8, pp. 23-24, 151).

domande.domanda: During a banking platform upgrade at Southland Financial, developers and compliance officers clash over security requirements. You facilitate a session and find a solution. What will you do with this new information?

opzioni.A: Update the risk register.
opzioni.B: Document it in the lessons learned register.
opzioni.C: Archive it into OPAs at project closure.
opzioni.D: Develop a knowledge management plan.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. A conflict already resolved isn't a future uncertainty for the risk register.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Records knowledge gained to improve future performance.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Archiving into OPAs happens at closure; capture the lesson now.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. A process, not where to record.

domande.spiegazione: Manage Project Knowledge (PMBOK 8, pp. 24-26, 123).

domande.domanda: After a critical migration phase at VLA, discrepancies between expected and actual results cause rework and missed deadlines. What should you do next?

opzioni.A: Conduct an after action review (AAR) with the team.
opzioni.B: Conduct a risk workshop.
opzioni.C: Conduct a SWOT analysis.
opzioni.D: Adjust the schedule and resource assignments.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. An AAR analyzes what happened, why and how to improve.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The discrepancies already happened; a risk workshop looks at future events.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. For identifying risks.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Adjusting the plan before knowing the root cause may repeat the problem.

domande.spiegazione: After action reviews (PMBOK 8, pp. 24-26, 145).

domande.domanda: James is managing a commercial build at Evercrest. Reviewing cost and schedule data, he sees the project going off track; stakeholders want an update. What should he do first?

opzioni.A: Implement corrective actions.
opzioni.B: Update the project management plan.
opzioni.C: Analyze the performance data and turn it into work performance information.
opzioni.D: Escalate to the PM team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Corrective actions come after the data has been analyzed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Last, after change control.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Analyze data first to produce information for decisions and reports.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Avoid escalation: analyze and handle it as PM first.

domande.spiegazione: Monitor and Control Project Performance (PMBOK 8, pp. 26-27).

domande.domanda: A team repeatedly submits deliverables late for internal quality checks despite clear expectations. The PM wants to prevent recurrence. What should they do?

opzioni.A: Raise a change request.
opzioni.B: Perform an Ishikawa analysis.
opzioni.C: Review the quality management plan.
opzioni.D: Initiate an internal audit.

domande.hint: Prevent recurrence = find the root cause.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. A change request fixes affected items but doesn't prevent recurrence.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. A cause-and-effect diagram identifies the root cause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Process review without knowing the cause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. An audit reviews processes but doesn't target the specific root cause.

domande.spiegazione: Cause-and-effect diagram (PMBOK 8, pp. 27, 150).

domande.domanda: After baselines are approved on a highway expansion at Granite Link, a stakeholder proposes a design change affecting cost and schedule. The team wants to implement it immediately. How should Leah handle this?

opzioni.A: Submit a formal change request and assess its impacts.
opzioni.B: Review the benefits and proceed.
opzioni.C: Defer the change until more performance data is available.
opzioni.D: Update the plans and communicate to stakeholders.

domande.hint: Baseline in place → formal change control.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Changes to baselines go through a formal process with impact assessment.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Proceeding without approval bypasses change control on baselined items.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Deferring isn't justified: the impact can be assessed now.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Plans are updated only after the change is approved.

domande.spiegazione: Assess and Implement Changes (PMBOK 8, pp. 28-29).

domande.domanda: At EI Solutions several change requests arrive at once: a developer implements his change immediately while a business user holds impact meetings for hers. You're struggling to keep track. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Review the change management plan with the team.
opzioni.B: Get a recommendation from the CCB.
opzioni.C: Review and update the change log.
opzioni.D: Approve the most critical changes immediately.

domande.hint: Everyone is following a different process.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Aligns everyone on the change process.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The CCB decides on changes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Doesn't fix inconsistent handling.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Bypasses the process.

domande.spiegazione: Change management plan (PMBOK 8, pp. 28-29, 116).

domande.domanda: On a power grid project at Grid Core, a critical update must be implemented immediately to prevent failure. The team is divided and time is limited. What should Marina do?

opzioni.A: Facilitate group decision making.
opzioni.B: Apply majority voting.
opzioni.C: Use multi-criteria decision analysis.
opzioni.D: Use autocratic decision making.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Group decision making takes too long when time is critical.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Voting still takes time and may not settle a divided team quickly.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Too time-consuming.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Appropriate when time is critical and a quick decision is needed.

domande.spiegazione: Autocratic decision making (PMBOK 8, pp. 29, 163).

domande.domanda: Olivia manages a predictive highway expansion at WIC nearing completion. Stakeholders push to release resources quickly; she wants proper administrative closure. What should she NOT do next?

opzioni.A: Confirm all deliverables are complete, accepted and closure criteria met.
opzioni.B: Verify that all costs have been charged to the project.
opzioni.C: Reassign or release project personnel.
opzioni.D: Ensure all documents are updated and issues resolved.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (She would do it) A closure step.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. (She would do it) A closure step.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. (NOT now) Release resources only after all closure activities and exit criteria are confirmed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. (She would do it) A closure step.

domande.spiegazione: Close Project or Phase (PMBOK 8, pp. 31-33).

domande.domanda: At North Bridge Utilities, a project component was handed over to operations, but team members are still being pulled back to support issues. The PM wants to confirm which activities and items were completed at handover. What will they do next?

opzioni.A: Review the procurement agreements and OPA updates.
opzioni.B: Review the quality report and lessons learned register.
opzioni.C: Review the final report and the scope management plan.
opzioni.D: Review the final report and the OPA updates.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Procurement agreements don't show handover activities.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. About defects and lessons, not handover.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The scope management plan is a process document.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. The final report, updated documents and OPA updates confirm closure and handover.

domande.spiegazione: Close Project or Phase (PMBOK 8, pp. 31-33, 121).
domande.nota: The instructor considers C and D close.

domande.domanda: Preparing a commercial building project at SBC, before defining detailed requirements, leadership wants a consistent approach so only value-adding work is performed. What's the next step?

opzioni.A: Begin creating the WBS.
opzioni.B: Develop the scope management plan.
opzioni.C: Collect detailed requirements from stakeholders.
opzioni.D: Validate scope with stakeholders.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Doing it, not defining how.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Defines how scope is managed and eliminates non-value-adding work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Comes after defining the approach.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Validation happens at the end, when deliverables are accepted.

domande.spiegazione: Plan Scope Management (PMBOK 8, p. 40).

domande.domanda: A mobile app is being initiated at Crestview Digital. Stakeholders have differing expectations on features. You're asked how the team will gather requirements to ensure value. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Develop a requirements traceability matrix.
opzioni.B: Conduct focus groups and benchmarking to collect and compare stakeholder requirements.
opzioni.C: Create a scope baseline.
opzioni.D: Perform quality audits on the requirements.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Traces requirements once gathered.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Elicitation techniques that reconcile differing expectations.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Requires approved requirements first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Audits processes.

domande.spiegazione: Elicit and Analyze Requirements (PMBOK 8, pp. 40-41).

domande.domanda: Two parallel streams at NT Industries are merged: one iterative, one with detailed planning. There's confusion about the varied requirements and how they'll be delivered as scope. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Create a requirements traceability matrix.
opzioni.B: Integrate all requirements into a single product backlog.
opzioni.C: Develop a new WBS.
opzioni.D: Update the requirements management plan.

domande.hint: Link requirements from multiple sources to scope.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. The RTM tracks requirements from multiple sources to deliverables, tests and sign-off.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Doesn't fit the predictive stream.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Doesn't trace requirement sources.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. A process, not traceability.

domande.domanda: You're working with your team on requirements defining the organization's overall goals and intended outcomes for a new initiative, ensuring alignment with long-term objectives. What type of requirements are these?

opzioni.A: Solution requirements.
opzioni.B: Stakeholder requirements.
opzioni.C: Business requirements.
opzioni.D: Transition requirements.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Describe product features.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Needs of stakeholders.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Strategic objectives and high-level organizational needs.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Training and moving to future state.

domande.spiegazione: Business requirements (PMBOK 8, pp. 40-41, 130).

domande.domanda: On a wearable device at Fitness Plus, users report inconsistent experiences but the root cause is unclear. The team has competing ideas; stakeholders want a solution based on real user needs. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Use an affinity diagram.
opzioni.B: Use Kano analysis.
opzioni.C: Use design thinking with the team.
opzioni.D: Use Pareto analysis.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Groups ideas.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Classifies features, doesn't find causes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Design thinking (double diamond) understands users and iterates with prototypes and feedback.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. 80/20, not user needs.

domande.spiegazione: Design thinking (PMBOK 8, pp. 40-41, 168).

domande.domanda: At VDS, conflicting stakeholder input makes prioritization hard; meetings are dominated by the highest-paid, loudest voices, leading to missed requirements. Time is short. How do you handle this?

opzioni.A: Facilitate an open brainstorming session.
opzioni.B: Conduct individual interviews.
opzioni.C: Lead a focus group.
opzioni.D: Use the nominal group technique.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Still dominated by loud voices.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Too time-consuming.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Still open to domination.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Structured, anonymous ideas and voting neutralize dominant voices.

domande.spiegazione: Nominal group technique (PMBOK 8, pp. 40-41, 184).

domande.domanda: Jane is gathering requirements for a customer portal at BLS. The team works well but has generated only a handful of ideas. The sponsor wants to speed up. What should she do?

opzioni.A: Conduct interviews.
opzioni.B: Use brainstorming.
opzioni.C: Use an affinity diagram.
opzioni.D: Use the nominal group technique.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Too slow.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Generates many ideas quickly in a group.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Groups ideas.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Slower; for dominant voices.

domande.spiegazione: Brainstorming (PMBOK 8, pp. 41, 149).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Sam manages features for a mobile banking app. Only one feature fits the next sprint. Which maximizes value using cost of delay divided by duration (CD3)?

opzioni.A: Feature A: $12,000/week value, 4 weeks.
opzioni.B: Feature B: $16,000/week value, 2 weeks.
opzioni.C: Feature C: $10,000/week value, 3 weeks.
opzioni.D: Feature D: $14,000/week value, 5 weeks.

domande.hint: Value per week divided by duration: pick the highest.

spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. 16,000/2 = 8,000: the highest.

domande.spiegazione: Prioritization: MoSCoW, 100-point, cost of delay, Kano (PMBOK 8, pp. 41, 187).
domande.nota: Feature labels reconstructed. The instructor says 'duration divided by value' but calculates value/duration.

domande.domanda: A project at HR Group must improve customer satisfaction quickly. The team struggles to find improvements; the sponsor wants proven ideas from similar projects or organizations. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Use benchmarking.
opzioni.B: Use analogous estimating.
opzioni.C: Conduct focus groups.
opzioni.D: Review the product with the senior developer.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Identifies good practices from comparable organizations.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. A decoy: an estimating technique.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Doesn't give external proven ideas.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Limited view.

domande.spiegazione: Benchmarking (PMBOK 8, pp. 41, 149).

domande.domanda: Jonah manages product development at RLM. The team needs to organize all deliverables and decompose the work into manageable components. What should he do next?

opzioni.A: Organize the deliverables into a work breakdown structure.
opzioni.B: Validate deliverables with stakeholders.
opzioni.C: Prioritize features in the backlog.
opzioni.D: Capture requirements as user stories.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. The WBS decomposes total scope into manageable work packages.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Validation happens at the end, when deliverables are accepted.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Prioritizes, doesn't decompose.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Agile decomposition, but WBS is the direct answer.

domande.spiegazione: Define Scope (PMBOK 8, pp. 41-42).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed: the instructor reads the WBS last but answers A.

domande.domanda: Nate manages a predictive facility upgrade. He has turned requirements into scope and wants to add more detail to the work packages for clarity. What will he do next?

opzioni.A: Create a responsibility assignment matrix.
opzioni.B: Perform quality control on the work packages.
opzioni.C: Develop a requirements traceability matrix.
opzioni.D: Create the WBS dictionary.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Roles, not work package detail.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Quality control checks deliverables; it doesn't add detail to work packages.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Traces requirements.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Adds descriptions, resources, cost and duration to each work package.

domande.spiegazione: Develop Scope Structure (PMBOK 8, p. 42).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Diane manages pharmaceutical development at Redwood Biologics. Monitoring reveals inconsistent deliverable quality; stakeholders want more information to support improvements. What should she produce?

opzioni.A: Work performance data.
opzioni.B: The scope baseline.
opzioni.C: Change requests in the change log.
opzioni.D: A quality report.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Raw data isn't analyzed: stakeholders need findings and recommendations.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The scope baseline doesn't contain quality issues.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Change requests concern changes, not quality findings.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Documents quality issues, findings and corrective action recommendations.

domande.spiegazione: Quality reports (PMBOK 8, pp. 42, 129-130).

domande.domanda: At Bel, completed bridge components passed internal quality checks. The client is reviewing them for formal approval. What should Marcus obtain as input?

opzioni.A: Work performance reports.
opzioni.B: Validated deliverables.
opzioni.C: Verified deliverables.
opzioni.D: Change requests.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Less specific: the client needs evidence that deliverables passed quality checks.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. That's the output after acceptance.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Verified deliverables are the input to Validate Scope.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Change requests address gaps; they aren't the input for acceptance.

domande.spiegazione: Validate Scope (PMBOK 8, pp. 44, 143).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Priya takes over a nationwide fiber project. Leadership is concerned about how schedule decisions are made and controlled and wants clear guidance for coordinating schedule activities. What should she do next?

opzioni.A: Develop the project schedule.
opzioni.B: Establish a schedule baseline.
opzioni.C: Develop a resource management plan.
opzioni.D: Create a schedule management plan.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The schedule, not the process.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. A baseline, not the process.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The resource management plan concerns resources, not schedule governance.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Defines policies and procedures for managing the schedule.

domande.spiegazione: Plan Schedule Management (PMBOK 8, pp. 49, 139).

domande.domanda: At OP Security, business leaders want to see your plan for managing the schedule. What do you need to know before creating the schedule management plan?

opzioni.A: The sequence of deliverables.
opzioni.B: Activity estimates from the team.
opzioni.C: The development approach.
opzioni.D: Methods for schedule compression.

domande.hint: Agile and predictive schedules are managed differently.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Needed for the schedule.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Needed for the schedule.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Determines how the schedule is managed (roadmap/sprints vs baselined schedule).
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Part of the plan, not a prerequisite.

domande.spiegazione: Plan Schedule Management (PMBOK 8, pp. 49, 139).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Noah upgrades core banking at Granite Peak. After iterations on sequences, durations and resources, stakeholders approve the final schedule. What next?

opzioni.A: Proceed with project delivery.
opzioni.B: Baseline the schedule.
opzioni.C: Review the impact on resources.
opzioni.D: Add the schedule to the status report.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Baseline the approved schedule first, so performance can be measured against it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. The schedule baseline is the output after approval.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Resources were already analyzed during the iterations.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Status reporting happens during execution, later.

domande.spiegazione: Develop Schedule (PMBOK 8, pp. 49, 138).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: At FI Group, several critical activities need the same specialized engineer at overlapping times, creating unrealistic workload. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Apply resource leveling.
opzioni.B: Apply fast tracking.
opzioni.C: Raise a risk.
opzioni.D: Apply resource smoothing.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Adjusts the schedule so resources aren't over-allocated.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Fast tracking overlaps activities, making the over-allocation worse.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The over-allocation already exists in the schedule: fix it now.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Smoothing only moves activities within float and may not remove the conflict.

domande.spiegazione: Resource leveling (PMBOK 8, pp. 50, 193).

domande.domanda: At Nexora Labs, near-term requirements are clear but later work is uncertain. The sponsor pressures to start quickly. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Estimate all durations immediately.
opzioni.B: Develop the full schedule for approval.
opzioni.C: Use rolling wave planning.
opzioni.D: Raise the uncertainty as a risk.

domande.hint: Near term detailed, far term high-level.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not possible for uncertain work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. A full detailed schedule isn't possible while later work is uncertain.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Plans near-term in detail, future at high level.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Logging a risk doesn't let the team start planning and working.

domande.spiegazione: Rolling wave planning (PMBOK 8, pp. 49-50, 196).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: At AC Goods, packaging design must finish before mass production, labeling can start once drafts are approved, and inspection must wait 2 days after production. What should Rayna do?

opzioni.A: Apply schedule crashing.
opzioni.B: Apply leads and lags.
opzioni.C: Update duration estimates.
opzioni.D: Apply fast tracking.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Crashing adds resources to shorten duration; the issue is timing between activities.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Adjusts successor timing: early starts (leads) or waits (lags).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Durations aren't the issue; dependencies and waiting times are.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Fast tracking overlaps sequential activities; here specific waits and early starts are needed.

domande.spiegazione: Leads and lags (PMBOK 8, pp. 50, 179-180).

domande.domanda: Elena monitors a warehouse automation project at SLG. She sees schedule differences that may require action. What will she use to decide?

opzioni.A: Basis of estimates.
opzioni.B: Work performance data.
opzioni.C: Work performance information.
opzioni.D: Work performance reports.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Assumptions behind estimates.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Raw data alone isn't compared to the plan, so it can't support decisions.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Analyzed data compared to the plan.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Reports package information for stakeholders; decisions use the information itself.

domande.spiegazione: Monitor and Control Schedule (PMBOK 8, pp. 53, 144).

domande.domanda: At ZP Logistics, many parallel activities compete for limited scheduling options. Different sequencing scenarios are proposed and the team can't agree. How should Aaron proceed?

opzioni.A: Apply the branch and bound technique.
opzioni.B: Add buffers to estimates.
opzioni.C: Resequence by team consensus.
opzioni.D: Fast-track.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Explores and prunes options to find the optimal schedule.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Buffers add time but don't pick the best sequence.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Consensus may not reach the optimal sequence among many options.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Compression doesn't resolve which scenario is best.

domande.spiegazione: Branch and bound (PMBOK 8, pp. 53-54, 150).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Lloyd's hospital project at CPB must finish earlier with no budget increase. Several activities could overlap, with some risk. Which approach?

opzioni.A: Resequence tasks.
opzioni.B: Adjust estimates.
opzioni.C: Schedule crashing.
opzioni.D: Fast tracking.

domande.hint: No extra money, activities can overlap.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Resequencing isn't a compression technique.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Changing estimates doesn't shorten the work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Crashing adds cost, but the budget can't increase.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Overlaps activities without extra cost.

domande.spiegazione: Schedule compression (PMBOK 8, pp. 54, 196-197).

domande.domanda: A new investment platform project is starting at KC Holdings. In early planning, the team asks how financial activities will be handled, including acceptable estimate ranges and triggers for escalation. What will the project manager show them?

opzioni.A: The basis of estimates.
opzioni.B: The configuration management plan.
opzioni.C: The financial management plan.
opzioni.D: The risk management plan with its triggers.

domande.hint: A process for managing something = its management plan.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. It explains how estimates were made, but not how finances are managed or escalated.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. It covers version control of project artifacts.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. It defines how revenues and expenses are estimated, budgeted, managed and controlled, including thresholds.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Triggers are mentioned, but the question is about finances, not risk.

domande.spiegazione: Plan Financial Management; the financial management plan is a component of the project management plan (PMBOK 8, pp. 62, 121-122).

domande.domanda: Maya at Orion Axis Consulting manages a direct air capture project to reduce CO2, with strong interest from large organizations that would benefit. As she finalizes the plan to manage project finances, what should she do next?

opzioni.A: Note the NGOs in the funding strategy.
opzioni.B: Send the financial management plan to the sponsor for approval.
opzioni.C: Review the project charter for the high-level cost.
opzioni.D: Engage business experts on the costs involved.

domande.hint: Where will the money come from?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. The funding strategy is an output of Plan Financial Management: interested organizations are funding sources.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Good, but after completing the plan with the funding strategy.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The charter belongs to initiation; you're past that stage.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Estimation is already done if you're finalizing the plan.

domande.spiegazione: Funding strategy (PMBOK 8, pp. 62-63, 122-123).

domande.domanda: At HN Manufacturing, Diego is early in a new project and needs a quick estimate for initial planning. Detailed information is limited, but a senior team member worked on a similar project. What should Diego do next?

opzioni.A: Use bottom-up estimating.
opzioni.B: Use three-point estimating.
opzioni.C: Use parametric estimating.
opzioni.D: Use analogous estimating.

domande.hint: Similar past project + need for speed.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Needs detailed work packages, which aren't available yet.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Needs optimistic, most likely and pessimistic values for each activity.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Needs reliable unit rates (e.g. cost per meter).
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Uses historical data from similar projects: fast, though less accurate.

domande.spiegazione: Analogous estimating (PMBOK 8, pp. 62-63, 146).

domande.domanda: Jordan oversees a consumer electronics project at ADH. After release, several units are returned for defects requiring repairs and replacements, hurting profitability. How should these quality-related costs be categorized?

opzioni.A: Conformance costs.
opzioni.B: Prevention costs.
opzioni.C: Appraisal costs.
opzioni.D: Failure costs.

domande.hint: The defect has already reached the customer.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Conformance costs are spent to avoid failures (prevention and appraisal).
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Prevention means training, better processes, design: before defects occur.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Appraisal means testing and inspection.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Failure costs (external, after delivery) cover rework, repairs and returns: the costliest kind.

domande.spiegazione: Cost of quality (PMBOK 8, pp. 63, 158-159).
domande.nota: Answer letter inferred: the instructor reads failure costs last and names it as the answer.

domande.domanda: Lena is estimating costs for a bridge at Arcspan Engineering. The team identifies potential soil instability that may require extra foundation work. The sponsor wants this handled without inflating the budget unnecessarily. What should Lena do?

opzioni.A: Increase all activity cost estimates by 15%.
opzioni.B: Add a management reserve.
opzioni.C: Add a contingency reserve.
opzioni.D: Update the cost baseline to include the extra foundation work.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Padding every estimate inflates the whole budget.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Management reserve covers unforeseen work (unknown unknowns).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Contingency reserve is set aside for identified risks and their responses.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The work may never be needed: it's still a risk.

domande.spiegazione: Contingency reserve (PMBOK 8, pp. 63, 266).

domande.domanda: Marcus at SBI is finalizing the budget. Cost estimates exist for individual activities, and he needs a single approved version of the budget to track future performance. What should he do first?

opzioni.A: Perform cost aggregation.
opzioni.B: Update the financial management plan.
opzioni.C: Finalize the cost baseline.
opzioni.D: Review the business case for the initial cost.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Rolls estimates up by work package and control account into the total budget.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. It's the process, not the budget.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Correct afterwards: the baseline comes after aggregation.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. You're past the business case stage.

domande.spiegazione: Develop Budget; cost aggregation (PMBOK 8, pp. 64, 158).

domande.domanda: Victor manages a solar farm at HEC. Cost estimates for work packages are done, but senior leaders question their accuracy and worry about delivery. What will Victor do next?

opzioni.A: Aggregate the estimates.
opzioni.B: Show them the basis of estimates.
opzioni.C: Show them the financial management plan.
opzioni.D: Develop more detailed estimates with the team.

domande.hint: Leaders doubt how the estimates were produced.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Shows the total, not how estimates were made.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Documents assumptions, methods, constraints and ranges behind the estimates.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. It's the overall finance process.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Estimates are already complete.

domande.spiegazione: Develop Budget; basis of estimates (PMBOK 8, pp. 64, 115).

domande.domanda: Nina oversees a metro expansion at AU Transit. She reviews budgeted work, completed work and actual spending to evaluate performance trends and decide where corrective action is needed. What is she performing?

opzioni.A: Earned value analysis.
opzioni.B: Variance analysis.
opzioni.C: An update of the cost baseline.
opzioni.D: A review of the work performance report.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Compares schedule and cost performance (PV, EV, AC) to the baseline.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Related, but EVA is the specific term for PV/EV/AC.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. She's only reviewing, not changing baselines.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Reports are for stakeholders.

domande.spiegazione: Monitor and Control Finances; earned value analysis (PMBOK 8, pp. 64-65, 169).
domande.nota: The instructor admits B was close.

domande.domanda: Kevin at Transit Flow Logistics is identifying stakeholders and analyzing their interests, influence and potential impact. What will he NOT do while identifying stakeholders?

opzioni.A: Develop strategies to engage stakeholders based on their expectations.
opzioni.B: Find the individuals, groups or organizations that think they're impacted.
opzioni.C: Document stakeholder information in the stakeholder register.
opzioni.D: Analyze stakeholder interests, influence and potential impact.

domande.hint: Identify and analyze first, plan engagement later.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. (NOT now) Engagement strategies belong to Plan Stakeholder Engagement.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. (He would do it) Even those who only think they're impacted are stakeholders.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (He would do it) The register is the output.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. (He would do it) Part of identifying stakeholders.

domande.spiegazione: Identify Stakeholders (PMBOK 8, p. 71).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Caleb is launching a coastal bridge repair at HL Infrastructure. Mid kickoff, a local fishermen's association complains it wasn't consulted, delaying permits. What should he do first?

opzioni.A: Develop the stakeholder engagement plan.
opzioni.B: Update the communications management plan.
opzioni.C: Add the association to the stakeholder register.
opzioni.D: Conduct stakeholder analysis with the association.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The plan comes after registering and analyzing the stakeholder.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Updating the communications plan comes later.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. First get them on the radar.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Right after registering them, not first.

domande.spiegazione: Stakeholder register (PMBOK 8, pp. 71, 141-142).

domande.domanda: Clara leads a metro rail upgrade at ATU. Design changes drew mixed reactions from regulators, businesses and commuters. With many opinions, she wants to focus on the right stakeholders. What should she do next?

opzioni.A: Add them to the stakeholder register.
opzioni.B: Perform stakeholder mapping.
opzioni.C: Organize a formal requirements workshop.
opzioni.D: Create a stakeholder requirements document.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Records them but doesn't prioritize.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Mapping (e.g. influence/impact) categorizes stakeholders to focus engagement.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Gathers requirements, doesn't prioritize stakeholders.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Documents needs, doesn't prioritize.

domande.spiegazione: Stakeholder mapping (PMBOK 8, pp. 71, 200).

domande.domanda: Planning a city redevelopment at New Horizon, you review how stakeholders are responding, determine the involvement needed and identify gaps to guide strategies. What will you use to represent this?

opzioni.A: The risk register listing engagement gaps.
opzioni.B: The communications management plan.
opzioni.C: The stakeholder engagement assessment matrix.
opzioni.D: The stakeholder register with classifications.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not the right tool for engagement levels.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Explains how to communicate, not gaps.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Compares current and desired levels (unaware, resistant, neutral, supportive, leading).
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Classifies but doesn't show gaps.

domande.spiegazione: Stakeholder engagement assessment matrix (PMBOK 8, pp. 71-72, 200).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Nadia is starting the next phase of a hospital expansion. Stakeholders complain they're not involved; some areas weren't engaged for the last release, leaving users dissatisfied. What will she do next?

opzioni.A: Identify stakeholders who can be more involved.
opzioni.B: Create and update the stakeholder register.
opzioni.C: Add and update stakeholder engagement activities.
opzioni.D: Create the communications management plan.

domande.hint: How, when and by whom information is shared.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. You don't choose stakeholders: they're impacted.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Past that stage.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Close, but the process for reaching them is missing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Defines how, when and by whom information is distributed, aligned with engagement.

domande.spiegazione: Plan Communications Management (PMBOK 8, pp. 72-73, 117-118).

domande.domanda: Isabel plans a digital banking rollout at Zenith Trust Bank. Receiving teams need product info and training, but they avoid updates and give minimal feedback. What should she do?

opzioni.A: Schedule more frequent status meetings.
opzioni.B: Update the stakeholder engagement plan.
opzioni.C: Conduct a communication styles assessment.
opzioni.D: Send formal reports to the receiving teams.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. More of the same may not help.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Update with what? Analyze first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Evaluates preferred methods, formats and content; used with unsupportive stakeholders.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. More of the same.

domande.spiegazione: Communication styles assessment (PMBOK 8, pp. 73, 155).

domande.domanda: You manage an ERP project with stakeholders in the US, India and Germany. Communication styles differ, requirements are missed and misunderstandings are frequent. What should you do next?

opzioni.A: Establish ground rules for meetings.
opzioni.B: Apply cultural awareness to adjust engagement approaches.
opzioni.C: Use observation and conversation.
opzioni.D: Increase status report frequency.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Helps, but after understanding cultural differences.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Cultural differences are the root cause: adapt engagement accordingly.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Hard across countries; cultural awareness first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. More info doesn't fix misunderstandings.

domande.spiegazione: Manage Stakeholder Engagement (PMBOK 8, p. 74).

domande.domanda: On the Helios Energy rollout, stakeholders say they aren't getting the latest information even though you send the project report every week. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Use a pull communication approach.
opzioni.B: Arrange a stakeholder meeting.
opzioni.C: Update the stakeholder register with the information they need.
opzioni.D: Send the report more frequently.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Put information in a portal or radiator they can access anytime.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. One meeting doesn't fix the cause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The register holds stakeholder data, not project information.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. More push isn't the solution.

domande.spiegazione: Manage Communications: push and pull (PMBOK 8, p. 75).
domande.nota: Option D not read in the source: written as a plausible distractor.

domande.domanda: Javier oversees stakeholders on a rail expansion at Stanton Group. Participation keeps declining and key decisions aren't being made, soon affecting delivery. What next?

opzioni.A: Hold a root cause analysis workshop with stakeholders.
opzioni.B: Raise the issue with each stakeholder's manager.
opzioni.C: Hold an after action review.
opzioni.D: Update the stakeholder engagement plan.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Identifies why engagement is declining.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Hands off your job.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. An AAR follows completed work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Update with what? Analyze first.

domande.spiegazione: Monitor Stakeholder Engagement; RCA (PMBOK 8, pp. 73, 76, 196).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: On the Apex Financial Systems upgrade, a confidential update with sensitive budget and staffing data was accidentally sent to a wider group than intended. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Update the communications management plan.
opzioni.B: Update the stakeholder engagement plan.
opzioni.C: Raise it in the issue log.
opzioni.D: Raise a change request on reporting deliverables.

domande.hint: It has happened, and it's sensitive.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Right, but after handling the issue.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. It's a communication problem.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Address what happened first: it's an issue.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Maybe later if baselined.

domande.spiegazione: Monitor Communications outputs (PMBOK 8, p. 77).

domande.domanda: Initiating a wind farm at Peak Energy, you see many mistakes and rework; team members blame each other. What should you do?
