spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Prototypes, demos, storyboards and mock-ups evolve requirements.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not about change.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Needs clear requirements first.

domande.spiegazione: Evolving and discovering requirements (PMBOK 7, p. 83).

domande.domanda: You're gathering requirements for a UI feature, the next priority, co-located with the receiving team. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Show the customer how the new UI will look.
opzioni.B: Communicate requirements to developers with a coherent logical flow.
opzioni.C: Elicit requirements into user stories with clear, verifiable, traceable acceptance criteria.
opzioni.D: Show the mock-up to developers and ask them to build it.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not enough to build.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Part of the 5 Cs, not elicitation.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Requirements should be clear, concise, verifiable, consistent, complete and traceable.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. A prototype may lack detail.

domande.spiegazione: Requirements elicitation (PMBOK 7, p. 83).

domande.domanda: An agile team created a scope statement and WBS but isn't sure how it fits sprints and user stories. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Assign activities and place them on a Gantt chart.
opzioni.B: Create a roadmap from the lowest WBS level.
opzioni.C: Group the work into themes of customer value (epics) and break them into user stories per sprint.
opzioni.D: Trace requirements with an RTM.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Traditional.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Roadmaps are at feature level.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Epics too big for a sprint, broken into stories.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not the question.

domande.spiegazione: Scope decomposition (PMBOK 7, p. 84).

domande.domanda: A team trialing agile is confused about how much work a story needs before the sprint review and how to know it's complete. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Refer to the story's acceptance criteria and the team's definition of done.
opzioni.B: Review the story with multiple users.
opzioni.C: Ask the PO to sign off.
opzioni.D: Ensure quality testing is passed.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Acceptance criteria and DoD describe completion.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Could be part of DoD.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Could be part of DoD.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Could be part of DoD.

domande.spiegazione: Completion of deliverables (PMBOK 7, p. 85).

domande.domanda: Planning the budget for an upcoming phase, the quality manager asks you to budget for appraisal costs. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Ensure enough for training.
opzioni.B: Ensure enough for a quality tester to verify deliverables against specifications.
opzioni.C: Ensure enough to create a quality assurance plan.
opzioni.D: Ensure enough for rework when defects are found.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Prevention.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Appraisal covers verification and audits.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Prevention (quality planning).
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Failure cost.

domande.spiegazione: Cost of quality (PMBOK 7, p. 89).

domande.domanda: Your agile project has multiple quality issues. Features are prioritized and broken into stories. What reduces the cost of quality issues the most?

opzioni.A: Test each story against acceptance criteria before release.
opzioni.B: Take defects out of the team's bonus.
opzioni.C: Test everything at the end.
opzioni.D: Involve a triad of developer, tester and customer during requirements and design.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Good, but later and costlier.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Harsh and disengaging.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Most costly.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Fixing at requirements/design is cheapest (20x build, 50x test, 150x production).

domande.spiegazione: Cost of change (PMBOK 7, p. 90).
domande.nota: The instructor finds A and D close.

domande.domanda: In an agile team, receiving executives want large reports every two weeks on tracking, cost and benefits. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Collect PV vs EV.
opzioni.B: Co-locate the team with the executives.
opzioni.C: Suggest a demo of features each sprint and a burndown of upcoming releases.
opzioni.D: Create the reports.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not agile-centric.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Possible, not best.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Agile demonstrates value delivered and uses information radiators.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Reports for their own sake.

domande.spiegazione: Measurement performance domain (PMBOK 7, p. 94).

domande.domanda: Released features aren't having the expected effect. You move to more leading KPIs. Which are leading indicators?

opzioni.A: Increase in customer usage after release.
opzioni.B: Stakeholders not engaged and lack of a risk management process.
opzioni.C: Velocity and cycle time.
opzioni.D: Schedule variance.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Lagging.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Leading indicators predict changes: no risk process, disengaged stakeholders, unclear success criteria.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Lagging.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Lagging.

domande.spiegazione: Leading indicators (PMBOK 7, p. 96).

domande.domanda: An agile team has grown in size and complexity; fewer stories are completed and the roadmap slips. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Limit work in progress and reduce cycle time with the team.
opzioni.B: Increase meetings.
opzioni.C: Ask for overtime.
opzioni.D: Put a pull system in place.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. WIP limits avoid multitasking and context switching.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Adds overhead.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Unsustainable.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Without WIP limits, more work gets pulled.

domande.spiegazione: What to measure, delivery (PMBOK 7, p. 99).

domande.domanda: The customer wants a reliable baseline to measure performance on an agile project. What will you show?

opzioni.A: Team velocity.
opzioni.B: Start and finish dates.
opzioni.C: Rate of features completed.
opzioni.D: Schedule and cost variance.

domande.hint: Fixed cost and time, variable scope.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Internal team measure.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not value.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Agile tracks features delivered with a stable team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Cost and time are fixed.

domande.spiegazione: Baseline performance (PMBOK 7, p. 100).

domande.domanda: The product owner and senior users gathered over 50 feature ideas, far too many for the time available. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Start with the smallest features.
opzioni.B: Ask for a shortened list.
opzioni.C: Workshop with a wider audience.
opzioni.D: Ask the product owner to prioritize by cost to benefit and deliver in priority order until time or money runs out.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Value first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Prioritize instead.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Messy; the PO decides.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. POs prioritize by business value (cost-benefit, ROI, NPV).

domande.spiegazione: Business value (PMBOK 7, p. 102).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Your new agile team has disagreements; the product is unclear; you can't pinpoint the problem. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Hold a workshop asking why they're unhappy.
opzioni.B: Have the team complete a Net Promoter Score with comments and ask for improvement ideas at the next retrospective.
opzioni.C: Raise it with their line managers.
opzioni.D: Have the team pair up.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. May become complaining.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. NPS/satisfaction measures plus retrospectives capture improvements.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Handle it yourself.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Possible later action.

domande.spiegazione: Measuring stakeholders (PMBOK 7, p. 103).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Supply chain disruptions put the project 3 weeks behind. The steering committee wants to know the final cost. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Use the current budget until it runs out.
opzioni.B: Use the burndown chart.
opzioni.C: Use regression analysis.
opzioni.D: Use the estimate at completion.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. No forecast.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Shows work, not cost.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. May work, but not best.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. EAC (e.g. BAC/CPI) forecasts the most likely final cost.

domande.spiegazione: Forecasts (PMBOK 7, p. 104).

domande.domanda: On an agile project, sponsor and executives require lengthy weekly reports, taking time from building the product. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Reuse most info weekly.
opzioni.B: Invite them to the sprint review and to the information radiator.
opzioni.C: Make them wait for steering meetings.
opzioni.D: Share the working schedule and budget.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Still waste.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Sprint reviews show work done; radiators let anyone pull information.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Less transparency.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Less live.

domande.spiegazione: Information radiators (PMBOK 7, p. 108).

domande.domanda: Your team planned upfront; work is hidden, they meet once a week and it's hard to track. You want more agile. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Daily written status updates.
opzioni.B: More working group meetings.
opzioni.C: Move work to a visible task board and hold a short daily meeting.
opzioni.D: Remove meetings and trust the team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Non-value-add.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Overhead.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Task boards plus a 15-minute daily stand-up.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Communication still needed.

domande.spiegazione: Visual controls, task boards (PMBOK 7, p. 109).

domande.domanda: On a hybrid project with a Kanban board, stakeholders keep adding scope and an executive raises an urgent feature. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Limit cards in ready/to-do and have the PO work with stakeholders, swapping the new item for an existing one.
opzioni.B: Match stories to velocity.
opzioni.C: Raise a change request.
opzioni.D: Review impact with the WBS dictionary.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. WIP limits and PO prioritization manage scope.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not the issue.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. It's addition, managed by prioritization.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. A distractor.

domande.spiegazione: Kanban board (PMBOK 7, p. 110).

domande.domanda: As PO, your success measure is features delivered. The team delivered a record number, but customers complain about bugs. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Ask the team to work harder on features and fixes.
opzioni.B: Add customer satisfaction and quality measures to the metrics.
opzioni.C: Add a 5-point slack card for technical debt.
opzioni.D: Remove customer feedback until features are done.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Unsustainable.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. What you measure influences behavior: balance it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Good, but doesn't fix the cause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Hides the problem.

domande.spiegazione: Measurement pitfalls, Hawthorne effect (PMBOK 7, p. 112).

domande.domanda: Many stakeholders ask your team for performance reports; much of their time goes into reports. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Ask stakeholders to stop interacting with the team.
opzioni.B: Spend budget automating reports.
opzioni.C: Work with the team and stakeholders to measure only what facilitates a decision, avoids an issue or improves performance.
opzioni.D: Invite stakeholders to sprint reviews.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Engagement still needed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Possible, but doesn't question what's measured.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Only measure what enables learning, decisions or improvement.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Good, but partial.

domande.spiegazione: Growing and improving (PMBOK 7, p. 114).

domande.domanda: Requirements are highly uncertain and a legislative change is coming with unknown impact. How do you deal with the uncertainty?

opzioni.A: Do additional planning.
opzioni.B: Hold more retrospectives.
opzioni.C: Create a risk assessment of all risks.
opzioni.D: Gather information, prepare for multiple outcomes and build team resilience.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Can't plan away uncertainty.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not for this.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Responses: gather information, multiple outcomes, set-based design, resilience.

domande.spiegazione: General uncertainty (PMBOK 7, p. 118).

domande.domanda: With a vendor, there's significant ambiguity: many options and outcomes with varying impact. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Use experiments, prototypes and progressive elaboration.
opzioni.B: Ask for more reports.
opzioni.C: Add all options to scope.
opzioni.D: Work closely with senior users.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Progressive elaboration, experiments and prototypes resolve ambiguity.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Doesn't resolve.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Still ambiguous.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Good practice, not direct.

domande.spiegazione: Ambiguity (PMBOK 7, p. 120).

domande.domanda: You must improve 17-year-old, heavily modified software integrated with many systems and can't decide which features to deliver first. How do you deal with the complexity?

opzioni.A: Prioritize features by cost/benefit.
opzioni.B: Simulate decoupling connected parts and reframe by brainstorming with diverse stakeholders.
opzioni.C: Give an incentive to whoever solves it.
opzioni.D: Make a business case for a third-party replacement.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Good practice, not complexity handling.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Systems-based decoupling/simulation and reframing with diverse views.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not a method.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. May increase complexity.

domande.spiegazione: Complexity (PMBOK 7, p. 121).

domande.domanda: Your project needs a rare programming skill in the hottest job market in decades; people leave often and the language evolves fast. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Rebuild in a common language.
opzioni.B: Have the whole team learn it.
opzioni.C: Use alternatives analysis and ensure a sufficient cost reserve.
opzioni.D: Raise a risk.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Drastic.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not feasible quickly.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Alternatives analysis and cost reserves address volatility.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Partial.

domande.spiegazione: Volatility (PMBOK 7, p. 122).

domande.domanda: Your team finds a serious data vulnerability (customer data exposed without password) in a feature partly made by a third-party vendor, whose relationship is owned by a functional manager. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Avoid the risk and wait for the vendor.
opzioni.B: Transfer it to a different vendor.
opzioni.C: Escalate the risk to the manager with authority to act.
opzioni.D: Accept the risk and move on.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Too passive for this severity.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Slow and not yours to decide.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Escalate when outside project scope or PM authority.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Too severe to accept.

domande.spiegazione: Threat responses (PMBOK 7, p. 123).

domande.domanda: A high-impact risk can't be transferred, avoided or escalated. The sponsor agrees to actively accept it. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Develop a contingency plan triggered if the event occurs.
opzioni.B: Shift ownership to a third party.
opzioni.C: Act to eliminate the threat.
opzioni.D: Reduce probability and impact.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Active acceptance includes a contingency plan.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Transfer.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Avoid.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Mitigate.

domande.spiegazione: Threat responses (PMBOK 7, p. 123).

domande.domanda: Building a customer database for engineering, you realize other teams could use it with little extra effort. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Escalate the opportunity.
opzioni.B: Exploit the opportunity.
opzioni.C: Enhance the opportunity.
opzioni.D: Accept the opportunity.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. For opportunities outside PM authority.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Exploit acts to ensure it occurs.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Only raises probability.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Does nothing.

domande.spiegazione: Opportunities (PMBOK 7, p. 125).

domande.domanda: As PO, a risk review uncovered several risks. The customer wants them mitigated ASAP. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Ask the team to do all responses ASAP.
opzioni.B: Ignore the risks initially.
opzioni.C: Assign responses to all stakeholders.
opzioni.D: Prioritize responses by comparing risk EMV with deliverables' ROI.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Ignores other priorities.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Risks may grow.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. May lack expertise.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. EMV vs ROI incorporates responses into normal prioritization.

domande.spiegazione: Risk-adjusted backlog (PMBOK 7, p. 126).

domande.domanda: Supply chains are disrupted and requirements are complex and intertwined. The sponsor wants risks managed before execution. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Move to execution and handle risks as they arise.
opzioni.B: Move to agile.
opzioni.C: Note the risks with controls and add a contingency reserve.
opzioni.D: Assign a management reserve.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Too late.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Doesn't remove risk.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Contingency reserve is for identified risks.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. For unknown events.

domande.spiegazione: Management and contingency reserves (PMBOK 7, p. 127).

domande.domanda: On an agile project delivering every few weeks, the waterfall-minded sponsor wants a regular risk review with many stakeholders. What will you suggest?

opzioni.A: No separate meeting needed.
opzioni.B: Daily stand-ups for blockers and fortnightly demos to catch dissatisfaction.
opzioni.C: Use the Kanban board.
opzioni.D: Hold the risk meeting with the core team only.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Partly true, but weak.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Stand-up blockers and demos surface threats and opportunities.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Excludes useful stakeholders.

domande.spiegazione: Risk review (PMBOK 7, p. 127).

domande.domanda: With no prescribed way of working, your PMO uses an expensive XP framework from a vendor, yet projects are still late, over budget and with low satisfaction. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Tailor the approach to the organization, environment and project needs.
opzioni.B: Switch to waterfall.
opzioni.C: Switch to Scrum.
opzioni.D: Tighten controls with a directive PMO.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Tailoring fits the approach to the context.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Still needs tailoring.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Popular isn't best.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not the cause.

domande.spiegazione: Tailoring overview (PMBOK 7, p. 132).

domande.domanda: Your PMO is tailoring a popular framework with branded templates during a company-wide transformation. You're asked to help finalize the process. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Gather feedback from functional areas.
opzioni.B: Pilot it in the PMO.
opzioni.C: Enable a process for tailoring by size and complexity and implement ongoing improvement.
opzioni.D: Form a working group of executives and PMs.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Select approach, tailor for organization and project, implement ongoing improvement.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Partial.

domande.spiegazione: The tailoring process (PMBOK 7, p. 137).

domande.domanda: As PMO manager after a transformation, you must select an initial development approach to tailor further. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Pick the framework with the best graphics for executives.
opzioni.B: Pick the most popular framework.
opzioni.C: Select multiple approaches as a baseline.
opzioni.D: Use a suitability filter to assess the most appropriate approach.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Looks, not fit.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Popular isn't fit.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Complex.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Suitability filters show predictive, hybrid or adaptive fit.

domande.spiegazione: Select initial development approach (PMBOK 7, p. 138).

domande.domanda: Moving to agile, your organization sets up a Value Delivery Office (VDO). Executives ask what it does. What will you tell them?

opzioni.A: It owns programs and value delivered.
opzioni.B: It coaches teams, builds adaptive skills and mentors sponsors and product owners.
opzioni.C: It allocates Scrum masters and POs.
opzioni.D: It creates the framework for every project.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. PMO-like.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. A VDO enables rather than oversees.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Directive PMO-like.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Directive PMO-like.

domande.spiegazione: Value Delivery Office (PMBOK 7, p. 141).

domande.domanda: Requirements are likely to change, need medium compliance, but can be released in one go. Which delivery approach?

opzioni.A: Predictive.
opzioni.B: Incremental.
opzioni.C: Adaptive.
opzioni.D: Iterative.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Plans upfront.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Releases increments.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Releases increments with feedback.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Iterative improves with feedback and delivers once.

domande.spiegazione: Tailor for the project (PMBOK 7, p. 141).

domande.domanda: A process improvement for accounting: a small team of nine, cross-functional, co-located, with unlimited customer access. How will you tailor delivery?

opzioni.A: Predictive.
opzioni.B: Adaptive.
opzioni.C: Incremental.
opzioni.D: Hybrid.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not needed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Adaptive fits small, cross-functional, co-located teams close to the customer.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. No predictive part.

domande.spiegazione: Tailor for the project team (PMBOK 7, p. 141).

domande.domanda: In an agile organization with a tailored approach, you notice things not working as you start new projects. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Review the product backlog flow.
opzioni.B: Look at issues, threats and QA statistics.
opzioni.C: Suggest a retrospective with PMO leaders to find ongoing improvements.
opzioni.D: Review a control chart and value stream map.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Retrospectives find ongoing improvements.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Good tools, but part of problem solving.

domande.spiegazione: Tailoring diagnostics (PMBOK 7, p. 151).

domande.domanda: Fewer stories are ready; a retrospective shows long waits for requirements and acceptance-criteria approvals. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Streamline approvals through fewer people, e.g. a PO authorized up to certain value thresholds.
opzioni.B: Let the team place stories without customer approval.
opzioni.C: Note it as a risk.
opzioni.D: Escalate to the functional manager.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Tailoring suggestion for approval delays.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Excludes the customer.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. It's an issue.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Doesn't fix the process.

domande.spiegazione: Common situations and tailoring suggestions (PMBOK 7, p. 151).

domande.domanda: Taking over a project, you see lots of work in progress, people context-switching between many items. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Add people.
opzioni.B: Use value stream mapping and Kanban boards to visualize work and brainstorm solutions.
opzioni.C: Ask for overtime.
opzioni.D: Cut low-impact scope.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Complicates communication.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Visualize work, identify issues, propose solutions.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Unsustainable.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Good practice, not the cause.

domande.spiegazione: Common situations and tailoring suggestions (PMBOK 7, p. 151).

domande.domanda: Stories are prioritized, estimated and fill two-week sprints, but completed pieces are rejected for defects and missed requirements. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Recreate the scope from scratch.
opzioni.B: Hold an iteration zero planning sprint.
opzioni.C: Add more feedback loops: shoulder checks, peer review, unit and system testing.
opzioni.D: Have less frequent customer demos.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Excessive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Delays flow.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. More verification loops and QA steps.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Less feedback.

domande.spiegazione: Common situations and tailoring suggestions (PMBOK 7, p. 151).

domande.domanda: Your team found its rhythm but seems disengaged. Everyone is fairly paid for the market. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Give bonuses.
opzioni.B: Rotate roles frequently.
opzioni.C: Give a paid day off.
opzioni.D: Establish ways for the team to grow and advance.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Fades quickly.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Loses expertise and flow.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Fades quickly.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. With hygiene factors met, motivators are achievement, growth, advancement.

domande.spiegazione: Hygiene and motivational factors (PMBOK 7, p. 158).

domande.domanda: On a regulatory change, your team isn't communicating well. You plan to increase communication effectiveness and richness. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Include methods handling multiple cues, rapid feedback and natural language.
opzioni.B: Include quick escalation to executives.
opzioni.C: Include written sign-offs.
opzioni.D: Ensure everyone has a voice in decisions.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Media richness: multiple cues, rapid feedback, personal focus, natural language.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not richness.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Less rich.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Good, but not richness.

domande.spiegazione: Effectiveness of communication channels (PMBOK 7, p. 157).

domande.domanda: Your deliverables are ready for the financial analytics team, a big change for them, and they already want to use the system. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Share the vision and why.
opzioni.B: Provide training and education on the new processes and systems.
opzioni.C: Give unlimited hands-on practice.
opzioni.D: Include rewards and recognition.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Awareness, already there.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. After Desire comes Knowledge.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Ability, later.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Reinforcement, last.

domande.spiegazione: ADKAR model (PMBOK 7, p. 161).

domande.domanda: Leading a change for 1,000+ people, you engaged senior managers, created a vision and strategy and are communicating the vision. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Release multiple usable features.
opzioni.B: Anchor changes in corporate culture.
opzioni.C: Address obstacles, including outdated processes and resistance.
opzioni.D: Set goals for continued improvement.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Too early.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Last step.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. After communicating the vision comes removing obstacles.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Later step.

domande.spiegazione: Kotter's 8-step process (PMBOK 7, p. 162).

domande.domanda: Assessing risk of future releases, requirements are clear but there's a range of possible correct solutions and known unknowns. How will you approach this?

opzioni.A: Use current best practices.
opzioni.B: Use emergent practices: probe, sense, respond.
opzioni.C: Assess the facts, analyze the situation and apply good practices.
opzioni.D: Act to stabilize the situation.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Obvious domain.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Complex domain (unknown unknowns).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Complicated: known unknowns, range of correct answers.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Chaotic domain.

domande.spiegazione: Cynefin framework (PMBOK 7, p. 164).

domande.domanda: Requirements for a new system are unclear and will take time to uncover; the technology has medium uncertainty. How will you approach the project?

opzioni.A: Release small usable features and improve based on feedback.
opzioni.B: Plan more upfront.
opzioni.C: Split the team in two.
opzioni.D: Make a business case to start from scratch with easier technology.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Agile works best in complicated and complex zones.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Doesn't resolve uncertainty.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Adds silos.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Long and unnecessary.

domande.spiegazione: Stacey matrix (PMBOK 7, p. 165).

domande.domanda: Your team, formally introduced, now has conflict: members don't respect each other's decisions and personalities clash. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Help members get to know each other's names.
opzioni.B: Help them understand roles and responsibilities and form a regular rhythm of work.
opzioni.C: Help them jockey for position.
opzioni.D: Help them complete work and disperse.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Forming, already done.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Moves the team from storming to norming.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Unhealthy competition.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Adjourning.

domande.spiegazione: Tuckman ladder (PMBOK 7, p. 166).

domande.domanda: With a new team you covered purpose and mission and who is on the team and their skills. You want a high-performing culture. What next?

opzioni.A: Work through changes to team and deliverables.
opzioni.B: Decompose the plan into detail.
opzioni.C: Define a plan with milestones and budgets.
opzioni.D: Clarify the team's goals and what you're here to deliver.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Later (renewal).
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Later (implementation).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Later (commitment).
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. After orientation and trust building comes goal clarification.

domande.spiegazione: Drexler/Sibbet Team Performance Model (PMBOK 7, p. 167).

domande.domanda: Your team thinks current scope won't increase customer retention. The sponsor, who controls funding, dismisses this and says to proceed. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Problem-solve with the sponsor.
opzioni.B: Compromise.
opzioni.C: Accommodate the sponsor to maintain harmony and goodwill.
opzioni.D: Force the sponsor to accept the change.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Good, but the sponsor already decided.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Lose-lose.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. With a powerful sponsor and a relationship to keep, accommodating may be appropriate.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Win-lose, damaging.

domande.spiegazione: Thomas-Kilmann conflict model (PMBOK 7, pp. 168-169).
domande.nota: The instructor finds A and C close.

domande.domanda: A functional manager says they weren't engaged and requirements are missing; you believe all are captured. The program manager asks for a win-win approach. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Escalate to the steering committee.
opzioni.B: Demonstrate integrity, find mutual trust and see it from their point of view.
opzioni.C: Give leeway so they can add requirements.
opzioni.D: Baseline first, then compete.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not win-win.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Win-win needs character, trust and their perspective.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Lose-win.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Win-lose.

domande.spiegazione: Negotiation (PMBOK 7, p. 169).

domande.domanda: After 4 weeks of planning, requirements and scope are signed off and execution begins per plan. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Monitor and control the work.
opzioni.B: Execute the work.
opzioni.C: Plan the work.
opzioni.D: Formally sign off the project.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Executed work must be monitored and controlled.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Already happening.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Already done.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not finished yet.

domande.spiegazione: Process groups (PMBOK 7, p. 170).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: As PO, sales and revenue grew over 8 months, but profit fell 17%. The executive asks you to address it. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Stop work and plan.
opzioni.B: Ask for overtime.
opzioni.C: Benchmark against a similar non-competing company and add process improvements to the backlog.
opzioni.D: Partner with other products to increase sales.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Don't stop work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Unsustainable.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Benchmarking finds process gaps reducing cost.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Ignores rising costs.

domande.spiegazione: Benchmarking (PMBOK 7, p. 175).

domande.domanda: Senior users created a feature list and each wants theirs first. How will you prioritize?

opzioni.A: Executives' features first.
opzioni.B: MoSCoW with stakeholders.
opzioni.C: Root cause analysis.
opzioni.D: Cost-benefit analysis and payback period.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. HiPPO.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Everyone says 'must have'.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. For specific problems.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Cost-benefit and payback are accepted ways to prioritize value.

domande.spiegazione: Business justification methods (PMBOK 7, p. 175).

domande.domanda: You want a high-level schedule using Wideband Delphi. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Each member places point cards in the center for a total.
opzioni.B: Have SMEs estimate in multiple rounds, explaining highest and lowest each round.
opzioni.C: Show the wide range from lowest to highest per feature.
opzioni.D: Estimate by business functionality.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not the method.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Multiple rounds with explanations of extremes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Wordplay trap.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Function points.

domande.spiegazione: Wideband Delphi (PMBOK 7, p. 178).

domande.domanda: Executives presented strengths and opportunities, a rosy picture, though revenue fell. The CEO wants a more complete view. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Add competitors' products.
opzioni.B: Show the pipeline.
opzioni.C: Add executives' backgrounds.
opzioni.D: Brainstorm the organization's weaknesses and threats.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not relevant.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not relevant.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Completes SWOT.

domande.spiegazione: SWOT analysis (PMBOK 7, p. 175).

domande.domanda: The team thinks a large feature takes 6 weeks; a lead developer did a similar one elsewhere in about 4 months. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Relative estimating.
opzioni.B: Analogous estimating, placing the feature at about 4 months.
opzioni.C: Parametric estimating.
opzioni.D: Function point estimating.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. For stories.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Uses experience on a similar item.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. No parameters.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. No data.

domande.spiegazione: Analogous estimating (PMBOK 7, p. 178).

domande.domanda: The first feature was broken into stories; the team wants to estimate effort but doesn't know how. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Each member adds their own estimate.
opzioni.B: Estimate the whole feature only.
opzioni.C: Help the team do relative estimating together in story points.
opzioni.D: Base estimates on cost per hour after work is done.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Loses team input.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Story estimates needed for velocity.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Most common for stories, often Fibonacci.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not estimation.

domande.spiegazione: Relative estimating (PMBOK 7, p. 178).

domande.domanda: Halfway through a sprint, not enough work is ready for the next one. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Hold a backlog refinement meeting.
opzioni.B: Raise it as a blocker and swarm.
opzioni.C: Raise it at the retrospective.
opzioni.D: Put cards on the Kanban board.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Refinement elaborates and prioritizes work for the next iteration.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Takes people off work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Too late.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not ready yet.

domande.spiegazione: Backlog refinement (PMBOK 7, p. 179).

domande.domanda: After make-or-buy, you created the procurement strategy, source selection criteria and SOW. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Gather seller proposals.
opzioni.B: Meet prospective sellers so all have a common understanding.
opzioni.C: Perform source selection analysis.
opzioni.D: Create the procurement agreement.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Too early.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Bidder conferences ensure common understanding before bids.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Already done.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Too early.

domande.spiegazione: Bidder conference (PMBOK 7, p. 179).

domande.domanda: A stakeholder raised a change request after defects and a missed requirement. Your project has formal change control. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Ask other stakeholders if they need it.
opzioni.B: Log it and put it in the next sprint.
opzioni.C: Take it to the CCB, then communicate approval or rejection.
opzioni.D: Raise it as an issue.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Already raised.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Skips control.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. The CCB approves or rejects; decisions are communicated.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not the process.

domande.spiegazione: Change control board (PMBOK 7, p. 179).

domande.domanda: New stakeholders after a restructure complain they don't see traction and fear requirements won't be met. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Invite them to the daily stand-up.
opzioni.B: Invite them to iteration planning.
opzioni.C: Invite them to the retrospective.
opzioni.D: Invite them to the iteration review to see the usable increment.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Team event.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. PO prioritizes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Team process.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Reviews demonstrate work to customers and stakeholders.

domande.spiegazione: Iteration review (PMBOK 7, p. 179).

domande.domanda: A regulatory approval not yet granted might block development in 5 months; it's not in project documents. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Hold a risk review and ensure an adequate response.
opzioni.B: Hold a retrospective.
opzioni.C: Adjust the roadmap.
opzioni.D: Escalate to the steering committee.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Risk reviews identify new risks and check responses.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not for this.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not known yet.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Manage first.

domande.spiegazione: Risk review (PMBOK 7, p. 180).

domande.domanda: In stand-ups people accuse each other, some tasks have no owner, and velocity slowed over 3 sprints. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Refer to the team charter roles and conflict rules.
opzioni.B: Raise it at the next retrospective and find a solution with the team.
opzioni.C: Assign roles yourself.
opzioni.D: Re-size stories.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The missing tasks aren't in it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Retrospectives improve the team's process.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not collaborative.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not the cause.

domande.spiegazione: Retrospective (PMBOK 7, p. 180).
domande.nota: The instructor finds A and B close.

domande.domanda: A one-week schedule delay slightly increased a risk, still within acceptable limits. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Hold a risk review and update responses and owners.
opzioni.B: Raise a change request.
opzioni.C: Capture it in reporting and take it to the next status meeting.
opzioni.D: Update the sprint backlog.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not needed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Within limits.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Status meetings exchange progress information.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not agile here.

domande.spiegazione: Status meeting (PMBOK 7, p. 180).

domande.domanda: Your team delivered 3 features to improve a customer app. The PO needs to know if they have the desired effect. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Gather velocity and throughput.
opzioni.B: Gather cost-benefit ratio.
opzioni.C: Gather the Net Promoter Score over the past six months.
opzioni.D: Gather app availability and uptime.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Internal.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. For prioritization.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. NPS gauges customer satisfaction and loyalty.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Operations.

domande.spiegazione: Net Promoter Score (PMBOK 7, p. 181).

domande.domanda: An influential executive wants a feature they and their friends like. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Place it in the backlog and prioritize by cost vs benefit.
opzioni.B: Raise a change request.
opzioni.C: Gather requirements.
opzioni.D: Analyze impact and add to scope.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Data-driven prioritization.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Analyze first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Decide first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Decide first.

domande.spiegazione: Prioritization schema (PMBOK 7, p. 181).

domande.domanda: For three weeks the team has struggled with a complicated, top-priority requirement; there's not enough work for the next sprint. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Start it next sprint anyway.
opzioni.B: Arrange a spike with the right people, timeboxed to two days.
opzioni.C: Deprioritize it.
opzioni.D: Adjust the schedule.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not ready.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. A spike is a short research story in a fixed time box.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. It's top priority.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Solve first.

domande.spiegazione: Spike and time box (PMBOK 7, p. 181).

domande.domanda: Your building construction project is about to start. Another executive asks you to also deliver a website. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Raise an issue.
opzioni.B: Add it to scope.
opzioni.C: Raise a change request.
opzioni.D: Help create a business case to fund a new project.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not an issue.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Different team and scope.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Wrong project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. A business case precedes a new project charter.

domande.spiegazione: Business case (PMBOK 7, p. 184).

domande.domanda: Planning the backlog for 3-6 months, you have feature ideas from staff, executives and customer research. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Break each feature into epics and stories and size them.
opzioni.B: Do managers' features first.
opzioni.C: Create a business model canvas for each feature with requesters and experts.
opzioni.D: Do precedence diagramming.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Too detailed too early.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. HiPPO.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. One-page summary of value, customers, infrastructure and finances.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Too early.

domande.spiegazione: Business model canvas (PMBOK 7, p. 184).

domande.domanda: Work slowed with uncertainty and low engagement. You create a team charter, roles and cadence. What next?

opzioni.A: Set a goal to be more engaged.
opzioni.B: Create a product vision statement with the value and the why.
opzioni.C: Ask everyone to contribute more.
opzioni.D: Raise a people issue to the steering committee.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Vague.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. A vision states purpose and inspires contribution.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Pressure.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Manage first.

domande.spiegazione: Project vision statement (PMBOK 7, p. 184).

domande.domanda: Developers haven't used a third-party system but assume same language and layout; they estimate 5 weeks with some buffer. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Note the 5-week estimate and update the assumption log.
opzioni.B: Do bottom-up story estimates.
opzioni.C: Check with parametric estimating.
opzioni.D: Run Wideband Delphi with everyone.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. The assumption log records assumptions and constraints.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Possible, more effort.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. No parameters.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Heavy for now.

domande.spiegazione: Assumption log (PMBOK 7, p. 185).

domande.domanda: A customer proposes a high-benefit, low-complexity feature mid-project. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Add money to the budget.
opzioni.B: Elaborate and break it down.
opzioni.C: Place it in the backlog and reprioritize it next.
opzioni.D: Write a business case.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Agile: fixed budget.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Prioritize first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Backlog items are ordered by priority.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not for agile.

domande.spiegazione: Backlog (PMBOK 7, p. 185).

domande.domanda: A missed requirement led to a change request, which the CCB approved. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Elaborate into stories.
opzioni.B: Place it in the sprint backlog.
opzioni.C: Log an issue and problem-solve.
opzioni.D: Note the outcome in the change log and communicate to stakeholders.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. After communicating.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. After elaborating.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Later.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. The change log records changes and status.

domande.spiegazione: Change log (PMBOK 7, p. 185).

domande.domanda: After a feature upgrade on a hybrid project, the senior developer says the system can't connect to parts of the organization. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Re-plan the project.
opzioni.B: Raise it in the issue log, assign a responsible party and work toward resolution.
opzioni.C: Raise it as a risk.
opzioni.D: Escalate to the technical manager.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Premature.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Issues are logged and assigned for resolution.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Already happened.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Assign the right party.

domande.spiegazione: Issue log (PMBOK 7, p. 185).

domande.domanda: Your program manager asks you to manage agile project risks with a risk-adjusted backlog. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Update the risk register with uncompleted work.
opzioni.B: Adjust velocity.
opzioni.C: Gather mitigations from retrospectives.
opzioni.D: Place at least one risk response in each sprint.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not a backlog.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not this.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. A risk-adjusted backlog includes actions for threats and opportunities.

domande.spiegazione: Risk-adjusted backlog (PMBOK 7, p. 185).

domande.domanda: On a complex project, the functional manager wants to see the biggest risks assigned to her. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Show the risk-adjusted backlog.
opzioni.B: Show the risk register.
opzioni.C: Show the risk management plan.
opzioni.D: Show the qualitative assessment.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not clearly agile.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Records owners, probability, impact and responses.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Process.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. No owners.

domande.spiegazione: Risk register (PMBOK 7, p. 185).

domande.domanda: An unknown person says his highly impacted team wasn't engaged and threatens to block the project. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Perform an engagement assessment.
opzioni.B: Add him to the register with salary and interests.
opzioni.C: Add him to the stakeholder register with impact and influence.
opzioni.D: Raise a risk.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Good, but record him first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Irrelevant data.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. The register records assessment and classification.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Manage first.

domande.spiegazione: Stakeholder register (PMBOK 7, p. 185).

domande.domanda: As PO, stories for the first feature are estimated. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Create an iteration plan with the team.
opzioni.B: Create the roadmap.
opzioni.C: Hold a sprint review.
opzioni.D: Start daily stand-ups.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Matches estimated work to velocity.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Already past.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. After the sprint.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. After planning.

domande.spiegazione: Iteration plan (PMBOK 7, p. 186).

domande.domanda: The customer wants to see when value will be delivered and expected outcomes. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Show features at the next sprint review.
opzioni.B: Put features on a release plan.
opzioni.C: Check the velocity chart.
opzioni.D: Put features in the next sprint plan.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Only past work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Sets expectations for dates, features and outcomes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. An input.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Only one sprint.

domande.spiegazione: Release plan (PMBOK 7, p. 186).

domande.domanda: New business analysts aren't sure of their process for capturing customer needs. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Start writing user stories.
opzioni.B: Create the PM plan.
opzioni.C: Create a requirements management plan with them.
opzioni.D: Create a WBS.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. No process yet.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Too broad.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Describes how requirements are analyzed, documented and managed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. One step only.

domande.spiegazione: Requirements management plan (PMBOK 7, p. 186).

domande.domanda: Complex interdependencies worry the senior user doing testing about release errors. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Get a written list of requirements.
opzioni.B: Raise a risk.
opzioni.C: Create an affinity diagram.
opzioni.D: Review the test plan with the senior user.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not testing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Groups ideas.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Describes what, how and when is tested.

domande.spiegazione: Test plan (PMBOK 7, p. 186).

domande.domanda: Your team must see exactly what to deliver and how each part relates. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Create a product breakdown structure.
opzioni.B: Create the RTM.
opzioni.C: Create a risk breakdown structure.
opzioni.D: Create the scope management plan.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Hierarchical tree of deliverables in whole-part relationship.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Traces requirements.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Risks.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Process.

domande.spiegazione: Product breakdown structure (PMBOK 7, p. 187).

domande.domanda: The program manager wants scope controlled so changes go through process. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Create the change management plan.
opzioni.B: Baseline the scope and note it in the configuration management plan.
opzioni.C: Create a scope plan minimizing changes.
opzioni.D: Create a RAM limiting approvers.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Needs a baseline first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Baselines are noted in the configuration management plan.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Process only.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Partial.

domande.spiegazione: Baselines (PMBOK 7, p. 188).

domande.domanda: You need to see how the team tracks toward the sprint goal. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Check the Kanban board.
opzioni.B: Check the velocity chart.
opzioni.C: Review the sprint burndown chart.
opzioni.D: Hold a sprint review.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Less direct.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Past sprints.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Compares ideal trend with work remaining.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. After the sprint.

domande.spiegazione: Burndown chart (PMBOK 7, p. 188).

domande.domanda: A program manager asks how much is complete in design, development, testing and sign-off. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Show the sprint Kanban board.
opzioni.B: Show the product backlog.
opzioni.C: Show the cumulative flow diagram.
opzioni.D: Show the velocity chart.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. One sprint only.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. No stages.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Shows features completed over time by stage.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Totals only.

domande.spiegazione: Cumulative flow diagram (PMBOK 7, p. 188).

domande.domanda: Unrefactored code may be slowing stories, but you're not sure. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Check the cycle time chart.
opzioni.B: Shadow developers.
opzioni.C: Check the roadmap.
opzioni.D: Compare sprint points to velocity.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Shows average cycle time over time.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not data.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Release dates.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Team-level only.

domande.spiegazione: Cycle time chart (PMBOK 7, p. 189).

domande.domanda: The team doesn't know what the next roadmap feature does or how to split it into stories. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Review the scope baseline.
opzioni.B: Do story mapping with the team.
opzioni.C: Sprint planning.
opzioni.D: Retrospective.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not agile.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Holistic view of features, broken into stories by functionality.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Needs stories first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not for this.

domande.spiegazione: Story map (PMBOK 7, p. 190).

domande.domanda: As program manager over Scrum teams, you need the rate of work flowing through each team. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Raise it at the Scrum of Scrums.
opzioni.B: Attend each sprint review.
opzioni.C: Review the schedule management plan.
opzioni.D: Review each team's velocity chart: committed vs completed.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Indirect.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Demos only.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Process.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Tracks the rate deliverables are produced and accepted.

domande.spiegazione: Velocity chart (PMBOK 7, p. 190).

domande.domanda: A new sponsor asks where the project is and whether it's on track, and wants more detail. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Show the signed charter.
opzioni.B: Show the PM plan.
opzioni.C: Review the current and previous status reports with him.
opzioni.D: Invite him to the next sprint review.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Start of project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Process.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Status and progress since last report, with forecasts.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Partial.

domande.spiegazione: Status report (PMBOK 7, p. 190).

domande.domanda: Your agile project needs a vendor, but the PO's roadmap may change, making scope uncertain. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Ask the PO to fix scope.
opzioni.B: Create a cost plus incentive fee contract.
opzioni.C: Create a firm fixed price contract.
opzioni.D: Bring the work in-house with the vendor budget.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not agile.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Cost-reimbursable suits ill-defined or changing scope.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Fixed scope needed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Complex and uncertain.

domande.spiegazione: Cost-reimbursable contracts (PMBOK 7, p. 191).

domande.domanda: Over 12 months, material costs are volatile and quantities may change significantly. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Use an indefinite delivery, indefinite quantity (IDIQ) contract.
opzioni.B: Use a firm fixed price contract.
opzioni.C: Use a sole supplier.
opzioni.D: Use multiple suppliers.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Quantity within limits over a fixed period.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Needs known quantity.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Doesn't address quantity.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Doesn't address quantity.

domande.spiegazione: Agreements and contracts (PMBOK 7, p. 191).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: You have an SOW and acceptable sellers; work isn't complex and they understand scope. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Send an RFP.
opzioni.B: Send an RFI.
opzioni.C: Send an RFQ.
opzioni.D: Hold a bidder conference.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. For complex.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Info already known.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Requirements are ready: just need price.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Already understood.

domande.spiegazione: Bid documents (PMBOK 7, p. 192).

domande.domanda: A new team has disagreements and slow work as people find their place. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Project charter.
opzioni.B: Definition of ready.
opzioni.C: Project management plan.
opzioni.D: Team charter.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Authorizes project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Work readiness.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Management processes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Records team values, agreements and guidelines.

domande.spiegazione: Team charter (PMBOK 7, p. 192).

domande.domanda: Features are prioritized but too high-level for developers to start. What will you do next?

opzioni.A: Start on the highest priority item.
opzioni.B: Help the team break features into user stories for a sprint.
opzioni.C: Hold a retrospective.
opzioni.D: Reprioritize.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Still too high-level.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Stories have enough detail to work on.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. After a sprint.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Doesn't add detail.

domande.spiegazione: User story (PMBOK 7, p. 192).

domande.domanda: As agile PM, the executive who will own the product wants to focus primarily on set processes and tools. What will you recommend instead?

opzioni.A: Focus on success as defined by the PM.
opzioni.B: Focus primarily on the individuals and interactions involved.
opzioni.C: Focus primarily on project scope.
opzioni.D: Focus primarily on the schedule.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The customer/PO defines success.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Manifesto: individuals and interactions over processes and tools.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Traditional focus.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Traditional focus.

domande.spiegazione: Projects are run by people: interactions make or break them. Agile Practice Guide.

domande.domanda: Executives assembled a new team and dictated agile. There's confusion about scope and the definition of done. What will you recommend?

opzioni.A: Select one person from each part of the organization for diversity.
opzioni.B: Let the functional manager pick favorite team members.
opzioni.C: Encourage a self-organizing team including those who asked for the requirements and outcomes.
opzioni.D: Hire external consultants.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. They may not care about the product.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Favorites may not fit.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Self-organizing teams with requirement owners have ownership and expertise.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Long ramp-up on the business.

domande.spiegazione: Agile encourages self-organizing teams of the people who own the need. Agile Practice Guide.

domande.domanda: You meet the team for the next sprint planning meeting. What happens?

opzioni.A: Negotiate scope and cost with the sponsor.
opzioni.B: Walk through the three stand-up questions.
opzioni.C: The team demonstrates the working feature to the PO.
opzioni.D: The PO shares the updated backlog and the team discusses it for shared understanding.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Done before the team forms; cost usually fixed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. That's the daily stand-up.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. That's the sprint review.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. PO brings prioritized items; the team builds shared understanding.

domande.spiegazione: Sprint planning: prioritized backlog + shared understanding.

domande.domanda: You want the team to maximize customer value. What can you eliminate?

opzioni.A: Daily stand-ups.
opzioni.B: Unnecessary features.
opzioni.C: Sprint reviews.
opzioni.D: Testing.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Needed for visibility.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Extra features are waste; also partially done work, task switching, waiting, handoffs, defects.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Needed for feedback.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Needed for quality.

domande.spiegazione: Eliminate waste to maximize value.

domande.domanda: A team member new to Scrum asks what typically happens after the sprint review.

opzioni.A: A sprint retrospective with the team.
opzioni.B: Backlog refinement with the PO.
opzioni.C: Story elaboration with the three amigos.
opzioni.D: A daily scrum.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Held after the review and before the next planning.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Before iteration planning.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Before iteration planning.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Happens daily.

domande.spiegazione: The retrospective gathers lessons learned for the next sprint.

domande.domanda: The agile team charter should answer: why are we doing this project, who benefits, and which other two?

opzioni.A: When will the project end? What do we do with the product?
opzioni.B: What does done mean? How will we work together?
opzioni.C: How much risk is there? What is the scope?
opzioni.D: How many defects are allowed? How many testers?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not charter content.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Charter covers why, who benefits, done, how we work together.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Project plan content.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not charter content.

domande.spiegazione: Agile Practice Guide.

domande.domanda: Agile favors value-based over predictive measurements. Which is an example of value-based measurement?

opzioni.A: Earned value and SPI.
opzioni.B: Variance analysis and ETC.
opzioni.C: Feature burndown, features delivered and customer satisfaction.
opzioni.D: VAC and CPI.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Predictive EVM.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Predictive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Agile's primary measure is value delivered.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Predictive EVM.

domande.spiegazione: Agile measures value delivered.

domande.domanda: Agile Unified Process (AUP) iterates across seven disciplines. Which is NOT one of them?

opzioni.A: Model.
opzioni.B: Managing stakeholder expectations.
opzioni.C: Testing.
opzioni.D: Configuration management.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Is one) High-level model.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. (NOT) Agile focuses on transparency, not managing expectations.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (Is one)
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. (Is one)

domande.spiegazione: Agile Practice Guide.

domande.domanda: In a coaching session on additional agile and lean frameworks, which will you share?

opzioni.A: Project management plan and charter.
opzioni.B: Scaled Agile Framework and Large-Scale Scrum.
opzioni.C: Working groups and post-mortems.
opzioni.D: Flowcharting and affinity diagrams.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Predictive artifacts.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. SAFe, LeSS, SoS, DSDM, plus Kanban, XP, Scrum.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Traditional meetings.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Analysis tools.

domande.spiegazione: Agile Practice Guide.

domande.domanda: Crystal (Cockburn) focuses on individuals and interactions. Which is NOT one of its core beliefs?

opzioni.A: Technologies change techniques.
opzioni.B: People change functions.
opzioni.C: Cultures change norms.
opzioni.D: Distances change communication.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Is one)
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. (NOT) Not a Crystal belief.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (Is one)
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. (Is one)

domande.spiegazione: Crystal beliefs underpin stand-ups, collaboration, retrospectives.

domande.domanda: As Scrum master you set a meeting with team and PO to refine the backlog. What should the team do?

opzioni.A: Estimate and refine the work items.
opzioni.B: Prioritize the items.
opzioni.C: Add features.
opzioni.D: Identify fixes.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Team estimates and refines with more detail each time.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. PO prioritizes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Done before.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not the purpose.

domande.spiegazione: PO prioritizes; team estimates and refines.

domande.domanda: A functional manager asks the difference between Kanban and Scrum.

opzioni.A: Kanban plans in sprints.
opzioni.B: Kanban has no WIP limits.
opzioni.C: Kanban works on the project as a whole.
opzioni.D: Kanban teams employ a pull system.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. That's Scrum.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. WIP limits are Kanban's core.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Works in increments.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Completing an item triggers pulling the next.

domande.spiegazione: Kanban: pull system and WIP limits.

domande.domanda: The self-formed team chose Jeremy as Scrum master; he immediately sets a meeting to flesh out the team charter. What makes him a good choice?

opzioni.A: He likes set processes.
opzioni.B: He's been there 5+ years.
opzioni.C: He shows servant leadership and engages the team in decisions.
opzioni.D: He sticks to the plan.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not agile.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Tenure isn't the criterion.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Engages team, starts with charter and ground rules.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Agile responds to change.

domande.spiegazione: Servant leaders engage rather than command.

domande.domanda: A business representative asks how many defects were found in the latest testing. You don't know offhand. What should you do?

opzioni.A: Guess and change subject.
opzioni.B: Promise an email.
opzioni.C: Take him to the team area's information radiator.
opzioni.D: Ask him to call the Scrum master.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not transparent.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Prefer face to face and self-serve.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Radiators show velocity, board, backlog, burndown, test results.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Information should be available to all.

domande.spiegazione: Information radiators enable transparency.

domande.domanda: Why will an agile team respond better to change and meet customer needs?

opzioni.A: It works directly with a business representative to constantly prioritize value.
opzioni.B: It delivers all in one go.
opzioni.C: It's for developers only.
opzioni.D: Business partners review statuses.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Daily collaboration with the business lets priorities change.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. That's waterfall.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Agile works for any work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Business provides priorities.

domande.spiegazione: Face to face with the business beats documents.

domande.domanda: In release planning, the PO prioritizes and refines user stories. Which is INCORRECT about iteration planning and backlog preparation?

opzioni.A: The backlog is the ordered list of all work in story form.
opzioni.B: The coach encourages the team to work alone so no one bothers them.
opzioni.C: The facilitator encourages triads of developer, tester and PO/BA.
opzioni.D: The triad places enough stories into an iteration and features for a first release.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Correct)
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. (INCORRECT) Agile teams collaborate continuously.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (Correct) Three amigos.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. (Correct)

domande.spiegazione: Agile Practice Guide.

domande.domanda: Behavior-Driven Development is a method for writing stories and acceptance criteria. Which format does it use?

opzioni.A: Make, buy and do.
opzioni.B: Tell, show and repeat.
opzioni.C: Find, create and perform.
opzioni.D: Given, when, then.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not real.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not real.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not real.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Given a situation, when something happens, then the outcome.

domande.spiegazione: BDD acceptance criteria use Given-When-Then.

domande.domanda: What is the correct description of a waterfall (predictive) approach?

opzioni.A: Fixed requirements, performed once for the project, single delivery.
opzioni.B: Variable requirements, repeated, single delivery.
opzioni.C: Fixed requirements, repeated, frequent deliveries.
opzioni.D: Variable requirements, performed once, frequent deliveries.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Predictive: fixed requirements, once, single delivery.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Iterative-like.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not predictive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Incremental-like.

domande.spiegazione: Agile Practice Guide.
domande.nota: Option text reconstructed.

domande.domanda: What is the correct description of an iterative approach?

opzioni.A: Fixed requirements, repeated until correct, single delivery.
opzioni.B: Dynamic requirements, repeated until correct, single delivery.
opzioni.C: Dynamic requirements, repeated until correct, multiple deliveries.
opzioni.D: Fixed requirements, once, multiple deliveries.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Requirements aren't fixed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Dynamic requirements improved by feedback, delivered once.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. That's agile.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not iterative.

domande.spiegazione: Agile Practice Guide.
domande.nota: Option text reconstructed.

domande.domanda: The team charter is also a social contract. Which is NOT usually part of it?

opzioni.A: Team values like sustainable pace and core hours.
opzioni.B: Working agreements like definition of ready and done.
opzioni.C: Ground rules like one person talking in meetings.
opzioni.D: SPI and CPI for the project.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Part)
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. (Part)
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (Part)
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. (NOT) EVM metrics belong to predictive projects.

domande.spiegazione: Charter focuses on vision, why and ways of working.

domande.domanda: A business rep is confused about sprint review vs retrospective. What will you tell them?

opzioni.A: Review shows sprint work; retro looks at all project work.
opzioni.B: Review discusses sprint work; retro is at project end.
opzioni.C: Review covers lessons learned; retro looks at product history.
opzioni.D: Review is for product demos; retro is for lessons learned.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Retro covers the iteration.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Retros happen every iteration.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Swapped.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Retro asks what went well, what didn't, what we learned.

domande.spiegazione: Review = demo; retrospective = process improvement.

domande.domanda: Gathering requirements on an agile project, what is the first question to ask and use as a guide?

opzioni.A: How long will the project last?
opzioni.B: What is the business value?
opzioni.C: How much is the budget?
opzioni.D: How many team members are there?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Valid, not first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Agile centers on delivering business value.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Valid, not first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Valid, not first.

domande.spiegazione: Also consider business risk of not doing the project.

domande.domanda: The team determined several key features. How should they be tackled?

opzioni.A: Prioritized, tested and delivered incrementally.
opzioni.B: Delivered fast even if incomplete.
opzioni.C: Delivered per the project plan.
opzioni.D: All at the end.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Value continuously prioritized and delivered in complete increments.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Quality matters.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Predictive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Waterfall.

domande.spiegazione: Quality is everyone's responsibility.

domande.domanda: All iteration tasks are done; you're not sure what to work on next. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Follow the early project plan.
opzioni.B: Follow the PMO.
opzioni.C: Ask the PO, who continuously prioritizes the backlog.
opzioni.D: Ask the coach to decide.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Predictive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Predictive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. PO represents the customer and orders the backlog.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not their role.

domande.spiegazione: Work from the PO-prioritized backlog.

domande.domanda: Customers add new functionality to the backlog; the deadline can't change. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Have the team work overtime.
opzioni.B: Tell customers it won't be on time.
opzioni.C: Ensure customers understand lower-priority features may drop off.
opzioni.D: Put new items in a separate 'if time allows' category.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Unsustainable pace.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Agile still delivers value.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Scope varies; lower priorities drop off.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Prioritization is the agile way.

domande.spiegazione: Accept late change; keep a sustainable pace.

domande.domanda: What is the correct description of an incremental approach?

opzioni.A: Fixed requirements, performed once, multiple deliveries.
opzioni.B: Dynamic requirements, repeated until correct, one large delivery.
opzioni.C: Dynamic requirements, performed once per increment, frequent smaller deliveries.
opzioni.D: Dynamic requirements, repeated, frequent deliveries.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Requirements dynamic.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Single delivery.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Once per increment, frequent small deliveries.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. That's agile.

domande.spiegazione: Agile Practice Guide.
domande.nota: Option text reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Which is NOT a core agile practice?

opzioni.A: Team iteration planning.
opzioni.B: Collaborative user story creation.
opzioni.C: Demos and reviews.
opzioni.D: Autocratic leadership to ensure work gets done.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Core)
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. (Core)
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (Core)
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. (NOT) Agile prefers servant leadership and psychological safety.

domande.spiegazione: Agile Practice Guide.

domande.domanda: User stories are written collaboratively by developers, testers and business with frequent reviews. Which is NOT correct?

opzioni.A: A story addresses functional and non-functional requirements.
opzioni.B: The sponsor must sign off all stories in advance.
opzioni.C: A story includes acceptance criteria.
opzioni.D: Criteria must be estimable, small and testable.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Correct)
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. (NOT correct) The team agrees; PO grooms the backlog.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (Correct)
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. (Correct)

domande.spiegazione: PO, not sponsor, owns the backlog.

domande.domanda: In continuous integration, build, deployment and testing are automated. Defects in the code are therefore...

opzioni.A: Not an issue.
opzioni.B: Detected more quickly because work is constantly integrated, built and tested.
opzioni.C: Integrated via TDD.
opzioni.D: Fixed in a final iteration.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Still matter.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. CI merges to a test environment with automated regression tests.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. TDD is separate.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Fix as you go.

domande.spiegazione: CI + automated regression = faster defect finding.

domande.domanda: Which is NOT a core agile practice?

opzioni.A: Whole team approach.
opzioni.B: Early and frequent feedback.
opzioni.C: Daily stand-ups.
opzioni.D: Reporting to executives to keep them happy.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Core)
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. (Core)
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (Core)
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. (NOT) Include executives in demos and radiators instead.

domande.spiegazione: Agile Practice Guide.

domande.domanda: You ensure several MVPs can be scheduled throughout the project. Why?

opzioni.A: To show executives progress.
opzioni.B: To keep the project short.
opzioni.C: So users test quality.
opzioni.D: So the business gets value quickly as features are delivered.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Side effect.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not the reason.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Usable increments deliver value and feedback early.

domande.spiegazione: MVPs deliver value incrementally.

domande.domanda: On a complex software project the team uses a whiteboard and sticky notes. The business rep is put off by low-tech tools. What will you say?

opzioni.A: Low-tech so low-tech people understand.
opzioni.B: A whiteboard is actually complex.
opzioni.C: The team uses visual management: a physical board is transparent to all.
opzioni.D: The team will build a software board to avoid embarrassment.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not the reason.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not serious.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Lean visual management: low tech, high touch.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Prefer interactions over tools.

domande.spiegazione: Kanban board: low tech, high touch.

domande.domanda: Which is NOT a benefit of demos and reviews?

opzioni.A: Catches mistakes and mismatched expectations early.
opzioni.B: Keeps everyone busy.
opzioni.C: Easy to manage with multiple feedback loops.
opzioni.D: Reduces cost overruns.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Benefit)
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. (NOT) Busy work adds no value.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (Benefit)
