spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. (Benefit)

domande.spiegazione: Demos give early feedback.

domande.domanda: With a very short deadline, how do agile teams shorten time between finding and fixing a defect?

opzioni.A: Continuous integration.
opzioni.B: Daily build and smoke tests.
opzioni.C: Usability testing.
opzioni.D: Exploratory testing.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Merges code daily and runs automated tests.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Valid, not core.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Valid, not core.

domande.spiegazione: CI shortens defect detection time.

domande.domanda: When should acceptance test criteria be determined for a story?

opzioni.A: After the first iteration.
opzioni.B: During estimation and elaboration with PO, BA and developers.
opzioni.C: Before the feature is prioritized.
opzioni.D: At project end.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Too late.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Defined during elaboration, often Given-When-Then.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Prioritize first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Too late.

domande.spiegazione: Acceptance criteria precede development.

domande.domanda: What is the correct description of an agile approach?

opzioni.A: Dynamic requirements, repeated until correct, frequent small deliveries.
opzioni.B: Fixed requirements, once, single delivery.
opzioni.C: Dynamic requirements, repeated, single large delivery.
opzioni.D: Fixed requirements, repeated, frequent deliveries.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Agile combines iterating and frequent delivery.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Predictive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Iterative.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not agile.

domande.spiegazione: Agile Practice Guide.
domande.nota: Option text reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Continuous integration wraps build, deployment and testing into one automated process. It...

opzioni.A: Separates features into pools.
opzioni.B: Ensures no code changes.
opzioni.C: Integrates all changed components regularly, at least once a day.
opzioni.D: Enables new backlog features.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Opposite.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. No.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Merges and tests changes daily.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not related.

domande.spiegazione: CI finds defects daily.

domande.domanda: Crystal is designed to scale. What are its core values?

opzioni.A: People, interaction and community.
opzioni.B: Building, buying and selling products.
opzioni.C: Profit, persistence and power.
opzioni.D: Finding, building and leading people.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Matches individuals and interactions.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not agile.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not agile.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Close, not Crystal.

domande.spiegazione: Crystal (Cockburn, 1990s).
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: How does Crystal scale?

opzioni.A: Blue, indigo, violet by features.
opzioni.B: Clear, yellow, orange, red by number of people.
opzioni.C: Metal, wood, water by Kanban flow.
opzioni.D: High, low, medium by dollars.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not real.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Based on people, money and risk/criticality.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not real.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not the naming.

domande.spiegazione: Crystal Clear for 0-8 people.

domande.domanda: Which is NOT a reason agile teams use daily stand-ups?

opzioni.A: To micro-commit to the team.
opzioni.B: To uncover and remove blockers.
opzioni.C: To ensure work flows.
opzioni.D: To report to the executive team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Reason)
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. (Reason)
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (Reason)
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. (NOT) Executives may attend but it's not for reporting.

domande.spiegazione: Stand-ups serve the team.

domande.domanda: Halfway through, the sponsor fears the project won't finish on time. What gathers the needed information?

opzioni.A: Review the Kanban board and WIP.
opzioni.B: Check the backlog for remaining features.
opzioni.C: Review velocity, burndown and other KPIs.
opzioni.D: Hold a team meeting to log statuses.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. One iteration.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Remaining, not time.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Velocity and burndown show pace vs remaining work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not agile.

domande.spiegazione: Agile KPIs: velocity and remaining work.

domande.domanda: At kickoff the Scrum master suggests MoSCoW. How does it prioritize?

opzioni.A: Priority 1-4.
opzioni.B: Low, medium, high.
opzioni.C: Must have, should have, could have, won't have.
opzioni.D: Dots on features.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not MoSCoW.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not MoSCoW.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. MoSCoW labels.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. That's multi-voting.

domande.spiegazione: Other techniques: dot voting, monopoly money, Kano, fist of five.

domande.domanda: The sponsor thinks removing WIP limits will get more done faster. What will you tell them?

opzioni.A: You'll remove the limits.
opzioni.B: You'll dictate overtime and no holidays.
opzioni.C: WIP limits keep focus and avoid the time cost of task switching.
opzioni.D: WIP shows on the board, so the limit doesn't matter.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Counterproductive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Burns out the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Multitasking reduces effectiveness.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The limit is the point.

domande.spiegazione: Work is taken on by velocity; WIP limits protect focus.

domande.domanda: Stakeholders new to agile have valid concerns about some methods. As servant leader, what will you do?

opzioni.A: Educate them, address concerns and keep them engaged.
opzioni.B: Say it worked before.
opzioni.C: Dictate this is how all projects run.
opzioni.D: Go back to waterfall.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Servant leaders include and educate.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Dismissive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not convinced against their will.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not here.

domande.spiegazione: Grow people through coaching.

domande.domanda: Why incorporate multiple touchpoints with stakeholders before, during and after iterations?

opzioni.A: To raise and manage changes and identify risks and issues.
opzioni.B: To inform them of team direction.
opzioni.C: So executives hear about value.
opzioni.D: So they invest more time.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Features reviewed regularly; changes and risks raised early.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. PO gives direction.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not the reason.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not the reason.

domande.spiegazione: Frequent touchpoints catch changes early.

domande.domanda: Which is NOT true about stand-ups?

opzioni.A: Time-boxed to 15 minutes.
opzioni.B: Team walks the board.
opzioni.C: Anyone in the team can facilitate.
opzioni.D: Only project team members can attend.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (True)
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. (True)
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (True)
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. (NOT) Agile is open: anyone can attend.

domande.spiegazione: Transparency.

domande.domanda: When do feature demonstrations/reviews occur?

opzioni.A: Only at project end.
opzioni.B: At iteration end or when enough features form a coherent set.
opzioni.C: At project start.
opzioni.D: Whenever the team wants.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Every iteration.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Show usable increments regularly.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Nothing to show.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Must be prioritized.

domande.spiegazione: Sprint reviews demonstrate working product.

domande.domanda: Disciplined Agile blends agile techniques. Which is NOT one of its principles?

opzioni.A: People first.
opzioni.B: Learning oriented.
opzioni.C: Self-promotion: improving your own brand.
opzioni.D: Goal driven.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Principle)
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. (Principle)
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. (NOT) Agile is about the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. (Principle)

domande.spiegazione: Team serves each other; information transparent.
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Which are Disciplined Agile principles?

opzioni.A: Learning oriented, goal driven, scalable.
opzioni.B: Implementing, iterating, integrating.
opzioni.C: Excellence, guidance, cadence.
opzioni.D: Making, doing, being.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. DA principles.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not DA.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not DA.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not DA.

domande.spiegazione: Disciplined Agile.

domande.domanda: Which is a DSDM principle?

opzioni.A: Focus on the business need and deliver on time.
opzioni.B: Add every feature and stop when done.
opzioni.C: Find all defects or don't approve release.
opzioni.D: Push fast delivery over quality.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Scope variable, schedule set.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Prioritize instead.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Unrealistic.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Quality matters.

domande.spiegazione: DSDM: constraint-driven delivery.

domande.domanda: Developers using TDD ask about 'red, green, refactor'. What is it?

opzioni.A: No code in red, some in green, new features in refactor.
opzioni.B: Traffic-light approach for features.
opzioni.C: Releasing only green-lit features.
opzioni.D: A test is written first and fails, passes once code is written, then code is refactored.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Wrong.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Wrong.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Wrong.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Fail, pass, streamline.

domande.spiegazione: Red-green-refactor is the TDD cycle.

domande.domanda: Key deliverables are in the backlog. What will the agile team do next?

opzioni.A: Go live at project end.
opzioni.B: Deliver untested.
opzioni.C: Prioritize, develop and test incrementally.
opzioni.D: Plan carefully and follow the plan.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Waterfall.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Quality matters.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Prioritize and test each increment.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Respond to change over following a plan.

domande.spiegazione: Deliver features incrementally.

domande.domanda: A team identified highest-value features. Why break them into increments and deliver ASAP?

opzioni.A: So the team can relax.
opzioni.B: To shorten the life cycle.
opzioni.C: So the PO can report progress.
opzioni.D: To reduce the risk the feature no longer provides value.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not the reason.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not the reason.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not team-focused.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Longer delivery raises risk of lost value.

domande.spiegazione: Value-driven delivery.

domande.domanda: The Scrum master says agile works differently with risk. What will you do?

opzioni.A: Schedule high-risk activities early so they're mitigated quickly.
opzioni.B: Register risks and mitigate by project end.
opzioni.C: Keep the register secret.
opzioni.D: Capture only people risks.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Prioritizing high-risk features first reduces future risk.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Too late.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not transparent.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Risk covers everything.

domande.spiegazione: Agile front-loads risk.

domande.domanda: Your agile project needs a vendor to build software for a feature. Working with procurement, what will you do?

opzioni.A: Request a contract that accommodates changes to scope.
opzioni.B: Ask the business to deliver it.
opzioni.C: Raise a risk.
opzioni.D: Use an existing T&M contract from OPAs.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Agile scope changes; the contract must allow it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Possible, not best.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Weak incentives.

domande.spiegazione: Contracts must accommodate changing requirements.

domande.domanda: DSDM is known for constraint-driven delivery: cost, quality and time set upfront. What varies?

opzioni.A: Scope, via formal prioritization.
opzioni.B: Single delivery.
opzioni.C: Stakeholders.
opzioni.D: Cost: project ends when funds run out.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Agile varies scope, fixes cost, quality, time.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not agile.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not the variable.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Cost is fixed.

domande.spiegazione: Opposite to predictive, which fixes scope.
domande.nota: Option text reconstructed.

domande.domanda: Short iterations give early feedback on quality. Which is NOT a benefit?

opzioni.A: Avoiding requirement misunderstandings.
opzioni.B: Clarifying feature requests early.
opzioni.C: Finding quality problems early.
opzioni.D: One big release at the end to celebrate.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Benefit)
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. (Benefit)
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (Benefit)
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. (NOT) Single release is waterfall.

domande.spiegazione: Agile releases increments.

domande.domanda: Enterprise Scrum applies Scrum organization-wide. Which is NOT part of its leadership?

opzioni.A: Extending Scrum to all aspects of the organization.
opzioni.B: Role-playing Scrum master before the first iteration.
opzioni.C: Generalizing Scrum techniques for various levels.
opzioni.D: Scaling with supplemental techniques.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Part)
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. (NOT) Not part of Enterprise Scrum.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (Part)
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. (Part)

domande.spiegazione: Enterprise Scrum scales Scrum across teams.

domande.domanda: You're evolving your part of the organization into agile. What would you NOT do?

opzioni.A: Treat the change as an agile project with its own backlog.
opzioni.B: Treat changes as short experiments.
opzioni.C: Track progress on a Kanban board.
opzioni.D: Direct teams to take on agile in one go without wavering.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. (Do)
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. (Do)
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. (Do)
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. (NOT) Big bang is waterfall.

domande.spiegazione: Use agile to implement agile.

domande.domanda: Extreme Programming popularized 12 primary practices. Which is one?

opzioni.A: Sit together as a whole team in an informative workspace.
opzioni.B: Write executive reports.
opzioni.C: Rotate roles constantly.
opzioni.D: Develop all changes for a single release.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Whole team + informative workspace (boards, burndowns).
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not XP.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Prefer T-shaped specialists.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not agile.

domande.spiegazione: XP is a core agile input.

domande.domanda: The sponsor asks for help with the project charter; you say you'll also do a team charter. What does this mean?

opzioni.A: Capturing team values, communication and decision process separately from purpose, requirements, schedule.
opzioni.B: A plan with scope, schedule, cost.
opzioni.C: Taking over from the sponsor.
opzioni.D: Deferring all queries to the team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Agile PMs charter both project and team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. PM plan.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. No.

spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The PM does not decide what is essential: that is for the sponsor, product owner or customers.

spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Before solving a problem, find out how it came about: no actions without understanding the problem.

opzioni.D: Organize the session so all team members contribute insights and potential solutions.

domande.hint: Product owner = agile project. Who decides how the team works?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. The team is self-leading: bring the suggestion to the team and let it decide whether to adopt it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. It gives away your work to someone else.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. It brings in more people and jumps to implementing the RCA outcome.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Vague: the question is about the RCA suggestion, not new solutions.

domande.spiegazione: On an agile project the team is self-organizing and decides how and with which methods to work; the PM is not a dictator.

domande.domanda: While launching a new e-commerce platform, the project manager discovers that the finance department is concerned about not being involved in the cost estimates and the potential impact on project returns. What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Amend the stakeholder engagement plan to better integrate finance in future plans.
opzioni.B: Document the exclusion of the finance team as a risk to project success.
opzioni.C: Maintain the project timeline and plan a financial review before the final phase.
opzioni.D: Organize a meeting with the finance team to understand their concerns.

domande.hint: Keyword 'first': understand the concern before acting.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. An action taken before understanding the concern.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. You must understand the risk before documenting it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Doing nothing: never pick 'keep doing what you're doing'.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Meet them first to understand their concerns, then decide the next action.

domande.spiegazione: Never take an action first: meet the stakeholders and understand the concern.

domande.domanda: As part of a project to integrate a new security feature into an online shopping platform, stakeholders are concerned they don't understand the integration process during planning. What should the project manager do to enhance their understanding?

opzioni.A: Schedule regular demonstration sessions during each sprint to show progress and integration steps.
opzioni.B: Arrange for the technical team to provide a detailed explanation before each sprint begins.
opzioni.C: Organize a training session to educate stakeholders on the technical aspects of the integration.
opzioni.D: Provide detailed documentation on the integration process before each sprint.

domande.hint: Agile: how do customers see what the project is doing?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Sprint reviews/demos show progress and how it works.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Stakeholders don't need detailed technical explanations.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Customers don't need to be educated on technical aspects.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Customers don't want detailed (possibly technical) documentation.

domande.spiegazione: Customers care about functionality, not technical details: show working increments in regular demos (sprint reviews).

domande.domanda: A project manager is preparing the sprint planning session for a new feature in a healthcare system. The meeting aims to determine the amount of work for the upcoming sprint. Which two pieces of information are essential to make the meeting productive and efficient? (Choose two.)

opzioni.A: An updated risk assessment.
opzioni.B: Product marketplace goals.
opzioni.C: Team performance metrics (velocity).
opzioni.D: A detailed product backlog.

domande.hint: What are the inputs to sprint planning, and what is its output?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not an essential input to decide how much work fits in the sprint.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. That's sales and marketing, not sprint planning.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Velocity tells the team how much work it can pull, based on past sprints.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. The backlog (with user stories) is where the team selects the work from.
spiegazioni_opzioni.E: Incorrect. Agile projects don't lay out phase-based timelines: work follows backlog priority.

domande.spiegazione: Sprint planning produces the sprint backlog: the team needs the product backlog (what) and its velocity (how much).
domande.nota: Multiple-choice question (choose two). The option letters are not read in the source video: options reconstructed from the transcript; answer (velocity + product backlog) is from the source.

domande.domanda: A project manager leads an internal biotechnology research project with significant ambiguity and unpredictability. A suggestion has been made to introduce a system to gauge the quality of project outputs effectively. Which hybrid technique should the project manager employ for quality assurance?

opzioni.A: Combine weekly sprints with quarterly external audits to validate project standards.
opzioni.B: Merge traditional milestone reviews with agile sprint demonstrations.
opzioni.C: Adopt pair programming and customer feedback sessions.
opzioni.D: Integrate continuous integration tools with formal quality control checkpoints.

domande.hint: The ultimate test of quality is customer satisfaction.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Quarterly is too infrequent and doesn't involve the customer.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Milestone reviews may be far apart.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Pair programming catches bugs as code is written; customer feedback ensures the product satisfies the customer.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Tools and checkpoints, but no customer involvement.

domande.spiegazione: Quality = customer satisfaction: involve the customer while developing the product; pair programming (XP) reduces defects.

domande.domanda: A project manager oversees a software project where the team prioritized a new user authentication system in the current sprint. Midway through, two developers want to divert their efforts to optimizing database queries to prevent future bottlenecks. What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Allocate time for the developers to present their optimization proposal at the next sprint planning meeting.
opzioni.B: Reinforce the importance of adhering to the sprint's primary goal of completing the authentication system.
opzioni.C: Request a special session to assess the impact of the database optimization on future sprints.
opzioni.D: Support the developers by allocating a small portion of their time to preliminary database work.

domande.hint: Once a sprint starts, what changes?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Takes time away from the sprint goal.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Once the sprint starts, keep the team on the sprint goal; the idea can go to the backlog later.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Also takes time away from the sprint goal.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Has them work on something outside the sprint goal.

domande.spiegazione: Agile principle: once a sprint starts, don't change the team or the work. The optimization may be added to the product backlog for a future sprint.

domande.domanda: A project manager overseeing an ERP system decided to combine Scrum and Kanban. The product owner is unsure how to begin organizing and prioritizing work. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Guide the product owner in developing and optimizing a comprehensive product backlog.
opzioni.B: Have team members explain the integration of Scrum and Kanban to the product owner.
opzioni.C: Recommend the project team use visual management tools to improve workflow.
opzioni.D: Teach the product owner how to map out process flows to understand task sequences.

domande.hint: If someone doesn't know how to do their role, don't do it for them: teach them.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Prioritizing work happens in the product backlog: coach the PO on it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Gives away your work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The team never prioritizes the product backlog.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Process flows don't teach prioritization.

domande.spiegazione: Coach people on their roles; organizing and prioritizing work is done in the product backlog by the product owner.

domande.domanda: A project manager leads a critical marketing campaign. After last-minute changes, the team worked overtime to meet tight deadlines. The sponsor allocated a monetary award to recognize the team. What is the most appropriate action?

opzioni.A: Distribute the entire award to the team member who worked the longest hours.
opzioni.B: Organize a team-building retreat to enhance morale for future projects.
opzioni.C: Use the award to fund professional development opportunities that benefit the team in future projects.
opzioni.D: Decide how to distribute the award based on informal team feedback.

domande.hint: Rewards must be fair and public; which option benefits them most in the future?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Unfair: longest hours doesn't mean most work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not bad, but less lasting benefit than development.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Helps them learn and benefits future projects.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Informal, not a clear fair system.

domande.spiegazione: Reward systems must be fair and transparent; professional development benefits the team and future projects.

domande.domanda: A project manager oversees construction of a community recreation center that must be developed quickly. The team is skilled, stakeholders are engaged and the community is excited. What should the project manager do to prioritize time to completion?

opzioni.A: Assign more resources to critical tasks without consulting the team.
opzioni.B: Develop a milestone-based plan ensuring regular stakeholder involvement and communication.
opzioni.C: Monitor daily progress and integrate team input to ensure alignment with project goals.
opzioni.D: Request an extension of the project deadline from the sponsor.

domande.hint: Stakeholder involvement is key to success.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Never act without consulting the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Milestones keep the schedule on track and stakeholder engagement keeps it right.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Daily monitoring takes a lot of time and ignores stakeholders.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. No reason to request an extension.

domande.spiegazione: Stakeholder engagement and involvement is the key to project success; milestones help keep the project on schedule.

domande.domanda: A project manager has begun a complex airport expansion project. Although it is in the initiating phase, the sponsor keeps asking for concrete dates for the key milestones. When will the project manager be able to provide them?

opzioni.A: After the initial risk assessments are completed to estimate timelines.
opzioni.B: At the end of the planning phase, once the detailed schedule and risk assessments are completed.
opzioni.C: During execution, when progress can be measured.
opzioni.D: Once the project charter is signed, as it outlines initial milestones.

domande.hint: Initiating is high level; detail comes from planning.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. An initial risk assessment doesn't give concrete dates.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Planning produces the detailed schedule (WBS, bottom-up estimates, expert judgment).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. No need to wait: that's the point of planning.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The charter authorizes the project but contains only high-level information.

domande.spiegazione: In initiating everything is high level (scope, schedule, budget, risks in the charter); concrete dates come at the end of planning.

domande.domanda: In a hierarchical organization, team members are used to direct instructions and their reviews are based on task completion percentage. The project manager realizes some tasks must be reassigned to meet the next milestone, which could be perceived negatively by current assignees. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Assign the tasks to the most skilled member without further discussion.
opzioni.B: Hold a meeting to explain the changes and collaborate on reassigning tasks.
opzioni.C: Privately ask a senior member to take over the tasks and inform the others.
opzioni.D: Send an email to the team outlining the task changes and the reasoning.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Deciding alone, without the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Confront the issue: meet the team, explain and reassign collaboratively.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Gives away your work and hides things.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Same idea as B, but email is less collaborative than a meeting.

domande.spiegazione: Confront problems, never hide them, and involve people in decisions.

domande.domanda: During a status meeting with city officials on a park renovation, the project manager updates them on a significant deliverable. Some officials claim they were never informed about it. What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Confirm whether the scope statement was updated to include the deliverable.
opzioni.B: Meet with these officials to review the communication plan and clarify the deliverables.
opzioni.C: Check the officials' attendance records at prior meetings.
opzioni.D: Review the project documents to ensure the deliverable was communicated.

domande.hint: Confront the problem with the people involved.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Meet them first to understand what they are referring to.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Meet them, review the communication plan and clarify.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Seems malicious, looking for someone to blame.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Meet them before reviewing documents.

domande.spiegazione: When something negative happens, meet and talk with the people involved; avoid options that look like finding someone to blame.

domande.domanda: A key stakeholder on an office building project complains they never received the structural integrity test status report. Once provided, the stakeholder notices an important aspect was not tested. Which tool should the project manager have used to prevent this?

opzioni.A: Communication log
opzioni.B: Requirements traceability matrix
opzioni.C: Stakeholder register
opzioni.D: Quality management plan

domande.hint: 'Prevent': go back in time. What was the core complaint?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Records communications that happened; it doesn't prevent.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Tracks who gave which requirement.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. It records stakeholders and their communication requirements.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Says how to meet quality requirements, not who receives reports.

domande.spiegazione: The stakeholder register identifies stakeholders and their communication requirements; the communications plan says what, when and how.

domande.domanda: A project manager oversees a new healthcare facility. The team struggles to understand critical aspects of the scope. A senior SME from headquarters is available for one week. What should the project manager do to benefit from the SME's presence?

opzioni.A: Conduct a workshop with the SME to address the team's challenges.
opzioni.B: Discuss with the SME the specific scope issues the team faces.
opzioni.C: Arrange for the SME to provide training sessions to the team.
opzioni.D: Have the SME review the project documentation for alignment.

domande.hint: Be collaborative: who needs to understand the scope?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Seems to be just you and the SME, not the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Again without the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. The SME trains the team so it better understands the scope.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Nothing indicates an alignment problem in the documents.

domande.spiegazione: Involve the team: use the SME to train the people who need the knowledge.

domande.domanda: On an agile CRM project, midway through, the legal team gives feedback on new data protection laws the project may have to comply with. Which two actions should the project manager take next? (Choose two.)

opzioni.A: Direct the product owner to prioritize data protection features in future sprints.
opzioni.B: Request detailed information about the new laws from the legal department.
opzioni.C: Have the legal team implement the compliance measures.
opzioni.D: Plan the immediate integration of compliance requirements to mitigate legal issues.
opzioni.E: Conduct an impact analysis with the team to understand how the law affects the project.

domande.hint: Understand the law and its impact before acting.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. An action taken before understanding the law and its impact.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. First learn what the law is about.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Legal doesn't implement project work, and it's premature.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Implementing before understanding the impact.
spiegazioni_opzioni.E: Correct. Assess how it affects the project before acting.

domande.spiegazione: Don't act right away: learn about the law and analyze its impact; then involve the product owner and plan the integration.
domande.nota: Multiple-choice question (choose two). The instructor first says 'B and C', then confirms B and E.

domande.domanda: A project manager starts a software project for a client known for vague requirements and challenging communication; past interactions led to scope misunderstandings. What strategy should be implemented to prevent this?

opzioni.A: Apply a phased development approach to validate scope at each milestone.
opzioni.B: Collaborate with the product owner to establish a clear minimum viable product.
opzioni.C: Enhance team-client communication protocols for better clarity and feedback.
opzioni.D: Implement a strict deliverable schedule to force clarity and client interaction.

domande.hint: How do you beat vague requirements?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Milestones can take a long time.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. An MVP gives the client something usable to react to, driving clear feedback.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Good, but giving them a product to use is better than just talking.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Never force people.

domande.spiegazione: The best way to beat vague requirements is an MVP: basic usable functionality the client uses and gives feedback on.

domande.domanda: Midway through a software project following a predictive life cycle, a significant portion is set for incremental delivery. The experienced team for this portion wants to take on more decision-making traditionally handled by the PM after each delivery. What should you do?

opzioni.A: Schedule a meeting with senior management to seek guidance on adjusting the decision-making process.
opzioni.B: Support the team's initiative to take on decision-making while retaining final approval authority.
opzioni.C: Maintain the traditional structure where the PM makes all decisions regardless of team readiness.
opzioni.D: Consult the sponsor to explore delegating key post-delivery decisions to the team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Never go to senior management for guidance: they hired you.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Support the team, but on a predictive project keep final approval.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Doing nothing: leaving things as they are is not the answer.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The sponsor wants outputs, not to help you run the project.

domande.spiegazione: Never give away your work; support the team while, on a predictive project, keeping the final decision.

domande.domanda: The product owner released an MVP of a new software tool. A key stakeholder, the VP of marketing, is unhappy with the limited features. What should the project manager do to ensure better satisfaction in future releases?

opzioni.A: Work with the team and stakeholders to adjust future release timelines based on expectations.
opzioni.B: Set up a process where stakeholders can provide feedback before future releases are finalized.
opzioni.C: Take control of communication with stakeholders to ensure everyone understands.
opzioni.D: Ask the sponsor to resolve the disagreement between the product owner and the VP of marketing.

domande.hint: Agile project (MVP): be a collaborative servant leader.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Collaborates with team and stakeholders on future releases.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Good idea, but you set it up alone, without the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. 'Taking control' is not servant leadership.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Never give away your work to the sponsor.

domande.spiegazione: Always collaborate: work with the team and stakeholders rather than acting alone or escalating.

domande.domanda: On an agile mobile app project, the PM planned email for all communications. The product owner suggests a specialized project management tool that integrates better with agile workflows. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Evaluate how the new tool could affect timelines and workflow before deciding.
opzioni.B: Update the communication plan to fully adopt the PO's tool and inform the team.
opzioni.C: Have the team test the proposed tool on a small part of the project before deciding whether to implement it.
opzioni.D: Keep email for major announcements but use the new tool for daily agile interactions.

domande.hint: Who should decide on the team's tools?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. You evaluate and decide alone.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Implements it bypassing the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Let the team test it and decide whether it fits.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. You decide alone and give the PO little.

domande.spiegazione: Servant leadership: let the team try the tool and decide.

domande.domanda: During development of a cloud analytics platform, the team raises concerns about product backlog items that are hard to implement due to technical and resource limitations. What should the project manager recommend the product owner do?

opzioni.A: Prioritize and address the impediments based on their impact on the platform's most valuable features.
opzioni.B: Conduct a risk assessment to evaluate how the impediments might affect the timeline.
opzioni.C: Implement a phase-based approach, starting with issues impacting the current sprint.
opzioni.D: Remove those items and add new ones.

domande.hint: What is the product owner responsible for?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. The PO prioritizes the backlog: reprioritize based on impact on the most valuable features.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Risk assessment is for you and the team, not the PO.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Nothing indicates the current sprint is affected.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Never just remove high-value items because of problems.

domande.spiegazione: The product owner's job is prioritizing the product backlog; coach them to factor in the impediments.

domande.domanda: A project manager new to agile sees other projects stumble without a well-defined scope and completion criteria, leading to continuous scope expansion. What proactive step should they take to establish clarity and prevent scope creep?

opzioni.A: Create a detailed timeline with milestones to monitor progress and control changes.
opzioni.B: Introduce a rigorous change management process to evaluate and approve features.
opzioni.C: Promote regular synchronization meetings to discuss the schedule and what to do first.
opzioni.D: Organize workshops with all stakeholders to collaboratively create the project charter and clearly define the definition of done.

domande.hint: Agile: what defines when work is complete?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. About schedule, not scope clarity.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Agile doesn't use rigorous change control.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Focused on schedule, not scope.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. A shared charter and a clear definition of done give scope clarity.

domande.spiegazione: The definition of done clarifies when work is finished; involve stakeholders to build it.

domande.domanda: Throughout a project it becomes apparent that team members from different departments have different perspectives on what the final outcome should be. What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Facilitate a session to revisit and clarify the project goal with the entire team.
opzioni.B: Meet with the sponsor to ensure alignment with the project objectives.
opzioni.C: Make sure the project outcome is aligned with the charter and scope statement.
opzioni.D: Assign department heads the responsibility to resolve the issue.

domande.hint: Bring people together and solve the problem.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Bring everyone together so they understand the goal.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The sponsor already knows the objectives: the problem is in the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Doesn't address the team's differing views.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Gives the problem away; it's about team members, not department heads.

domande.spiegazione: Never run from or push away a problem: bring people together and resolve it.

domande.domanda: A project manager oversees construction of a manufacturing facility when an economic downturn may suddenly threaten the project's viability. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Adjust the financial forecast to account for the downturn.
opzioni.B: Suggest to the sponsor that the project be postponed.
opzioni.C: Redirect some resources to support other essential projects.
opzioni.D: Identify and document the new risk and create mitigation strategies.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. An action that would need a change request on a traditional project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Never postpone a project without assessing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Basically shutting the project down.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. It's a risk: record it in the risk register and plan responses.

domande.spiegazione: 'May/might' indicates a risk; 'has happened/will' an issue. Don't take drastic action right away.

domande.domanda: A project manager is starting a highway expansion. The state requested an initial environmental impact assessment, after which they'll decide whether to continue. A team member suggests planning the full project based on past trends. What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Advise the team member to focus on the current deliverable.
opzioni.B: Review the charter to confirm the high-level scope.
opzioni.C: Develop a detailed plan for the entire project based on history.
opzioni.D: Confirm with stakeholders and plan the full project scope.

domande.hint: Still initiating, and continuation depends on the assessment.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Shuts the team member down: doing nothing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Review and confirm the high-level scope while waiting for the assessment.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Premature: you must wait for the assessment.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. An action taken before the go/no-go decision.

domande.spiegazione: 'First' is never to take a big action: review and assess. Detailed planning must wait for the assessment.

domande.domanda: A project manager oversees an upgrade of an old manufacturing system to an automated solution. The charter is approved and the PMO has provided templates. What should the project manager prioritize?

opzioni.A: Align the project plan with strategic goals, working closely with senior management.
opzioni.B: Develop a training and communication management plan to enhance collaboration with the team.
opzioni.C: Create a detailed budget and schedule regular reviews with the finance team.
opzioni.D: Collaborate with operations to minimize disruption during the upgrade.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Senior management doesn't build detailed plans with you.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Plan with the team: good communication is the basis of collaboration.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. You budget with your team, not finance.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Operations isn't who you build the plan with.

domande.spiegazione: Not a perfect answer, but the best of the four: plan with your team. Choose the best option, not the perfect one.
domande.nota: The instructor: 'not the best answer in absolute terms, but the best of these four'.

domande.domanda: A project manager has completed a new city park and is preparing to transition it to the city maintenance department. Before closing the project, what should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Verify that all project deliverables were met according to the plan.
opzioni.B: Conduct a final inspection with the sponsor to ensure all WBS tasks are complete.
opzioni.C: Ensure all project documentation is completed and archived.
opzioni.D: Conduct a final performance review with stakeholders.

domande.hint: 'Before closing': which process comes before closing?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Also part of closing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Validate scope (inspection with customer/sponsor) comes before closing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. That's done in closing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Project performance review is in closing.

domande.spiegazione: Before closing: control quality, then validate scope (inspection with the sponsor/customer gives accepted deliverables).

domande.domanda: A project manager must prioritize multiple projects in a portfolio and needs accurate budget estimates, aligned with agile principles. How should the budget for each project be estimated?

opzioni.A: Calculate the cost from the team's individual task estimates, considering the current workload.
opzioni.B: Leverage the combined expertise of the sponsor, product owner and agile coach to derive estimates.
opzioni.C: Use analytical software to model costs based on predictive analysis and history.
opzioni.D: Have the product owner conduct a requirements analysis with the team to forecast the budget.

domande.hint: Agile projects are mostly people cost.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Agile cost is driven by the team: who, how long and how many sprints.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The real cost lies in what you pay the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Predictive modeling isn't the agile way.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Gives away your work.

domande.spiegazione: Agile estimating: cost is heavily people-based (team cost × duration/sprints).

domande.domanda: On a large agile e-commerce project, in the retrospective the team says the product owner's expectations for sprint deliverables were not fully met. What proactive measure should the project manager have taken?

opzioni.A: Initiate a kickoff workshop to train all team members on agile tools and techniques.
opzioni.B: Establish a risk framework addressing misalignment between team outputs and stakeholders.
opzioni.C: Develop an integration plan aligning development with marketing and sales strategy.
opzioni.D: Ensure the project vision and objectives of each sprint were communicated to all team members.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Kickoffs happen once at the start; not this issue.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. It already happened: not a risk.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The PO's expectations, not marketing and sales.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Clear vision and sprint objectives tell the team what to accomplish.

domande.spiegazione: Read whether the question wants a forward fix or what should have been done: here, clarify vision and sprint goals.

domande.domanda: Leading a customer support software project, developers encounter ambiguity in a feature's acceptance criteria during a sprint. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Request a meeting with the steering committee to discuss the feature.
opzioni.B: Initiate a discussion at the next team meeting to gather collective input.
opzioni.C: Refer the question to the technical architect for an expert interpretation.
opzioni.D: Collaborate with the product owner to resolve the ambiguity in the acceptance criteria.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Acceptance criteria don't come from the steering committee.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The issue is between team and PO, not within the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Go to the product owner, not an architect.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. The PO defines the work and its acceptance criteria.

domande.spiegazione: The product owner defines the work and acceptance criteria.

domande.domanda: During execution of a development project, the team hits a technical challenge that jeopardizes delivery of key functionality; the technical team indicates a delay. What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Schedule an emergency meeting with all stakeholders to brainstorm solutions.
opzioni.B: Initiate a quick training session for the technical team on problem-solving.
opzioni.C: Record the problem, its impact and urgency in the issue log for structured tracking.
opzioni.D: Organize a team-building event to boost morale and innovative thinking.

domande.hint: It's already happening: risk or issue?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. 'All' stakeholders is too broad; work with the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The PM generally lacks the technical skills to train a technical team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. It's an issue: log it with impact and urgency.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Nothing says morale is low.

domande.spiegazione: An issue goes in the issue log. Beware the word 'all' in options.

domande.domanda: During a pivotal phase, it emerges that critical stakeholders did not attend the meeting confirming strategic alignment and expected benefits, so their feedback was overlooked; this led to conflicts in decision-making. What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Initiate a discussion to directly address and understand their concerns.
opzioni.B: Distribute a detailed meeting summary and request written feedback from the absent stakeholders.
opzioni.C: Conduct a formal risk assessment of the impact of missing stakeholder input.
opzioni.D: Develop a contingency plan for potential delays or changes.

domande.hint: There is conflict: bring people together.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Directly address and understand the root cause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Sounds negative ('you weren't here').
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. It already happened: an issue, not a risk.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. No delays have been mentioned yet.

domande.spiegazione: Understand the problem before solving it: address the conflict directly.

domande.domanda: During a critical phase, a pivotal team member tells the PM they intend to resign and will submit notice to their line manager soon, at a time their contribution is critical to an upcoming deadline. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Have a senior team member hold a meeting to reassess task allocation.
opzioni.B: Update the risk register to reflect the potential impact on the timeline.
opzioni.C: Brief stakeholders to set realistic expectations about delays.
opzioni.D: Proactively collaborate with other members to formulate a transition plan and mitigate disruption.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Gives away your work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Assessed alone and only on timeline; scope may be affected too.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. You don't know there will be a delay yet.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Work with the team on a transition plan: they may absorb the work.

domande.spiegazione: Work with the team proactively; don't assume delays before involving them.

domande.domanda: On a software project, the team uses time tracking where 1 hour = 1 point. Some tasks are 5 points, others up to 200. To improve accuracy and scheduling, what should the project manager encourage?

opzioni.A: Recommend dividing tasks into subtasks to improve manageability and estimation accuracy.
opzioni.B: Have the team use a new estimating technique that better reflects complexity.
opzioni.C: Encourage a fixed-point system for all tasks.
opzioni.D: Have the team recalibrate the point system to differentiate simple and complex tasks.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Decomposition improves estimate accuracy (agile and traditional).
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Telling the team what to do.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. A fixed point for all tasks makes no sense.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Telling the team what to do.

domande.spiegazione: Recommend, don't dictate; decompose large items for better estimates.

domande.domanda: A tech startup aims to launch an app by summer, but in early planning there is uncertainty about specifications: they don't know how stakeholders will use the product. What should the project manager do to stay on track?

opzioni.A: Incorporate insights from technology consultants.
opzioni.B: Establish a comprehensive risk framework to mitigate potential delays.
opzioni.C: Assess the team and propose a minimum viable product.
opzioni.D: Organize workshops with the team to solidify technical requirements.

domande.hint: What addresses uncertainty about how users will use it?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Uncertainty is resolved by customers, not consultants.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Focuses on delays; the problem is scope.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. An MVP gets real users' feedback on what to change.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The team needs to work with customers, not alone.

domande.spiegazione: An MVP is one of the best ways to address uncertainty: release basic usable features and learn from users.

domande.domanda: During a large event planning project, the team keeps reporting logistical challenges that are acknowledged in meetings but rarely resolved, creating potential risks to the event's success. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Schedule additional planning sessions focused on logistics.
opzioni.B: Assign a dedicated team solely to resolve logistical issues.
opzioni.C: Prioritize the logistical challenges based on their potential impact on the event.
opzioni.D: Increase the frequency of team meetings for more updates.

domande.hint: Potential risks: what's the next step after identifying them?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. More planning sessions aren't needed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Gives away the work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Risks must be prioritized by impact.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. More meetings won't solve them.

domande.spiegazione: Identified risks must be prioritized by impact. Best of the four (ideally with the team).

domande.domanda: During execution of an urban development project, the PM sends email updates to all stakeholders. Feedback says the information is either too technical or too general. What should you do first?

opzioni.A: Initiate one-on-one briefings for stakeholders needing detail.
opzioni.B: Organize a workshop to keep them informed.
opzioni.C: Evaluate the specific needs of the stakeholders.
opzioni.D: Launch a project blog with varying levels of detail.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Would take forever with many stakeholders.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Some may want it, some may not.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. First understand each stakeholder's needs.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Possible later, after evaluating needs.

domande.spiegazione: Communication must be tailored: first evaluate stakeholders' information needs.

domande.domanda: During deployment of a telecom network, the project encounters significant delays. What should the project manager do to identify and mitigate them?

opzioni.A: Increase the frequency of status meetings.
opzioni.B: Reallocate resources to the most delayed aspects.
opzioni.C: Adjust the timeline to accommodate the delays.
opzioni.D: Facilitate a collaborative session with the team to pinpoint and tackle the delays.

domande.hint: Problem on the project: who helps you?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Without working with the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Never reallocate without the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Needs a change request on a traditional project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Ask the team to help find and fix the causes.

domande.spiegazione: When there's a problem, ask the team to help solve it.

domande.domanda: A key stakeholder asks for a critical infrastructure component two weeks early. The PM determines this is possible by overlapping certain processes. What is the most effective course of action?

opzioni.A: Re-evaluate the scope to postpone non-essential elements.
opzioni.B: Adjust the timeline by resequencing work to allow parallel activities.
opzioni.C: Increase the budget for overtime and additional resources.
opzioni.D: Use advanced technology to automate construction processes.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Postponing scope needs a change request.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Fast tracking: shorter time, more risk, generally no extra cost.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. That's crashing and needs a change request.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Beyond the question's scope.

domande.spiegazione: Fast tracking overlaps activities; it doesn't usually raise cost. Resequencing without extending the schedule needs no change request.

domande.domanda: At the start of a software project, the PM must devise a strategy for assessing each developer's contribution, to be presented to leadership at the end. What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Arrange regular one-on-one meetings with each developer to document progress.
opzioni.B: Develop clear, quantifiable criteria for evaluating performance and communicate them to the team.
opzioni.C: Use metrics like lines of code to directly measure productivity.
opzioni.D: Conduct anonymous surveys among team members on individual contributions.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Possible later, after defining criteria.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Clear, measurable criteria known by all are fair and transparent.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Lines of code don't measure productivity fairly.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Team members evaluating each other; criteria come first.

domande.spiegazione: Be fair and transparent: define clear, quantifiable criteria and communicate them before assessing.

domande.domanda: At the start of an environmental conservation project, a key stakeholder fears the approach won't meet environmental goals and will exceed the initial forecast. What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Organize a meeting with the stakeholder to understand the concerns and identify potential improvements.
opzioni.B: Launch a pilot phase to demonstrate effectiveness and adjust.
opzioni.C: Enhance communication with regular updates and more involvement in planning.
opzioni.D: Outline the long-term benefits and sustainability impacts of the project.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Meet them and understand the concern before acting.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. An action without understanding the concern.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The problem isn't communication but the approach.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Addresses objectives, not the approach.

domande.spiegazione: When a stakeholder has a concern, meet them and assess before acting.

domande.domanda: Implementing a healthcare IT system, the initial hardware upgrade phase is behind schedule, impacting the software phase because technical teams are shared. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Negotiate with other PMs for temporary resource sharing to expedite the hardware upgrade.
opzioni.B: Initiate an assessment of the delay's impact on the overall project.
opzioni.C: Implement a reward system to incentivize faster completion.
opzioni.D: Engage a consultant to streamline the hardware upgrade.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. An action before knowing the impact.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Understand how it affects the project (time, cost...) first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. An action before knowing the impact.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. An action before knowing the impact.

domande.spiegazione: Assess the impact before taking action.

domande.domanda: Midway through a renewable energy project, the design team and environmental consultants clash over turbine placement: better energy output versus ecological disruption. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Proceed with the design team's recommendation.
opzioni.B: Organize a collaborative session to discuss impacts and find a compromise.
opzioni.C: Commission an independent review of the placement.
opzioni.D: Postpone the decision until further data is available.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Choosing a side is forcing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Bring them together to work out a solution.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Deciding without them.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Kicking the can down the road.

domande.spiegazione: With conflicts between people, help them resolve it together; don't pick a side.

domande.domanda: After a new project starts executing, an executive suggests adding an add-on to give the product more functionality. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Update the product immediately to include it without formal approval.
opzioni.B: Note the suggestion in a separate risk assessment document.
opzioni.C: Integrate the executive's feedback into an appendix of the current report.
opzioni.D: Encourage the executive to formalize the suggestion through the change request process.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The PM doesn't approve scope changes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Doesn't deal with the add-on.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Doesn't deal with the add-on.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Scope changes go through change control.

domande.spiegazione: On a traditional project, scope changes go through change control; the PM doesn't approve or reject them.

domande.domanda: At the start of an urban regeneration project, morale is high but meetings often diverge into unrelated conversations, overrunning and postponing decisions. What is the most effective initial action?

opzioni.A: Schedule shorter meetings.
opzioni.B: Designate a timekeeper.
opzioni.C: Emphasize the meeting objectives and agenda at the start of each session.
opzioni.D: Introduce a digital platform for non-project discussions.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. More drastic.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Possible later.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. The simplest first step: remind everyone what must be done.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Drastic, new software.

domande.spiegazione: The initial action should be the least drastic: restate objectives and agenda.

domande.domanda: In progress sessions for a multinational project, a highly knowledgeable technical analyst rarely contributes to group discussions despite engaging in private conversations. What should you do?

opzioni.A: Schedule a dedicated session where only the analyst presents findings to the team.
opzioni.B: Actively solicit the analyst's input during meetings, emphasizing the value of their expertise.
opzioni.C: Create an anonymous feedback mechanism for the analyst.
opzioni.D: Wait for the analyst to become more comfortable over time.

domande.hint: The goal: the analyst contributes in group discussions.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Takes them out of the normal discussion.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Engage them directly in meetings: they talk when asked.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. If only the analyst uses it, it isn't anonymous.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Doing nothing.

domande.spiegazione: Answer what the question asks: get the analyst contributing in meetings.

domande.domanda: Just before the final review of a software project, QA reports several key features don't meet the specifications agreed with the client; fixing them would delay delivery by weeks. What should you do next?

opzioni.A: Prioritize work to meet the specs, accepting the timeline may need extending.
opzioni.B: Suggest a partial delivery with non-compliant features fixed later.
opzioni.C: Propose a compromise on specifications, reducing scope.
opzioni.D: Consult the development team to find a faster solution that reduces the delay while meeting the specifications.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Prioritizing isn't the PM's decision.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Needs the sponsor/customer approval.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The PM can't reduce scope.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Ask the team whether it can be done faster first.

domande.spiegazione: Before going to the client, work with the team on solutions. The PM can't cut scope.

domande.domanda: During a critical phase of an agile project, the only specialist able to design a key component must take extended medical leave. What proactive measure could the PM have taken?

opzioni.A: Build a cross-functional team.
opzioni.B: Distribute the specialist's tasks among several members from the project's onset.
opzioni.C: Allocate additional funds to hire temporary specialists if needed.
opzioni.D: Establish a comprehensive documentation practice for all project tasks.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Generalizing specialists can help each other, removing bottlenecks.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. You couldn't predict who would leave.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Only if foreseen in the risk assessment.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Good, but a cross-functional team is better.

domande.spiegazione: Agile teams should be cross-functional (generalizing specialists).
domande.nota: Options reconstructed from the transcript (letter order partly inferred).

domande.domanda: In planning a large software project, the PM wants an extensive analysis of timeline and budget risks: the likelihood of completing within parameters and which variables most affect the outcome, using many different perspectives. Which technique?

opzioni.A: Develop a risk breakdown structure.
opzioni.B: Conduct a sensitivity analysis.
opzioni.C: Use a cause-and-effect diagram.
opzioni.D: Run a Monte Carlo simulation.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Only categorizes risks.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Ranks impacts but not many scenarios.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Shows causes of failure (fishbone).
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Simulates many scenarios and outcomes.

domande.spiegazione: Monte Carlo simulates many different scenarios and their effect on the project.

domande.domanda: On a new CRM project, the PM learns that upcoming regulatory changes will affect data handling; they'll be enforced shortly after planned completion. What is the most appropriate action to ensure compliance?

opzioni.A: Add the regulations to the risk log for future analysis.
opzioni.B: Plan to address them in the next CRM system development.
opzioni.C: Integrate discussion of the regulatory changes into the project phases.
opzioni.D: Request detailed information and make changes at the next product update meeting.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. It will happen: not a risk.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Don't wait for the next system.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Start incorporating the regulation now.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Don't wait for the next update.

domande.spiegazione: Something certain is not a risk. Laws must be followed: incorporate them into the current work.

domande.domanda: During a mobile app project, the PM faces significant uncertainty about user preferences and the effectiveness of proposed features; initial user feedback is inconclusive. What is the best course of action to align with users' expectations?

opzioni.A: Finish developing the application, then correct features not aligned with users.
opzioni.B: Proceed with creating a minimum viable product (MVP).
opzioni.C: Pause development until a comprehensive market analysis is complete.
opzioni.D: Instruct the team to incorporate the most popular features in the application.

domande.hint: How do you learn whether features are effective?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Kicks the can down the road.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. An MVP lets users try core features and give feedback.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Never pause a project unless safety or legality is at stake.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Popular doesn't mean effective.

domande.spiegazione: An MVP is usable but minimal: users use it and tell you what works, reducing uncertainty.

domande.domanda: Anticipating new environmental regulations, a manufacturing project with two teams (one traditional, one green technology) must evaluate the impact on combined operations. What is the most effective action to ensure compliance and seamless integration?

opzioni.A: Organize a collaborative workshop with representatives from both teams to discuss compliance strategies.
opzioni.B: Conduct separate workshops for each team.
opzioni.C: Hold individual strategy sessions with each team, then a joint session.
opzioni.D: Assemble a panel of regulatory experts to advise both teams.

domande.hint: The PM is a facilitator: bring people together.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Both teams work together on the combined operation.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Separates the teams.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Longer, and ends in a joint session anyway.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The teams must work out the implementation themselves.

domande.spiegazione: Be a facilitator: bring people together to collaborate.

domande.domanda: Following a recommendation from the founder, a PM adopts servant leadership to foster cooperation and exceptional performance. What should the PM do to embody servant leadership?

opzioni.A: Implement a competitive reward system to incentivize individual excellence.
opzioni.B: Direct the team to refine strategies until they devise an unbeatable plan.
opzioni.C: Evaluate the scope meticulously and set clear prioritized goals for the team.
opzioni.D: Establish clear project goals and nurture a supportive environment that enables members to contribute to their fullest potential.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Competition between members isn't servant leadership.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Directing, not supporting.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The PM sets goals for the team: directive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Supporting the team and enabling it.

domande.spiegazione: Servant leaders support self-directing teams rather than directing them.

domande.domanda: During a critical phase of a remotely operated environmental research project, a key analyst departs and a new member joins who lacks familiarity with the project's specific challenges; documentation exists but the project is complex. What proactive measure ensures effective integration of new members?

opzioni.A: Arrange for the new member to shadow an experienced team member.
opzioni.B: Encourage the new member to study the documentation, followed by a session on their role.
opzioni.C: Schedule training webinars on the project's methodology and technologies.
opzioni.D: Facilitate a workshop with the team on the project's complexities, with all current and new members attending.

domande.hint: Which option brings the team together with the new member?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Gives the work away to one person.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Leaves the person studying alone.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Time-consuming and may not engage them.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. The whole team works with the new member.

domande.spiegazione: Follow the mindset: integrate newcomers through the team, not alone.

domande.domanda: In a routine progress check, an agile PM notices a lead analyst habitually passes less complex analysis work to newer members, claiming it lets them focus on intricate aspects. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Develop a rotational task assignment system.
opzioni.B: Directly assign tasks based on complexity.
opzioni.C: Establish a mentorship program where seniors guide juniors through complex tasks.
opzioni.D: Discuss at the next team meeting to evaluate the effectiveness of the current delegation method.

domande.hint: The team chose this approach: is it effective?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Imposes your way.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Directive PM.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Telling them what to do.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Let the team evaluate whether its method works.

domande.spiegazione: The team is self-organizing; don't shut down its practices, evaluate them together.

domande.domanda: As a critical e-commerce update nears completion, stakeholders request additional features that would greatly improve customer experience but require extensive extra work, potentially affecting the launch. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Expedite by incorporating the features into the plan.
opzioni.B: Calculate the additional cost and request an immediate budget increase.
opzioni.C: Reject the request outright to maintain focus.
opzioni.D: Discuss implementation with the development team and present feasible solutions to stakeholders.

domande.hint: Analyze the change with the team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Don't incorporate without analysis.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Analyzes, but alone.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Never reject outright.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Analyze with the team, then present options.

domande.spiegazione: Never reject; analyze changes together with the team.

domande.domanda: In an international public health project, government partners are skeptical about achieving the project's goals due to limited visibility into progress. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Start a monthly newsletter on milestones and challenges.
opzioni.B: Hold workshops with beneficiaries to showcase impact.
opzioni.C: Organize a virtual meeting with government partners to ask how they would like updates and answer questions.
opzioni.D: Distribute a quarterly comprehensive report.

domande.hint: Who knows what's best for them?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. You decide for them.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. You decide for them.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Ask them how they want to be updated.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. You decide for them.

domande.spiegazione: Ask stakeholders how they want to receive information.

domande.domanda: During an agile mobile banking app project, a regulatory update requires adjustments to several key features. The PM meets the compliance officer, new to the project. What should the PM do to integrate these updates into scope efficiently?

opzioni.A: Ask the compliance officer to formalize the updates in writing for Change Control Board approval.
opzioni.B: Encourage the compliance officer to detail the regulatory changes for inclusion in the product backlog.
opzioni.C: Have the compliance officer communicate the changes to the team at the next daily scrum.
opzioni.D: Ask the compliance officer to assess the plan and suggest modifications.

domande.hint: Agile: where must work be to get done?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. No CCB on agile projects.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Work must be in the product backlog to be done (ideally via the PO).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The daily scrum isn't for introducing new work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The compliance officer isn't a PM.

domande.spiegazione: Agile scope changes go into the product backlog; the daily scrum only answers the three questions.

domande.domanda: Integration is more cumbersome than expected, slowing progress, mainly due to a newly implemented IT protocol designed to enhance security. What should you do next?

opzioni.A: Introduce additional training on the new IT protocol.
opzioni.B: Require the team to double their efforts despite the protocol.
opzioni.C: Organize a workshop to find workarounds that don't compromise security.
opzioni.D: Initiate discussions with IT leadership and the team to understand the protocol and how best to facilitate the project.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Possible later.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Never overwork people.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Don't work around protocols before understanding them.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Meet everyone to understand first.

domande.spiegazione: 'Next/first' questions ask you to order the options: understand first, then act.

domande.domanda: On an app project, a stakeholder requests a feature mirroring something built in a previous sprint and wants a quick estimate of its schedule and cost impact. What should you do?

opzioni.A: Compare it to the total budget, adjusted by the proportion of work completed.
opzioni.B: Meet with the product owner to help with the estimate.
opzioni.C: Review the user stories and velocity metrics from the previous sprint for the similar feature to estimate the effort.
opzioni.D: Initiate a detailed risk analysis focused on schedule and budget overruns.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not quick nor accurate.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The PO doesn't estimate: you and the team do.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Uses actual data on similar work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Takes too long.

domande.spiegazione: Best of four (ideally ask the team): estimate from velocity and similar past stories.
domande.nota: The instructor: none is perfect (best would be to ask the team), C is the best of the four.

domande.domanda: In a complex software project, the PM notices significant variances between planned and actual performance metrics; key deliverables risk delay. What should the PM do first?

opzioni.A: Adjust the timeline and communicate the changes.
opzioni.B: Conduct a detailed analysis of performance data to identify root causes.
opzioni.C: Request additional resources.
opzioni.D: Reassess the project management strategies.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Changes without knowing the problem.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Find the root cause first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Resources without knowing the problem.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not specific to the variance.

domande.spiegazione: Don't act first: analyze the problem.

domande.domanda: On a large infrastructure project, sudden regulatory changes could potentially impact scope and cost. The project is on track but adjustments may be needed. What should you do first?

opzioni.A: Update the budget and timeline based on a preliminary assessment.
opzioni.B: Initiate a stakeholder meeting to discuss impacts and adjustments.
opzioni.C: Conduct a comprehensive review of the regulatory changes to assess their impact.
opzioni.D: Implement the regulatory changes.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Never update based on a preliminary assessment.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Analyze before meeting stakeholders.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Analyze how it affects scope, budget and schedule.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Never implement before analyzing.

domande.spiegazione: 'First' is rarely to fix: analyze what is being asked.
domande.nota: Option text reconstructed from the transcript.
