domande.domanda: An office building project is over budget due to high material costs. The team suggests cheaper materials, simplifying the design or eliminating non-essential features. Which approach addresses cost while ensuring the building meets its purpose?

opzioni.A: Value engineering
opzioni.B: Critical path method
opzioni.C: Earned value
opzioni.D: Monte Carlo simulation

domande.hint: Deliver what the customer wants in the most cost-effective way.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Delivering the required functions at the lowest cost.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Builds the schedule.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Tracks budget performance.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Simulates scenarios.

domande.spiegazione: Value engineering: deliver the required scope/functions in the most cost-effective way.
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed: the instructor reads the options inconsistently and then says 'A is the best answer'.

domande.domanda: During a project charter review, a dispute arises between the sponsor and the product owner in front of the team and other stakeholders. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Propose a follow-up session after the meeting.
opzioni.B: Facilitate the meeting actively using conflict resolution strategies to manage the dispute and maintain cohesion.
opzioni.C: Adjourn immediately and suggest a cooling-off period.
opzioni.D: Arrange a separate session with a neutral facilitator.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Postpones.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Confront and manage the conflict now: managed conflict is healthy.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Withdrawing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Postpones and gives it away.

domande.spiegazione: Take a confronting approach; managed conflict is good.
domande.nota: The instructor says 'D' but describes option B and concludes 'B best answer'.

domande.domanda: A PM uses a risk breakdown structure (RBS) for an infrastructure project; the team fears it may become overly complex. What should the PM do to create an effective, manageable RBS?

opzioni.A: Develop a simple scheme including only high-priority risks.
opzioni.B: Adapt an existing RBS from a similar project.
opzioni.C: Create a detailed RBS with many subcategories.
opzioni.D: Involve key stakeholders in developing the RBS.

domande.hint: The RBS categorizes risks; who helps build it?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The RBS categorizes all risks, not just high-priority ones.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Every project is unique.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. May become too complex.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. More people involved = better coverage and manageability.

domande.spiegazione: The RBS categorizes risks (risks themselves are in the register). Involve stakeholders.

domande.domanda: On a construction project, the PM applies value engineering to improve the function-to-cost ratio. What should the PM do first?

opzioni.A: Have the team brainstorm functions to remove to cut costs.
opzioni.B: Focus solely on cutting costs even if functionality suffers.
opzioni.C: Engage stakeholders to understand the critical functions.
opzioni.D: Implement all proposed changes immediately.

domande.hint: Value engineering keeps functions the same.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Removing functions isn't value engineering.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Never compromise functionality.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Understand the functions before optimizing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Never implement all changes blindly.

domande.spiegazione: Value engineering delivers the same functions more cheaply: first understand the critical functions.

domande.domanda: In a value engineering workshop, a team member suggests a cheaper component that slightly reduces performance but saves significant money. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Approve it since it reduces cost.
opzioni.B: Reject it since it reduces performance.
opzioni.C: Evaluate whether the reduction in performance impacts the project's functionality.
opzioni.D: Implement it if it doesn't require stakeholder approval.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Never approve without evaluating.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Never reject without evaluating.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Evaluate the impact on functionality.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Never implement without evaluating.

domande.spiegazione: Never approve, reject or implement a change without evaluating it.

domande.domanda: A large infrastructure project faces delays. The team has used EVM to track progress. What should the PM do to forecast the completion date accurately?

opzioni.A: Apply the SPI to the remaining work and calculate an estimate at completion.
opzioni.B: Run a Monte Carlo simulation.
opzioni.C: Use CPM to re-evaluate the timeline.
opzioni.D: Implement rolling wave planning.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. SPI with EAC forecasts schedule.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Used more to build than forecast.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Builds the schedule.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Planning technique.

domande.spiegazione: EVM: SPI and EAC can forecast completion.

domande.domanda: Midway through a software project, progress lags the plan; the sponsor worries about the next milestone. What technique addresses this and predicts completion?

opzioni.A: Trend analysis using historical data.
opzioni.B: Apply EVM to calculate the variances and forecast.
opzioni.C: Three-point estimating for future tasks.
opzioni.D: Resource leveling analysis.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Only historical.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. EVM uses current performance to forecast.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Estimates durations, doesn't forecast.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Prevents over-allocation.

domande.spiegazione: EVM (EAC) forecasts using current performance.

domande.domanda: A construction project has significant delays from many unforeseen weather conditions. The PM must predict the potential impact on completion dates. Which approach?

opzioni.A: Update the Gantt chart and adjust manually.
opzioni.B: Use a Monte Carlo simulation to predict the probability of various completion dates.
opzioni.C: Apply CPM to fast track activities.
opzioni.D: Perform a cost-benefit analysis on hiring resources.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Doesn't model scenarios.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Simulates many scenarios.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Builds the schedule.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Premature.

domande.spiegazione: Many scenarios → Monte Carlo.

domande.domanda: A PM prepares for a quality audit of a software project. What is the most effective action after the audit?

opzioni.A: Provide the team all documents to review.
opzioni.B: Prepare the team to answer audit questions.
opzioni.C: Collaborate with the team to understand the findings and develop corrective actions.
opzioni.D: Present the project's successes.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. During the audit.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Before the audit.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. After the audit: act on the findings.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not related to the audit.

domande.spiegazione: Read carefully: after the audit you act on the findings with the team.

domande.domanda: During execution of a manufacturing project, an internal audit reveals non-conformances identified as potential risks. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Halt production until all are resolved.
opzioni.B: Develop and implement corrective actions for the non-conformances.
opzioni.C: Dismiss them as minor.
opzioni.D: Inform the sponsor and request resources.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Only halt for safety or legal issues.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Fix the problem with corrective actions.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Never ignore.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The sponsor hired you to solve problems.

domande.spiegazione: Fix the problem; don't halt, ignore or escalate.

domande.domanda: Midway through an infrastructure project, an external audit highlights significant non-conformances that could impact time and budget. What should you do?

opzioni.A: Continue with the plan and monitor.
opzioni.B: Ask the sponsor to review the report.
opzioni.C: Adjust the scope for the non-conformances.
opzioni.D: Integrate the recommended corrective actions from the audit report into the plan.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Doing nothing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Don't go to the sponsor for guidance.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Scope changes need approval.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Act on the findings.

domande.spiegazione: Choose the best of the four, not a perfect answer.
domande.nota: The instructor: 'the least of the suckiest answer'.

domande.domanda: Preparing a mobile app project, a senior executive worries the project may not align with strategic goals. What should you do next?

opzioni.A: Reassure them the team can deliver on time and budget.
opzioni.B: Review the project's alignment with strategic goals.
opzioni.C: Schedule a follow-up meeting on project benefits.
opzioni.D: Conduct a team performance review.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Doing nothing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Analyze alignment first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. After reviewing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Irrelevant.

domande.spiegazione: Analyze before acting: check the alignment, then discuss.

domande.domanda: On a government infrastructure project requiring strict compliance, a routine review finds some activities may not meet required standards. What should you do?

opzioni.A: Halt all activities until a full compliance review.
opzioni.B: Update the plan with additional quality checks.
opzioni.C: Notify regulators of non-compliance.
opzioni.D: Conduct root cause analysis to find the reasons and implement corrective actions.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Too drastic for a potential issue.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not yet.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Confirm before notifying.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Analyze first, then fix.

domande.spiegazione: If it's only potential, analyze; halt only for confirmed illegality or safety.

domande.domanda: During construction, unforeseen geological issues will significantly increase costs beyond the budget. What should you do next?

opzioni.A: Adjust the timeline to reduce labor costs.
opzioni.B: Consult a geological technician for a cheaper solution.
opzioni.C: Implement phased construction.
opzioni.D: Analyze the situation, considering all possible options.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Needs a change request.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Good but narrower.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Unclear benefit.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. More comprehensive analysis.

domande.spiegazione: Analyze the situation before acting.

domande.domanda: Midway through the fiscal year, critical software enhancements funded by this year's budget won't be completed on schedule. What should you do first?

opzioni.A: Review the scope to identify areas to accelerate.
opzioni.B: Collaborate with the team to assess deliverables and focus on critical enhancements.
opzioni.C: Engage the sponsor to adjust expectations and secure an extension.
opzioni.D: Communicate progress and adjusted timelines to finance.

domande.hint: Who is best placed to tell you how to fix it?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. You can't do it alone.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. The team tells you how to solve it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Second best.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Finance isn't the customer.

domande.spiegazione: The team is the best source of solutions.

domande.domanda: Preparing an executive review, the PM must show how progress is tracked and measured. What should the presentation focus on?

opzioni.A: Team productivity and individual contributions.
opzioni.B: EVM metrics including SV and CV.
opzioni.C: A new PM tool's impact.
opzioni.D: Risks and mitigations.

domande.hint: What do we measure on projects?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Doesn't show project measurement.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. EVM measures time and cost performance.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Doesn't measure progress.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not measurement.

domande.spiegazione: EVM measures schedule and cost performance.

domande.domanda: Leading an agile global conservation project with a culturally diverse team across continents, the PM aims to foster unity and effective collaboration. What is the most effective action?

opzioni.A: Organize cross-cultural training for all teams.
opzioni.B: Set up a digital space for personal and professional updates.
opzioni.C: Arrange monthly face-to-face retreats.
opzioni.D: Encourage open communication and show confidence in the team's ability and contributions.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Good, but you impose the solution.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Leaves it to the team without engagement.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not feasible across continents.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Let the team work it out with open communication.

domande.spiegazione: On agile projects step back, encourage open communication and trust the team.
domande.nota: The instructor hesitates between A and D, then explains D ('indeed').

domande.domanda: At the start of a healthcare software upgrade, the client wants improvements in the shortest time. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Use agile to rapidly deliver high-priority features.
opzioni.B: Use waterfall to automate testing.
opzioni.C: Establish a task force on critical upgrades.
opzioni.D: Run stakeholder workshops to prioritize enhancements.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Agile delivers the most valuable features first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Slowest.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Only the customer knows what's critical.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The PO prioritizes.

domande.spiegazione: Agile delivers high-value features early.

domande.domanda: Midway through an urban development project, a key engineer and an urban planner announce their departure. The remaining team worries about workload and schedule. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Increase workload on others.
opzioni.B: Outsource tasks to a firm.
opzioni.C: Work with the remaining members to recruit new members.
opzioni.D: Apply for an extension.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Never overwork.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Long procurement.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Involve the team in the solution.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Needs a change request.

domande.spiegazione: Never overwork the team; involve them in the solution.

domande.domanda: Transitioning to lean, the PM faces resistance from worldwide stakeholders wary of new processes. What should the PM propose?

opzioni.A: Meetings with stakeholders to address concerns.
opzioni.B: Rewards for early adopters.
opzioni.C: Accept lean won't work everywhere.
opzioni.D: A company-wide seminar on lean history.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Find out what they don't like, then explain benefits.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Doesn't address concerns.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Doing nothing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Doesn't address concerns.

domande.spiegazione: Never do nothing; meet resistant stakeholders.

domande.domanda: In an IT infrastructure overhaul, the CTO departs; the incoming CTO pauses the initiative pending a review of alignment with the new direction. What is the most effective first step?

opzioni.A: Meet the new CTO to outline benefits and strategic alignment.
opzioni.B: Prepare a report comparing status with industry trends.
opzioni.C: Initiate an audit for compliance.
opzioni.D: Develop a contingency plan for changes.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Meet them first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Later.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Later.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Later.

domande.spiegazione: When a key stakeholder changes, meet the new one first.

domande.domanda: Estimating a challenging feature, developers have different views on effort. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Suggest a quick prototype.
opzioni.B: Allow time to reassess independently.
opzioni.C: Ask each member to detail their estimation process and foster group consensus.
opzioni.D: Assign estimation to the most experienced developer.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Premature.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Independent.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Shared understanding → consensus.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Forcing.

domande.spiegazione: Bring the team together to reach consensus.

domande.domanda: During an e-commerce rollout, an agile PM notices customers moving to a competitor with a user-friendly checkout. What first?

opzioni.A: Discuss customer feedback and market trends with the product owner.
opzioni.B: Intensify development refining existing features.
opzioni.C: Pause new features for an overhaul.
opzioni.D: Add a new checkout process.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. The PO decides.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The PO decides priorities.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Don't pause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Only the PO adds work.

domande.spiegazione: Only the product owner adds to and prioritizes the backlog.

domande.domanda: Initiating an advanced analytics platform new to the organization's landscape, what should the PM emphasize?

opzioni.A: Compatibility with legacy data and user adaptability.
opzioni.B: Precise needs analysis within key business sectors to ensure the platform meets specific objectives.
opzioni.C: Future-proofing consultation.
opzioni.D: Streamlining cross-functional workflows.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Covered by B.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Includes the others.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Covered by B.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Covered by B.

domande.spiegazione: A broad question gets a broad answer; in initiating, analyze needs and objectives.

domande.domanda: In the second sprint, one member dominates scrum meetings, reducing input from others. What should you do?

opzioni.A: Anonymous feedback system.
opzioni.B: Reassign them to less collaborative tasks.
opzioni.C: Switch to written updates.
opzioni.D: Have a private conversation with them about the impact.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. You already see the problem.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Don't remove people.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Avoids the issue.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Deal with individuals privately.

domande.spiegazione: Individual issues are handled privately and directly.

domande.domanda: Extensive, unforeseen scope changes (flagged in the initial risk assessment) cause delays; the team proposes requesting an extension. What next?

opzioni.A: Re-evaluate the timeline with all stakeholders.
opzioni.B: Ensure every scope change is properly logged and its impact assessed.
opzioni.C: Extend the schedule as needed.
opzioni.D: Renegotiate deliverables with stakeholders.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. After B.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. First make sure all changes are logged and assessed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Needs change request.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Avoids the problem.

domande.spiegazione: 'First/next': order the steps; log and assess all changes before re-evaluating.
domande.nota: Tricky question per the instructor.

domande.domanda: Client engagement in sprint reviews is low; a working prototype is ready. What first?

opzioni.A: Email a progress report.
opzioni.B: Deploy the prototype to gather feedback.
opzioni.C: Review with the technical lead first.
opzioni.D: Organize a sprint review to actively review the prototype with the client.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. No feedback.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. May not use it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Prototypes are for customers.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Demonstrate and engage.

domande.spiegazione: Sprint reviews are where customers give feedback.

domande.domanda: Essential feedback from a vital operational division has been consistently omitted, causing dissatisfaction. What first?

opzioni.A: Change scope.
opzioni.B: Comprehensive policy review.
opzioni.C: Review the communications management plan.
opzioni.D: Craft a reactive plan.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Needs approval.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not the root cause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Find why communication failed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Fixes before understanding.

domande.spiegazione: Find the root cause before fixing.

domande.domanda: During an IT deployment, there's a knowledge gap among newly onboarded staff. Budget is fully allocated; external training isn't feasible. Which two actions next? (Choose two.)

opzioni.A: Assess specific areas where new staff lack expertise.
opzioni.B: Reallocate critical tasks to experienced members.
opzioni.C: Propose a pause to reallocate budget to training.
opzioni.D: Establish mentorship pairings between new staff and seasoned professionals.
opzioni.E: Suggest new staff find online resources at their own cost.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Know what to train first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Overworks people.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Never pause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. On-the-job training.

domande.spiegazione: Identify gaps, then mentor internally.
domande.nota: Multiple-choice question (choose two).

domande.domanda: During an agile web platform, a critical stakeholder requests unforeseen functionality in the current cycle. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Advise presenting after the cycle review.
opzioni.B: Assess viability at the next team planning meeting.
opzioni.C: Swiftly revise the agenda.
opzioni.D: Have the product owner engage the stakeholder about incorporating the request.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Send them to the PO.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The team doesn't decide.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not your job.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Only the PO adds to the backlog.

domande.spiegazione: The product owner handles new requests.

domande.domanda: As a deadline approaches, enthusiasm drops; members arrive late and aren't focused. What should you do?

opzioni.A: Coordinate with HR on post-project opportunities.
opzioni.B: Conduct motivational workshops to re-energize and reinforce contributions.
opzioni.C: Peer recognition program.
opzioni.D: Enforce strict attendance.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Gives motivation to HR.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. You keep the team motivated.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Gives it to peers.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Negative.

domande.spiegazione: The PM keeps the team motivated; confront issues.

domande.domanda: The PM asks the product owner to prioritize features that greatly enhance patient data processing. Which tool?

opzioni.A: Scope statement
opzioni.B: Sprint backlog
opzioni.C: Product backlog
opzioni.D: WBS

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Traditional.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Team's sprint work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Stores and prioritizes all features.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Traditional.

domande.spiegazione: The product backlog holds and prioritizes features.

domande.domanda: In final stages, reports by a departed engineer were never documented or shared. What should have been implemented?

opzioni.A: Cross-training program.
opzioni.B: Monthly knowledge exchange.
opzioni.C: External consultants.
opzioni.D: An integrated PMIS to share information.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Engineers may need licenses.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Gaps between sessions.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Unneeded.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Continuous information sharing.

domande.spiegazione: Think long-term prevention.

domande.domanda: Fully remote team, communication challenge. Best approach?

opzioni.A: Monthly detailed updates.
opzioni.B: Structured online communication platform for frequent interactions.
opzioni.C: Open forum for daily posts.
opzioni.D: Biweekly emails.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Too specific.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Generic and frequent.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Too specific.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Too specific.

domande.spiegazione: A generic question gets a generic answer.

domande.domanda: Risks assessed as low evolved into issues. What proactive step?

opzioni.A: Weekly risk reviews.
opzioni.B: Monthly risk tracking.
opzioni.C: Zero tolerance.
opzioni.D: Continuous assessment and prioritization throughout the life cycle.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Too fixed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Too fixed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Unrealistic.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Continuous.

domande.spiegazione: Risk management is continuous.

domande.domanda: Despite meeting timeline and deliverables, stakeholders perceive diminishing value. What approach?

opzioni.A: Clarify that timeline is the indicator of success.
opzioni.B: Highlight fluctuations in value perception.
opzioni.C: Explain that most valuable items come first.
opzioni.D: Analyze the trend with the team, devise strategies and transparently communicate.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Forcing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Dismisses.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. True but doesn't address underlying issues.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Find and solve underlying issues.

domande.spiegazione: Confront and solve problems.

domande.domanda: Launching a software tool for small businesses, how should the PM ensure highest quality?

opzioni.A: Engage a reputable firm.
opzioni.B: Recruit a chief quality officer.
opzioni.C: Establish specific quality benchmarks and continuously seek to enhance them.
opzioni.D: Instruct lead developer to refine UX.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Reputation isn't quality.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Your job.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Benchmarking.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Prioritizing isn't the PM's.

domande.spiegazione: Benchmarking compares against standards.

domande.domanda: A client proposes a new cloud technology mid-project, aligned with their digital transformation. What next?

opzioni.A: Analyze the proposed change for strategic alignment and impact on outcomes.
opzioni.B: Notify the steering committee.
opzioni.C: Implement the change.
opzioni.D: Evaluate team capabilities against the new tech.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. First assess impact.

spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Gives away.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Change request.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Resolves.

domande.spiegazione: Fix-it questions need concrete solutions; 'first' questions need analysis.
domande.nota: Trick question per the instructor.

domande.domanda: Cultural misunderstandings between onsite and offshore teams. Action?

opzioni.A: Language course.
opzioni.B: Workshop sharing cultural norms and preferences.
opzioni.C: Liaison.
opzioni.D: Written only.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Too slow.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Shared understanding.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Dependency.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Impractical.

domande.spiegazione: Facilitate shared understanding.

domande.domanda: A company-wide IT security project schedules webinars; a not-yet-included department leader wants to attend early. Action?

opzioni.A: Limit.
opzioni.B: Wait.
opzioni.C: Encourage them to join early.
opzioni.D: Recordings only.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. No.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. No.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Engage.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Exclusive.

domande.spiegazione: Engage stakeholders early and often.

domande.domanda: Team lacks AI expertise for integration. Action?

opzioni.A: Targeted AI training for the team.
opzioni.B: Partner with AI firm.
opzioni.C: Problem-solving workshops.
opzioni.D: Automated tools.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Train.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Later if needed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. They lack expertise.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Complicates.

domande.spiegazione: Train when the team lacks skills.

domande.domanda: Experts across continents; face-to-face impossible. Action?

opzioni.A: Advanced PM and communication software.
opzioni.B: Rotational schedule.
opzioni.C: Cultural exchange.
opzioni.D: Email reports.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Real-time collaboration.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Occasional.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Slow.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Asynchronous.

domande.spiegazione: Use synchronous technology when not co-located.

domande.domanda: A stakeholder requests advanced AI capabilities late in the cycle. Next?

opzioni.A: Impact analysis on timeline and budget.
opzioni.B: Defer to next release.
opzioni.C: Increase hours.
opzioni.D: Negotiate resources.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Assess.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Rejects.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Overwork.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. After A.

domande.spiegazione: Assess changes first.

domande.domanda: A PM leads development of a new public library. During planning it emerges that the proposed site hosts a popular annual book fair, not considered in the initial consultations, raising concerns about community relations. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Redesign the layout to include a dedicated book fair space without additional stakeholder input.
opzioni.B: Organize a discussion forum with book fair organizers and community members to explore how the library can accommodate the fair.
opzioni.C: Prepare a risk management plan to mitigate backlash from book fair enthusiasts.
opzioni.D: Suggest relocating the book fair to a less central location without consulting the organizers.

domande.hint: Don't modify scope without your stakeholders.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Changes scope without stakeholder input.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Engages stakeholders to find a solution together.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Takes no real action: just waits for backlash.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Decides without consulting the organizers.

domande.spiegazione: The PM doesn't modify scope without consulting stakeholders: bring them together to find a solution.

domande.domanda: On a software project, budget reallocations mean several developers will be reassigned to other projects, creating unease about timelines and roles. What should the PM do first?

opzioni.A: Implement a revised schedule with accelerated timelines to show the project can proceed.
opzioni.B: Facilitate a session to discuss the reassignments, emphasizing the strategic vision and how team contributions remain critical.
opzioni.C: Introduce a mentorship program pairing remaining members with experienced mentors.
opzioni.D: Launch a cross-training initiative to diversify the remaining team's skills.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Changing the schedule needs a change request.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Discuss what the reassignments mean for the project and the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Possible afterwards.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Possible afterwards.

domande.spiegazione: 'First' questions: assess and discuss the situation before taking action (B, then C/D).

domande.domanda: During a citywide public transportation project, a City Council member requests a specialized update beyond the regular briefings. The team uses simulation software and traffic flow analysis. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Provide a tutorial on interpreting the simulation results.
opzioni.B: Invite the council member to a workshop on traffic flow analysis.
opzioni.C: Engage directly with the council member to clarify what specific data and insights are needed.
opzioni.D: Compile a comprehensive report from both tools.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. You decide what to give them.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. You decide what to give them.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Clarify their needs before providing information.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. You decide what to give them.

domande.spiegazione: Before providing information, ask what, when, how and in what format the stakeholder wants it.

domande.domanda: After a critical review of a healthcare software project, the PM notes one software engineer's output is below standards. What is the most appropriate form of communication?

opzioni.A: A group email on standards without naming individuals.
opzioni.B: A one-on-one meeting to discuss the performance issues and a development plan.
opzioni.C: A formal performance improvement plan through HR.
opzioni.D: A team-wide meeting on standards and individual contributions.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Indirect and doesn't address the person.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Deal with the individual privately.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Escalates and gives away the problem.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Public: never address individual issues in front of the team.

domande.spiegazione: Problems involving one person are handled one-on-one, not in front of the team.

domande.domanda: Leading an agile software project across multiple time zones, the PM has previously seen inconsistent quality and missed deadlines with such teams. What action ensures quality deliverables and timeline adherence?

opzioni.A: Hold frequent virtual stand-ups to clarify goals, synchronize efforts and address issues.
opzioni.B: Develop a training program on time management.
opzioni.C: Distribute a weekly progress template.
opzioni.D: Organize quarterly in-person meetups.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Daily stand-ups keep a distributed team aligned and surface issues.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Decent, but doesn't synchronize the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Weekly may be too far apart.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Too infrequent.

domande.spiegazione: On an agile project you should hold the daily (virtual) stand-up.

domande.domanda: A PM launches a new drug product that must comply with stringent health and safety regulations to avoid penalties and ensure public safety. What should the PM do next?

opzioni.A: Arrange regular training sessions on regulatory compliance.
opzioni.B: Assess and document the potential compliance risks related to health and safety.
opzioni.C: Implement a quality control system to monitor against safety standards.
opzioni.D: Consult legal experts to review alignment.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Possible after B.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Identify and document compliance risks first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Comes later.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Assess internally first.

domande.spiegazione: Assess and document compliance risks before training, controls or external consultation.

domande.domanda: During the critical testing phase of an enterprise software upgrade, the PM finds testing significantly behind schedule, risking the go-live date. What first?

opzioni.A: Escalate to executive management.
opzioni.B: Conduct a detailed session with the team to pinpoint the causes of the delay.
opzioni.C: Seek funding for external testing services.
opzioni.D: Implement overtime for the testing team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Executives decide, they don't manage your project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Find the causes with the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Premature without knowing the cause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Overtime hurts productivity and quality.

domande.spiegazione: Find the cause with the team; never overwork people or escalate first.

domande.domanda: During construction of a city park, landscape designers and environmental consultants conflict over plant species and their environmental impact. Which two actions should the PM take first? (Choose two.)

opzioni.A: Delay decisions until further research.
opzioni.B: Organize individual meetings with each group to understand their concerns.
opzioni.C: Hold a workshop for all stakeholders to vote on the species.
opzioni.D: Escalate to the City Council for a final decision.
opzioni.E: Conduct private targeted discussions with key representatives of both sides to find middle ground.

domande.hint: Understand each side, then bring them together.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Kicks the can down the road.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Understand each group's concerns.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Voting before exploring middle ground.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Try to solve it first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.E: Correct. Bring both sides together toward a solution.

domande.spiegazione: First understand each side, then bring representatives together to find common ground.
domande.nota: Multiple-choice question (choose two).

domande.domanda: During a software implementation, the team's unfamiliarity with the new software's API slows integration and threatens milestones. What first, without raising the budget?

opzioni.A: Initiate a collaborative problem-solving session to identify alternative integration strategies or solutions.
opzioni.B: Delegate integration to a more experienced team elsewhere.
opzioni.C: Invest in a fast-track external training program.
opzioni.D: Hire an external consultant.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Works within the constraint, with the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Gives the work away.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Raises the budget.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Raises the budget.

domande.spiegazione: Read the constraint: options that raise the budget are out.
domande.nota: The instructor: not a great answer, but the best given the constraint.

domande.domanda: During planning of a development project, a newly enacted zoning law changes permissible building heights in the project area. The team has been informed. What is the most effective course of action?

opzioni.A: Proceed with planning until legal says to update.
opzioni.B: Update the project documentation to reflect the zoning law change and its impact on scope.
opzioni.C: Seek an exception from local government.
opzioni.D: Consult legal counsel on the implications.

domande.hint: Still in planning, and it's a law.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Ignores a law already in force.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. In planning you can update without a change request; laws must be followed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. It's the law: no exceptions to seek.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The impact (height) is already known.

domande.spiegazione: Laws must be complied with; during planning, update the documents directly.
domande.nota: Trick question per the instructor.

domande.domanda: In the late stages of a marketing campaign, a critical piece of content isn't ready because a team member fell behind, revealed during a presentation to marketing. What first?

opzioni.A: Have a confidential discussion with the team member to understand the delay and explore solutions together.
opzioni.B: Delegate the task to another member.
opzioni.C: Organize a team session to expedite the work.
opzioni.D: Seek a senior manager's advice.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Talk privately to the person.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Reassigning before understanding.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Involves the whole team prematurely.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Senior managers don't solve your project problems.

domande.spiegazione: Individual problems: meet the person privately first.

domande.domanda: An environmental consultant suggests a new technology for a renewable energy initiative that improves outcomes but extends the timeline and raises costs. What first?

opzioni.A: Forward it to the change control board for approval.
opzioni.B: Arrange a team meeting to discuss the feasibility and implications.
opzioni.C: Consult industry experts.
opzioni.D: Do a preliminary risk analysis.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Changes must be assessed before CCB approval.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. The team assesses feasibility and impact.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Internal first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The team should help with it.

domande.spiegazione: All changes must be assessed (with the team) before the CCB can approve them.

domande.domanda: On a renewable energy project, a team member notices a significant equipment procurement risk and tells the sponsor, who asks the PM for an assessment and action plan. Which document should the PM consult with the team for predefined approaches?

opzioni.A: Risk register
opzioni.B: Issue log
opzioni.C: Risk response strategy
opzioni.D: Risk management plan

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Contains risks and their planned responses.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. It's a risk, not an issue.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not a real document.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Describes how risk is managed, not specific risks.

domande.spiegazione: The risk register lists risks and their responses; the risk management plan is the process.

domande.domanda: Finalizing an infrastructure upgrade, the PM must confirm all operational knowledge was transferred effectively to the client's maintenance team. What approach confirms thoroughness?

opzioni.A: Schedule face-to-face sessions between maintenance and project teams to validate understanding and application.
opzioni.B: Administer a formal assessment.
opzioni.C: Create an online module.
opzioni.D: Facilitate a roundtable discussion.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Face-to-face lets them validate understanding together.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Less rich.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not interactive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Good, but face-to-face validation is better.

domande.spiegazione: Face-to-face is the richest communication method.

domande.domanda: Various teams on a software project use different priorities and methodologies, causing inconsistencies and delays. What ensures consistent progress?

opzioni.A: Implement a centralized PM tool.
opzioni.B: Conduct a workshop to align all teams on objectives and establish a shared methodology.
opzioni.C: Assign liaisons.
opzioni.D: Reallocate resources by urgency.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. You choose for them.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Shared methodology directly fixes inconsistency.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Doesn't unify.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. You decide for them.

domande.spiegazione: Choose the option that solves the stated problem, letting teams decide together.

domande.domanda: While implementing an ERP on an agile project, the PM receives requests for additional features from department heads. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Have them submit after go-live.
opzioni.B: Have the product owner integrate the requests into the product backlog for prioritization.
opzioni.C: Advise that all changes are frozen.
opzioni.D: Request a detailed business case for each feature.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Delays without evaluation.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Only the PO adds to and prioritizes the backlog.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Agile doesn't freeze changes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not needed; between PO and requesters.

domande.spiegazione: Only the product owner adds features to the backlog and prioritizes them.

domande.domanda: A specialist responsible for key configuration will take emergency leave. What should the PM do to stay on schedule?

opzioni.A: Facilitate a discussion with the team to redistribute responsibilities.
opzioni.B: Pause the project.
opzioni.C: Hire external consultants.
opzioni.D: Request an extension.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Quickest, team-driven solution.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Never pause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Only if the team says it's needed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Only if needed.

domande.spiegazione: The team has the power and expertise: work with them first.

domande.domanda: Near completion, one developer's innovative solutions greatly enhanced the outcome. Most appropriate acknowledgment?

opzioni.A: Newsletter feature.
opzioni.B: Casual team lunch.
opzioni.C: Recommend for an industry award.
opzioni.D: Identify a form of recognition aligned with what the developer values most.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. You choose.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. You choose.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. You choose.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Let them choose what they value.

domande.spiegazione: Tailor recognition to what the person values.

domande.domanda: Stakeholders disagree on balancing interactive content vs accessibility for an online education platform; the team is split. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Deploy conflict resolution techniques to unite diverse viewpoints into a unified strategy.
opzioni.B: Poll team and stakeholders.
opzioni.C: Focus group with design thinking.
opzioni.D: Let the team debate without managerial intervention.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Merges views into one strategy so the project can progress.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Some features may be legally required.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Innovative but not unifying.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Never leave the team alone.

domande.spiegazione: Use conflict resolution to reach a unified strategy.

domande.domanda: Halfway through a website project, a sprint review reveals an unforeseen technical hurdle that could delay completion, despite weekly updates saying all was on plan. What should have been done?

opzioni.A: Establish a robust risk process to identify and monitor potential technical challenges throughout.
opzioni.B: Mid-sprint reviews.
opzioni.C: One-on-ones.
opzioni.D: PM tool flagging deviations.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Manage risk throughout the project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not enough.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Risk is done as a team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Tools don't replace the process.

domande.spiegazione: Risk management is continuous and team-based.
domande.nota: The instructor calls it 'question 178' by mistake; it is question 170.

domande.domanda: Rolling out an online banking platform, the sponsor stresses excellent customer support post-launch. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Extend customer service hours.
opzioni.B: Temporary hotline.
opzioni.C: Self-paced webinars.
opzioni.D: Create an online help center with tutorials, a searchable knowledge base and live support options.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. One option.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. One option.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. One option.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Most options for diverse needs.

domande.spiegazione: With many stakeholders, offer multiple support channels.

domande.domanda: At the start of a smart city initiative, a crucial environmental expert's input was not included in the impact assessment discussions. Which document most likely needs revision?

opzioni.A: Stakeholder register
opzioni.B: Stakeholder engagement plan
opzioni.C: Project schedule
opzioni.D: Communications management plan

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Identify the stakeholder first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Comes after the register.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Unrelated.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Comes after identification.

domande.spiegazione: If a stakeholder was missed, the stakeholder register needs updating.

domande.domanda: Newly assigned to a technology integration project, the PM finds no foundational documentation; the team is unsure about scope, deliverables and timeline. What action?

opzioni.A: Start with high-level tasks and document as you go.
opzioni.B: Have department heads compile sections.
opzioni.C: Use templates to quickly draft documents.
opzioni.D: Engage the entire team in a planning session to develop the critical PM documents.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. No foundation.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Your job.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Templates good, but engage the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Collaborative planning with the team.

domande.spiegazione: Build the plan with the team.

domande.domanda: A PM organizes biweekly meetings with the development team. What should be prioritized at the beginning?

opzioni.A: Detail status and deviations.
opzioni.B: Review the meeting agenda: times and topics to cover.
opzioni.C: Re-evaluate scope.
opzioni.D: Gather feedback.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. During the meeting.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. State purpose, timing and topics first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Later.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Later.

domande.spiegazione: Start every meeting with the agenda and timing.

domande.domanda: Unexpected bugs and team miscommunications cause delays and tension; the sponsor is concerned. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Conduct team-building focused on collaboration and open communication.
opzioni.B: Problem-solving workshop on technical issues.
opzioni.C: Increase progress review meetings.
opzioni.D: Hire a professional mediator.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Fixes miscommunication and enables solving technical issues.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Only technical.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. May worsen tension.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. That's your job.

domande.spiegazione: Open communication addresses both miscommunication and technical issues.

domande.domanda: Decision-making has slowed because the PM must approve numerous minor adjustments while booked in stakeholder meetings. What initiative?

opzioni.A: Weekly decision sessions.
opzioni.B: Critical path analysis.
opzioni.C: Delegate decision-making for specific areas to trusted project leads.
opzioni.D: Make all decisions.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Teams wait for decisions.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Cause already known.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Empower trusted leads.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The current bottleneck.

domande.spiegazione: Delegate minor decisions to trusted leads.

domande.domanda: An executive sponsor is dissatisfied with overly detailed updates. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Weekly email summary.
opzioni.B: Real-time tool.
opzioni.C: Have a detailed discussion with the sponsor to identify their preferences for information and format.
opzioni.D: Brief update calls.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. You choose.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. You choose.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Tailor to their preferences.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. You choose.

domande.spiegazione: If options do the same thing (you choose), they're likely wrong; tailor to the stakeholder.

domande.domanda: On an iterative project, a new developer suggests a cutting-edge testing technique; the team is reluctant. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Tell the developer to maintain the status quo.
opzioni.B: Assign them to less critical tasks.
opzioni.C: Facilitate a discussion where the developer presents the method, advantages and implementation.
opzioni.D: Have them write a report for review at project end.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Shuts the developer down.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Like firing them from the task.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Let the team evaluate it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Too late to benefit.

domande.spiegazione: Don't shut down new ideas; let the team evaluate them.

domande.domanda: Before a crucial update meeting, the PM learns of a potential unforeseen delay involving an external contractor; extent unknown. Which two actions? (Choose two.)

opzioni.A: Liaise with the contractor to understand the reasons.
opzioni.B: Perform a detailed assessment of the overall impact.
opzioni.C: Delay discussion until stakeholders notice.
opzioni.D: Compare with documented outcomes from similar incidents.
opzioni.E: Update the risk register and discuss it openly at the meeting.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. After assessment.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Assess the impact.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not proactive.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Useful but less direct.
spiegazioni_opzioni.E: Correct. It's a risk: register and discuss.

domande.spiegazione: A potential delay is a risk: assess and record in the risk register.
domande.nota: Multiple-choice question (choose two).

domande.domanda: At the end of an enterprise software project, a department head suggests a new analytics feature not in the initial scope, considered easy for IT. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Assess the feasibility of the feature within the project without formalizing it yet.
opzioni.B: Consult finance on budget implications.
opzioni.C: Meet stakeholders on value vs effort and risk.
opzioni.D: Draft a supplemental charter.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Assess feasibility; changes can't be formalized without approval.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Only budget.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Partial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Charter not needed.

domande.spiegazione: Assess the change; formal scope changes go through change control or the PO.
domande.nota: Answer as stated by the instructor.

domande.domanda: Upgrading an institution's digital infrastructure, a department head proposes an AI learning assistant not in scope and isn't sure investors would fund it. Initial action?

opzioni.A: Feasibility study.
opzioni.B: Estimate budget/timeline impact.
opzioni.C: Consult with the team to assess how the integration could affect the overall project.
opzioni.D: Assess the addition's impact.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Only technical/financial.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Only time and cost.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Team experts assess overall impact.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Done alone.

domande.spiegazione: The team best knows how a change affects the project.

domande.domanda: An e-commerce update faces: urgent cybersecurity expertise need, upcoming staff shortages including the PO's exit, and a new data security law. Where to focus?

opzioni.A: Search for a cybersecurity expert.
opzioni.B: Transition to a new PO.
opzioni.C: Secure an IT contractor.
opzioni.D: Resolve identified regulatory compliance issues to prevent legal or operational setbacks.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Important, but secondary.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Important, but secondary.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Secondary.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. No project should proceed while breaking the law.

domande.spiegazione: Compliance with the law takes priority.

domande.domanda: Global health initiative: online tools hinder communication; the team suggests changing tools. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Trial tools on a small scale.
opzioni.B: Delegate to an advisory board.
opzioni.C: Maximize current tools.
opzioni.D: Meet the entire team to assess needs, evaluate alternatives and decide.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. You decide.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Gives away.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Ignores suggestion.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Team-driven decision.

domande.spiegazione: Let the team choose the tools that suit it.

domande.domanda: An external provider claims its security software is plug-and-play with no need for validation. The PM wants to confirm with organizational stakeholders. Initial step?

opzioni.A: Convene a comprehensive briefing with key stakeholders to consolidate understanding and set unified expectations.
opzioni.B: Draft a contingency plan.
opzioni.C: Propose vendor–IT collaboration.
opzioni.D: Survey department heads.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Align expectations first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Gaps unknown.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Only IT.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Less rich than a briefing.

domande.spiegazione: Align stakeholders' understanding and expectations first.

domande.domanda: A tech firm moves to agile for a more dynamic, customer-responsive process. Principal advantage?

opzioni.A: Faster time to market.
opzioni.B: Structured risk approach.
opzioni.C: Prioritize and deliver features by value and customer demand.
opzioni.D: Reduce operations costs.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Partly true, but secondary.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not agile.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Most valuable first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not guaranteed.

domande.spiegazione: Agile's value is delivering the most valuable features first.

domande.domanda: On a green energy plant, the project may miss the schedule despite good team performance. First action?

opzioni.A: Inform senior management.
opzioni.B: Brief the board.
opzioni.C: Revise the timeline with lead engineers.
opzioni.D: Review the current timeline with the entire team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. After assessing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. After assessing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Revising needs change request.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Assess with the team first.

domande.spiegazione: Meet the team and assess before informing or changing.
domande.nota: Option D completed by the instructor ('with the entire team').

domande.domanda: A new PM takes over a hybrid retail software project. Which document first to understand strategic benefits and objectives?

opzioni.A: Roadmap
opzioni.B: Business case
opzioni.C: Strategic alignment documents
opzioni.D: Technical design documents

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Program-level.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Holds benefits and justification.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not a standard document.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Technical.

domande.spiegazione: Ignore filler: the business case holds benefits and objectives.

domande.domanda: An unusual enterprise software upgrade: who chooses the PM methodology and tools?

opzioni.A: Key stakeholders from each department.
opzioni.B: Strictly industry standard.
opzioni.C: The CTO.
opzioni.D: The PM and the project team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. No.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Tailor.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. No.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. They understand the work.

domande.spiegazione: The PM and team tailor methodology and tools.

domande.domanda: Environmental initiative: team from engineering, environmental science and PM disciplines. Clear communication?

opzioni.A: Individualized communication plans catering to each discipline's needs and preferences.
opzioni.B: Centralized dashboard.
opzioni.C: Interdisciplinary workshops.
opzioni.D: Liaisons.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Tailored.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. One method.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not tailored.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not everyone.

domande.spiegazione: Communication should be tailored to stakeholders.

domande.domanda: After charter approval, the PM and team organize scope into smaller detailed components. What are they creating?

opzioni.A: RACI chart
opzioni.B: Schedule network diagram
opzioni.C: Work breakdown structure
opzioni.D: Execution phase schedule

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Assigns people.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Schedule.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Decomposed work packages.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Schedule.

domande.spiegazione: Decomposing scope creates the WBS.

domande.domanda: Agile project: many miss or are late to virtual daily scrums. Action?

opzioni.A: Work with the team to define a communication protocol that ensures timely participation.
opzioni.B: Pick a time yourself.
opzioni.C: Asynchronous updates.
opzioni.D: Stakeholder input.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Team-built agreement.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. You decide.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not a daily scrum.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not the team.

domande.spiegazione: Work with the team on its own agreements.

domande.domanda: Legislative updates required security enhancements; development stayed on budget but the QA/testing budget is depleting. Action?

opzioni.A: Temporary reallocation.
opzioni.B: Sponsor analyzes savings.
opzioni.C: Submit a formal change request to revise the cost baseline for the extra testing.
opzioni.D: Adjust financial strategy.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. May need change request.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Sponsor approves, doesn't analyze.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Formal change control.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Unauthorized.

domande.spiegazione: Budget changes require a formal change request.

domande.domanda: Agile team discovers it needs an unanticipated advanced library critical for functionality. Action?

opzioni.A: Meet the PO to reassess priorities and integrate the library.
opzioni.B: Update the timeline.
opzioni.C: Log as risk; ask steering committee.
opzioni.D: Delegate to a specialist.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Through the PO and backlog.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Needs PO.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. It's needed now.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Gives away.

domande.spiegazione: New agile work goes through the product owner.

domande.domanda: Client changes threaten the timeline; acceleration may mean overtime. Keep the team motivated?

opzioni.A: Monetary incentives for extended hours.
opzioni.B: Regularly recognize efforts and celebrate milestones.
opzioni.C: Reassign tasks to reduce workload.
opzioni.D: Mandatory team-building.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not feasible for all.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Maintains morale.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. May not be feasible.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Mandatory demotivates.

domande.spiegazione: Recognition and celebration maintain motivation.

domande.domanda: Members resist new PM software as overly complicated. What should the PM have done initially?

opzioni.A: Team leaders set an example.
opzioni.B: Reward early adopters who integrate it.
opzioni.C: One-on-ones on resistance.
opzioni.D: Comprehensive training demonstrating functionality and benefits.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Doesn't show benefits.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Use for rewards.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Fixes now.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Shows benefits upfront.

domande.spiegazione: Prevention: show the benefits through training.

domande.domanda: A water system project can't finalize the schedule due to unpredictable regulatory reviews and equipment delays. Technique?

opzioni.A: Rolling wave planning
opzioni.B: Backward pass
opzioni.C: Dependency structuring
opzioni.D: Lead and lag optimization

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Detail as things clarify.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Critical path.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Dependencies.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Overlaps/delays.

domande.spiegazione: Rolling wave planning.

domande.domanda: A participant derails meetings with irrelevant technical details, causing overruns. Action?

opzioni.A: Emphasize the agenda at the start and kindly remind participants to stay on topic.
opzioni.B: Open discussion time at end.
opzioni.C: Co-facilitator.
opzioni.D: Suggestion box.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Solves it directly.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. May extend meetings.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. You are the facilitator.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Indirect.

domande.spiegazione: Restate the agenda and keep discussions on topic.

domande.domanda: A key member says the risk strategy doesn't address unpredictable weather on crop trials. First?

opzioni.A: Contingency fund.
opzioni.B: External expert.
opzioni.C: Re-evaluate the risk management plan and register with the entire team.
opzioni.D: Adjust timeline.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Later.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Later.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Team incorporates feedback.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Change request.

domande.spiegazione: Review risks with the team first.

domande.domanda: A design software license expired, halting critical campaign visuals. Initial action?

opzioni.A: Manual sketches.
opzioni.B: Team works with IT.
opzioni.C: Prioritize other aspects.
opzioni.D: Coordinate with IT to promptly renew the license.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not optimal.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Gives it to the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Avoids.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Remove the obstacle yourself.

domande.spiegazione: Removing impediments is the servant leader's job.

domande.domanda: A key developer must take unexpected leave, impacting a crucial backlog item for the upcoming sprint review. What should the PM do?

opzioni.A: Ask them to work remotely during leave.
opzioni.B: Escalate and demand resources.
opzioni.C: Re-evaluate sprint goals and backlog priorities with the team and communicate the revised plan.
opzioni.D: Cancel the sprint review.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Never.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Negative.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Adjust with the team; the PO reprioritizes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Never cancel.

domande.spiegazione: Re-evaluate with the team; only the PO reprioritizes the backlog.
